turns.en: Ha ha, that dish hasn't got any chilli in it! And three bowls of rice and a pot of tea, please.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 怎么样？吃饱了吗？
turns.pinyin: zěnmeyàng? chī bǎo le ma?
turns.en: Well? Have you had enough?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 吃饱了！微辣的水煮鱼也很辣，可是真好吃！
turns.pinyin: chī bǎo le! wēilà de shuǐzhǔyú yě hěn là, kěshì zhēn hǎochī!
turns.en: I'm full! Even the mild fish was hot, but it was really good!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好吃吧？表哥做的四川菜很地道。
turns.pinyin: hǎochī ba? biǎogē zuò de sìchuān cài hěn dìdao.
turns.en: Good, isn't it? My cousin's Sichuan food is the real thing.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 服务员，买单！
turns.pinyin: fúwùyuán, mǎidān!
turns.en: Waitress, the bill please!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 今天我请客！你们常常请我吃饭。
turns.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè! nǐmen chángcháng qǐng wǒ chīfàn.
turns.en: It's on me tonight! You're always buying me dinner.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 不行，我比你们大，我来！
turns.pinyin: bùxíng, wǒ bǐ nǐmen dà, wǒ lái!
turns.en: No way. I'm older than all of you, I'll get it!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你们别争了，我们 AA 吧！
turns.pinyin: nǐmen bié zhēng le, wǒmenAA ba!
turns.en: Stop fighting over it. Let's go Dutch!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: AA 是什么意思？
turns.pinyin: AA shì shénme yìsi?
turns.en: 'AA'? What does that mean?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 就是每个人付自己的钱。
turns.pinyin: jiù shì měi gè rén fù zìjǐ de qián.
turns.en: It means everyone pays for themselves.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 不好意思，这位先生已经付了。
turns.pinyin: bùhǎoyìsi, zhè wèi xiānsheng yǐjīng fù le.
turns.en: Sorry, this gentleman has already paid.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 又是您！那下次一定是我请客！
turns.pinyin: yòu shì nín! nà xià cì yīdìng shì wǒ qǐngkè!
turns.en: You again! Then next time it's definitely on me!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我爸爸每次都这样！
turns.pinyin: wǒ bàba měi cì dōu zhèyàng!
turns.en: My dad does this every time!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 马克，你喜欢什么运动？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?
turns.en: Mark, what sports do you like?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我喜欢跑步，也喜欢游泳。你呢？
turns.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan pǎobù, yě xǐhuan yóuyǒng. nǐ ne?
turns.en: I like running, and swimming too. What about you?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我喜欢打羽毛球。每个星期天上午，我都去体育馆打球。你打过羽毛球吗？
turns.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan dǎ yǔmáoqiú. měi gè xīngqītiān shàngwǔ, wǒ dōu qù tǐyùguǎn dǎqiú. nǐ dǎ guo yǔmáoqiú ma?
turns.en: I like badminton. I go and play at the sports hall every Sunday morning. Have you ever played badminton?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 没打过。我会踢足球，可是不会打羽毛球。
turns.pinyin: méi dǎ guo. wǒ huì tī zúqiú, kěshì bù huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú.
turns.en: Never. I can play football, but I can't play badminton.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 在中国，很多人都会打羽毛球。一点儿也不难，我可以教你！
turns.pinyin: zài zhōngguó, hěnduō rén dōu huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú. yīdiǎnr yěbù nán, wǒ kěyǐ jiāo nǐ!
turns.en: In China, loads of people can play. It's not hard at all. I can teach you!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 真的吗？太好了！
turns.pinyin: zhēnde ma? tàihǎole!
turns.en: Really? Brilliant!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 这个星期天你能来吗？
turns.pinyin: zhège xīngqītiān nǐ néng lái ma?
turns.en: Can you come this Sunday?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 能！几点？
turns.pinyin: néng! jǐ diǎn?
turns.en: Yes! What time?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 十点，在体育馆门口见。
turns.pinyin: shí diǎn, zài tǐyùguǎn ménkǒu jiàn.
turns.en: Ten o'clock. See you outside the sports hall.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我没有球拍，可以吗？
turns.pinyin: wǒ méiyǒu qiúpāi, kěyǐ ma?
turns.en: I haven't got a racket. Is that OK?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 可以，我有两个。你穿运动鞋来就行。
turns.pinyin: kěyǐ, wǒ yǒu liǎng gè. nǐ chuān yùndòngxié lái jiù xíng.
turns.en: That's fine, I've got two. Just come in trainers.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，星期天见！
turns.pinyin: hǎo, xīngqītiān jiàn!
turns.en: Great, see you Sunday!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 来，球拍要这样拿。你先打一个。
turns.pinyin: lái, qiúpāi yào zhèyàng ná. nǐ xiān dǎ yī gè.
turns.en: Right, hold the racket like this. You have a go first.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这样？……怎么样？
turns.pinyin: zhèyàng? zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: Like this? ...How was that?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 不错！再来一个！
turns.pinyin: bùcuò! zài lái yī gè!
turns.en: Not bad! Again!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈明，你每个星期都来这儿吗？你常常一个人来吗？
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng, nǐ měi gè xīngqī dōu lái zhèr ma? nǐ chángcháng yī gè rén lái ma?
turns.en: Chen Ming, do you come here every week? Do you often come on your own?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 马克，别一边打球一边说话！看球！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, bié yībiān dǎqiú yībiān shuōhuà! kàn qiú!
turns.en: Mark, don't talk while you're playing! Watch the shuttle!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对不起！我能一边跑步一边听音乐，可是不能一边打球一边说话。
turns.pinyin: duìbuqǐ! wǒ néng yībiān pǎobù yībiān tīng yīnyuè, kěshì bù néng yībiān dǎqiú yībiān shuōhuà.
turns.en: Sorry! I can run and listen to music at the same time, but I can't play and talk.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那就别说话了！……你累了吧？休息一下。
turns.pinyin: nà jiù bié shuōhuà le! nǐ lèi le ba? xiūxi yīxià.
turns.en: Then stop talking! ...You must be tired. Let's have a break.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好。这儿可以吃东西吗？我带了一个香蕉。
turns.pinyin: hǎo. zhèr kěyǐ chī dōngxi ma? wǒ dài le yī gè xiāngjiāo.
turns.en: OK. Can you eat in here? I brought a banana.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 这儿不可以吃东西，可以喝水。
turns.pinyin: zhèr bù kěyǐ chī dōngxi, kěyǐ hē shuǐ.
turns.en: No eating in here, but you can drink water.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好吧……哎呀！我的手机！
turns.pinyin: hǎo ba āiyā! wǒ de shǒujī!
turns.en: Fine... Oh no! My phone!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 怎么了？
turns.pinyin: zěnmele?
turns.en: What's happened?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 手机掉在地上了……坏了！
turns.pinyin: shǒujī diào zài dìshang le huài le!
turns.en: It fell on the floor... It's broken!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我的旧手机坏了，得买个新的。小雨，你看，这两个哪个好？
turns.pinyin: wǒ de jiù shǒujī huài le, děi mǎi gè xīn de. Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ kàn, zhè liǎng gè nǎge hǎo?
turns.en: My old phone's broken, so I've got to buy a new one. Xiaoyu, look, which of these two is better?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这个是今年的新手机，又轻又好看，拍照也特别好。
turns.pinyin: zhège shì jīnnián de xīn shǒujī, yòu qīng yòu hǎokàn, pāizhào yě tèbié hǎo.
turns.en: This one's this year's model. It's light and it looks great, and the camera's really good.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那个呢？
turns.pinyin: nàge ne?
turns.en: What about that one?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那个是去年的。屏幕比这个大一点儿，电池也比这个好。
turns.pinyin: nàge shì qùnián de. píngmù bǐ zhège dà yīdiǎnr, diànchí yě bǐ zhège hǎo.
turns.en: That's last year's. The screen's a bit bigger than this one's, and the battery's better too.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 多少钱？
turns.pinyin: duōshǎoqián?
turns.en: How much are they?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 新的九百九十九块，去年的六百块。
turns.pinyin: xīn de jiǔbǎijiǔshíjiǔ kuài, qùnián de liù bǎi kuài.
turns.en: The new one's nine hundred and ninety-nine pounds, and last year's is six hundred.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 新的比去年的贵多了！
turns.pinyin: xīn de bǐ qùnián de guì duōle!
turns.en: The new one's much more expensive!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对。不过你是设计师，常常拍照，拍照最重要。
turns.pinyin: duì. bùguò nǐ shì shèjìshī, chángcháng pāizhào, pāizhào zuì zhòngyào.
turns.en: Yes. But you're a designer and you take lots of photos. The camera's the most important thing.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可是我也常常用手机看电影，屏幕大的更好。
turns.pinyin: kěshì wǒ yě chángcháng yòng shǒujī kàn diànyǐng, píngmù dà de gèng hǎo.
turns.en: But I watch a lot of films on my phone too, so a bigger screen is better.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那你买去年的吧，又便宜又大！
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ mǎi qùnián de ba, yòu piányi yòu dà!
turns.en: Then get last year's. It's cheaper and bigger!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好主意！就买这个！
turns.pinyin: hǎozhǔyi! jiù mǎi zhège!
turns.en: Good idea! This one it is!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克，你想买哪个手机？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎge shǒujī?
turns.en: Mark, which phone do you want to buy?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我要这个。有什么颜色？
turns.pinyin: wǒ yào zhège. yǒu shénme yánsè?
turns.en: I'll have this one. What colours does it come in?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 有黑色、白色和蓝色。你喜欢黑色还是白色？
turns.pinyin: yǒu hēisè, báisè hé lánsè. nǐ xǐhuan hēisè háishi báisè?
turns.en: Black, white and blue. Do you prefer black or white?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 黑色或者蓝色都行。哪个颜色最受欢迎？
turns.pinyin: hēisè huòzhě lánsè dōu xíng. nǎge yánsè zuì shòuhuānyíng?
turns.en: Black or blue, either's fine. Which colour's the most popular?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 黑色的最受欢迎，买的人最多。我的也是黑色的！
turns.pinyin: hēisè de zuì shòuhuānyíng, mǎi de rén zuì duō. wǒ de yě shì hēisè de!
turns.en: Black's the most popular. That's the one most people buy. Mine's black too!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那就要黑色的。您能帮我问问，能便宜一点儿吗？
turns.pinyin: nà jiù yào hēisè de. nín néng bāng wǒ wèn wèn, néng piányi yīdiǎnr ma?
turns.en: Then I'll have black. Could you ask for me if they can do it a bit cheaper?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我问了。不能再便宜了，不过他送你一个手机壳。
turns.pinyin: wǒ wèn le. bù néng zài piányi le, bùguò tā sòng nǐ yī gè shǒujīké.
turns.en: I asked. He can't go any lower, but he'll throw in a phone case.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好！可以用手机付钱吗？……啊，不行，我的手机坏了！
turns.pinyin: hǎo! kěyǐ yòng shǒujī fùqián ma? a, bùxíng, wǒ de shǒujī huài le!
turns.en: Great! Can I pay with my phone? ...Oh, no, I can't, my phone's broken!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈！你可以刷卡或者付现金。
turns.pinyin: hāhā! nǐ kěyǐ shuākǎ huòzhě fù xiànjīn.
turns.en: Ha ha! You can pay by card or in cash.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 刷卡吧。
turns.pinyin: shuākǎ ba.
turns.en: Card, then.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 新手机，别再掉在地上了！
turns.pinyin: xīn shǒujī, bié zài diào zài dìshang le!
turns.en: It's a new phone. Don't drop this one on the floor!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 放心！以后打羽毛球，我不带手机！
turns.pinyin: fàngxīn! yǐhòu dǎ yǔmáoqiú, wǒ bù dài shǒujī!
turns.en: Don't worry! From now on, no phone when I play badminton!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 喂，您好，陈家饺子。
turns.pinyin: wèi, nín hǎo, Chénjiājiǎozi.
turns.en: Hello, Chen Family Dumplings.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 您好！请问，陈明在吗？
turns.pinyin: nín hǎo! qǐngwèn, Chénmíng zài ma?
turns.en: Hello! Is Chen Ming there, please?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 他不在，去超市了。请问您是哪位？
turns.pinyin: tā bù zài, qù chāoshì le. qǐngwèn nín shì nǎwèi?
turns.en: He's not in, he's gone to the supermarket. Who's calling, please?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我是他朋友马克。我打他的手机，没人接。
turns.pinyin: wǒ shì tā péngyou Mǎkè. wǒ dǎ tā de shǒujī, méi rén jiē.
turns.en: I'm his friend Mark. I tried his mobile, but no one answered.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 啊，是马克啊！他可能没听到。你一会儿再打吧。
turns.pinyin: a, shì Mǎkè a! tā kěnéng méi tīngdào. nǐ yīhuìr zài dǎ ba.
turns.en: Oh, Mark, it's you! He probably didn't hear it. Try again in a bit.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 喂？
turns.pinyin: wèi?
turns.en: Hello?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 喂，陈明吗？我是马克！
turns.pinyin: wèi, Chénmíng ma? wǒ shì Mǎkè!
turns.en: Hello, Chen Ming? It's Mark!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 陈明？小伙子，你打错了！……哈哈，是我，朵朵！
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng? xiǎohuǒzi, nǐ dǎcuò le! hāhā, shì wǒ, Duǒduo!
turns.en: Chen Ming? Young man, you've got the wrong number! ...Ha ha, it's me, Duoduo!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 啊，朵朵！你爸爸呢？
turns.pinyin: a, Duǒduo! nǐ bàba ne?
turns.en: Oh, Duoduo! Where's your dad?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 喂，马克！你找我？
turns.pinyin: wèi, Mǎkè! nǐ zhǎo wǒ?
turns.en: Hello, Mark! You were after me?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对！这个星期六你有空吗？我想跟你一起去打羽毛球。
turns.pinyin: duì! zhège xīngqī liù nǐ yǒukòng ma? wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yīqǐ qù dǎ yǔmáoqiú.
turns.en: Yes! Are you free this Saturday? I'd like to go and play badminton with you.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 好啊！叫上小雨，朵朵也想去，我们四个人一起打！
turns.pinyin: hǎo a! jiàoshang Xiǎoyǔ, Duǒduo yě xiǎng qù, wǒmen sì gè rén yīqǐ dǎ!
turns.en: Sure! Get Xiaoyu along. Duoduo wants to come too, so the four of us can play together!

dialogues.title: I'd like to book a badminton court

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 喂，您好，华人中心。
turns.pinyin: wèi, nín hǎo, Huárénzhōngxīn.
turns.en: Hello, the Chinese Centre.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 您好！我想预订一个羽毛球场。
turns.pinyin: nín hǎo! wǒ xiǎng yùdìng yī gè yǔmáoqiú chǎng.
turns.en: Hello! I'd like to book a badminton court.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 好的。哪天？几点？
turns.pinyin: hǎode. nǎ tiān? jǐ diǎn?
turns.en: Certainly. Which day, and what time?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这个星期六上午，十点到十二点。
turns.pinyin: zhège xīngqī liù shàngwǔ, shí diǎn dào shí èr diǎn.
turns.en: This Saturday morning, ten till twelve.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 对不起，星期六上午已经没有场了。下午两点到四点可以吗？
turns.pinyin: duìbuqǐ, xīngqī liù shàngwǔ yǐjīng méiyǒu chǎng le. xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn dào sì diǎn kěyǐ ma?
turns.en: Sorry, there are no courts left on Saturday morning. Would two till four in the afternoon be OK?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可以。多少钱一个小时？
turns.pinyin: kěyǐ. duōshǎoqián yī gè xiǎoshí?
turns.en: That's fine. How much is it an hour?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 十二块。我们还有乒乓球桌，要不要也订一张？
turns.pinyin: shí èr kuài. wǒmen hái yǒu pīngpāngqiúzhuō, yào bù yào yě dìng yī zhāng?
turns.en: Twelve pounds. We've got table-tennis tables too. Would you like to book one of those as well?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好啊！我朋友是北京人，很会打乒乓球。
turns.pinyin: hǎo a! wǒ péngyou shì běijīng rén, hěnhuì dǎ pīngpāngqiú.
turns.en: Yes, please! My friend's from Beijing, and he's really good at table tennis.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 好的。您贵姓？
turns.pinyin: hǎode. nín guì xìng?
turns.en: Fine. Can I take your name?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我姓 Smith，叫马克。电话是零七七零零，九零零，二三八。
turns.pinyin: wǒ xìngSmith, jiào Mǎkè. diànhuà shì líng qīqī línglíng, jiǔ línglíng, èr sānbā.
turns.en: Smith, Mark Smith. My number's 07700 900 238.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克？哈哈，是我，陈明的爸爸！好，星期六下午两点，一个羽毛球场，一张乒乓球桌。到时候见！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè? hāhā, shì wǒ, Chénmíng de bàba! hǎo, xīngqī liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, yī gè yǔmáoqiú chǎng, yī zhāng pīngpāngqiúzhuō. dàoshíhou jiàn!
turns.en: Mark? Ha ha, it's me, Chen Ming's dad! Right: Saturday at two, one badminton court and one table-tennis table. See you then!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 是您啊！谢谢！再见！
turns.pinyin: shì nín a! xièxie! zàijiàn!
turns.en: Oh, it's you! Thanks! Bye!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 喂，马克，早！昨天晚上小雨的演出怎么样？
turns.pinyin: wèi, Mǎkè, zǎo! zuótiān wǎnshang Xiǎoyǔ de yǎnchū zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: Hi Mark, morning! How was Xiaoyu's show last night?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 挺好的！你没来，太可惜了。
turns.pinyin: tǐng hǎode! nǐ méi lái, tài kěxī le.
turns.en: It was great! Such a shame you couldn't come.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 没办法，星期六饭馆太忙了。人多吗？
turns.pinyin: méi bànfǎ, xīngqī liù fànguǎn tài máng le. rén duō ma?
turns.en: It couldn't be helped. Saturdays are too busy at the restaurant. Were there lots of people?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 挺多的，咖啡店里差不多有五十个人。
turns.pinyin: tǐng duō de, kāfēidiàn lǐ chàbuduō yǒu wǔ shí gè rén.
turns.en: Quite a lot. There were about fifty people in the café.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 小雨唱了几首歌？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ chàng le jǐ shǒu gē?
turns.en: How many songs did Xiaoyu sing?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 她一共唱了六首，还弹了吉他。最后她还用四川话唱了一首！
turns.pinyin: tā yīgòng chàng le liù shǒu, hái tán le jítā. zuìhòu tā hái yòng sìchuānhuà chàng le yī shǒu!
turns.en: Six altogether, and she played the guitar. And at the end she sang one in Sichuanese!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 她紧张吗？
turns.pinyin: tā jǐnzhāng ma?
turns.en: Was she nervous?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 开始的时候有点儿紧张，后来就好了。
turns.pinyin: kāishǐ de shíhou yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng, hòulái jiù hǎole.
turns.en: A bit at the start, but she was fine after that.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你觉得哪首最好听？
turns.pinyin: nǐ juéde nǎ shǒu zuì hǎotīng?
turns.en: Which one did you like best?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我觉得四川话的那首最好听。我一句也没听懂，可是真好听！
turns.pinyin: wǒ juéde sìchuānhuà de nà shǒu zuì hǎotīng. wǒ yī jù yě méi tīngdǒng, kěshì zhēn hǎotīng!
turns.en: I thought the Sichuanese one was the best. I didn't understand a word, but it was lovely!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 哈哈。那个咖啡店怎么样？
turns.pinyin: hāhā. nàge kāfēidiàn zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: Ha ha. What was the café like?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 还可以吧。咖啡挺好喝的，蛋糕一般。
turns.pinyin: háikěyǐ ba. kāfēi tǐng hǎohē de, dàngāo yībān.
turns.en: It was OK. The coffee was pretty good, the cake was so-so.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，昨天谢谢你来！你觉得怎么样？说真的！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, zuótiān xièxie nǐ lái! nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng? shuōzhēnde!
turns.en: Mark, thanks for coming yesterday! What did you think? Be honest!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说真的，挺好的！你的新歌特别好听。
turns.pinyin: shuōzhēnde, tǐng hǎode! nǐ de xīn gē tèbié hǎotīng.
turns.en: Honestly, it was great! Your new song was really lovely.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 真的吗？其实我太紧张了，第二首还唱错了一句。
turns.pinyin: zhēnde ma? qíshí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, dì èr shǒu hái chàng cuò le yī jù.
turns.en: Really? Actually I was far too nervous. I even got a line wrong in the second song.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 是吗？我们都不知道！大家都觉得很好。
turns.pinyin: shì ma? wǒmen dōu bù zhīdào! dàjiā dōu juéde hěn hǎo.
turns.en: Did you? None of us noticed! Everyone thought it was great.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 朵朵和陈爸爸觉得怎么样？
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo hé Chénbàba juéde zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: What did Duoduo and Uncle Chen think?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈爸爸拍了很多照片，朵朵一直说“太棒了”！
turns.pinyin: Chénbàba pāi le hěnduō zhàopiàn, Duǒduo yīzhí shuō tài bàng le!
turns.en: Uncle Chen took loads of photos, and Duoduo kept saying 'brilliant'!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈。那你呢？你最喜欢哪首？
turns.pinyin: hāhā. nà nǐ ne? nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎ shǒu?
turns.en: Ha ha. And you? Which one did you like best?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 四川话的那首！你能教我唱吗？
turns.pinyin: sìchuānhuà de nà shǒu! nǐ néng jiāo wǒ chàng ma?
turns.en: The Sichuanese one! Could you teach me to sing it?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 四川话很难啊！
turns.pinyin: sìchuānhuà hěn nán a!
turns.en: Sichuanese is hard, you know!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 没关系，我慢慢学。对了，你下次什么时候演出？
turns.pinyin: méiguānxi, wǒ mànmàn xué. duìle, nǐ xià cì shénmeshíhou yǎnchū?
turns.en: Never mind, I'll learn it bit by bit. Oh, by the way, when are you performing next?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 下个月，还在那个咖啡店。
turns.pinyin: xià gè yuè, hái zài nàge kāfēidiàn.
turns.en: Next month, at the same café.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 太好了！这次我叫上陈明，我们一起去！
turns.pinyin: tàihǎole! zhè cì wǒ jiàoshang Chénmíng, wǒmen yīqǐ qù!
turns.en: Great! This time I'll get Chen Ming along, and we'll all go!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好香啊！你在做什么？
turns.pinyin: hǎo xiāng a! nǐ zài zuò shénme?
turns.en: Something smells good! What are you making?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 烤鸡。在英国，很多人星期天中午吃烤鸡。
turns.pinyin: kǎojī. zài yīngguó, hěnduō rén xīngqītiān zhōngwǔ chī kǎojī.
turns.en: Roast chicken. In Britain lots of people have roast chicken for Sunday lunch.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 可是今天是星期一啊！
turns.pinyin: kěshì jīntiān shì xīngqī yī a!
turns.en: But it's Monday!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 没关系，好吃就行！你帮我洗一下这些土豆吧。
turns.pinyin: méiguānxi, hǎochī jiù xíng! nǐ bāng wǒ xǐ yīxià zhèxiē tǔdòu ba.
turns.en: Doesn't matter, as long as it tastes good! Could you wash these potatoes for me?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好。……马克，你切菜切得真快啊！
turns.pinyin: hǎo. Mǎkè, nǐ qiē cài qiē de zhēn kuài a!
turns.en: Sure. ...Mark, you chop really fast!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哪里哪里。我做饭做得一般，只会做几个英国菜。
turns.pinyin: nǎlǐnǎlǐ. wǒ zuòfàn zuò de yībān, zhǐ huì zuò jǐ gè yīngguó cài.
turns.en: Oh, not really. I'm not much of a cook. I can only make a few British dishes.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那这是什么？西红柿炒鸡蛋？你还会做中国菜！
turns.pinyin: nà zhè shì shénme? xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn? nǐ hái huì zuò zhōngguó cài!
turns.en: Then what's this? Tomato and egg? You can cook Chinese food too!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 上个月陈明教了我。他说这个菜最简单。
turns.pinyin: shàng gè yuè Chénmíng jiāo le wǒ. tā shuō zhège cài zuì jiǎndān.
turns.en: Chen Ming taught me last month. He says it's the easiest dish there is.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥做菜做得特别好。你跟他学，一定越来越好！
turns.pinyin: biǎogē zuòcài zuò de tèbié hǎo. nǐ gēn tā xué, yīdìng yuèláiyuè hǎo!
turns.en: My cousin's a brilliant cook. Learn from him and you'll keep getting better!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 希望吧！……有人来了，一定是陈明！
turns.pinyin: xīwàng ba! yǒu rén lái le, yīdìng shì Chénmíng!
turns.en: I hope so! ...Someone's here. That'll be Chen Ming!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 不错！西红柿炒鸡蛋炒得很好。马克，你学得真快！
turns.pinyin: bùcuò! xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn chǎo de hěn hǎo. Mǎkè, nǐ xué de zhēn kuài!
turns.en: Not bad! You've done the tomato and egg really well. Mark, you learn fast!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哪里哪里，是老师教得好！
turns.pinyin: nǎlǐnǎlǐ, shì lǎoshī jiāo de hǎo!
turns.en: Oh, not at all. It's all down to a good teacher!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 烤鸡也特别好吃！马克，你是设计师还是厨师啊？
turns.pinyin: kǎojī yě tèbié hǎochī! Mǎkè, nǐ shì shèjìshī háishi chúshī a?
turns.en: The roast chicken's delicious too! Mark, are you a designer or a chef?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 土豆也烤得很香。英国菜不错啊！
turns.pinyin: tǔdòu yě kǎo de hěn xiāng. yīngguó cài bùcuò a!
turns.en: The potatoes are lovely too. British food's not bad at all!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 谢谢！多吃点儿，还有很多！
turns.pinyin: xièxie! duō chī diǎnr, hái yǒu hěnduō!
turns.en: Thanks! Have some more, there's plenty!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克，你的中文也越来越好了，说得又快又清楚。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ de zhōngwén yě yuèláiyuè hǎole, shuō de yòu kuài yòu qīngchu.
turns.en: Mark, your Chinese is getting better and better too. You speak so fast and clearly.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哪里哪里，还差得远呢！
turns.pinyin: nǎlǐnǎlǐ, hái chàdeyuǎn ne!
turns.en: Oh, not really, I've still got a long way to go!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 别客气，你真的进步了很多。去年九月，你只会说“你好”！
turns.pinyin: bié kèqi, nǐ zhēnde jìnbù le hěnduō. qùnián jiǔ yuè, nǐ zhǐ huì shuō nǐhǎo!
turns.en: Don't be so modest, you really have come on a lot. Last September all you could say was 'nǐ hǎo'!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 现在他还会说“哪里哪里”了！
turns.pinyin: xiànzài tā hái huì shuō nǎlǐnǎlǐ le!
turns.en: And now he can say 'nǎlǐ nǎlǐ' too!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 哈哈！
turns.pinyin: hāhā!
turns.en: Ha ha!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 来，干杯！谢谢大家教我中文！
turns.pinyin: lái, gānbēi! xièxie dàjiā jiāo wǒ zhōngwén!
turns.en: Come on, cheers! Thanks, everyone, for teaching me Chinese!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 干杯！
turns.pinyin: gānbēi!
turns.en: Cheers!

dialogues.title: The train leaves at half past eight!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 喂，马克，你在哪儿？火车八点半开，现在已经八点二十了！
turns.pinyin: wèi, Mǎkè, nǐ zài nǎr? huǒchē bā diǎn bàn kāi, xiànzài yǐjīng bā diǎn èrshí le!
turns.en: Hello, Mark, where are you? The train leaves at half past eight, and it's already twenty past!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对不起！我起晚了，刚出门。
turns.pinyin: duìbuqǐ! wǒ qǐwǎn le, gāng chūmén.
turns.en: Sorry! I overslept. I've only just left the house.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 什么？我和表哥七点半就到了！
turns.pinyin: shénme? wǒ hé biǎogē qī diǎn bàn jiù dào le!
turns.en: What? My cousin and I have been here since half past seven!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 你们怎么那么早？
turns.pinyin: nǐmen zěnme nàme zǎo?
turns.en: Why so early?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我每天六点就起床，去市场买菜。你今天几点起床？
turns.pinyin: wǒ měitiān liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng, qù shìchǎng mǎi cài. nǐ jīntiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
turns.en: I get up at six every day to buy vegetables at the market. What time did you get up today?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我的闹钟坏了，八点才醒。我一醒就出门了，早饭也没吃。
turns.pinyin: wǒ de nàozhōng huài le, bā diǎn cái xǐng. wǒ yī xǐng jiù chūmén le, zǎofàn yě méi chī.
turns.en: My alarm clock's broken, and I didn't wake up till eight. I left the moment I woke up. I didn't even have breakfast.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 从你家到这儿要多长时间？
turns.pinyin: cóng nǐ jiā dào zhèr yào duōchángshíjiān?
turns.en: How long does it take from your place to here?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 坐地铁要半个小时。
turns.pinyin: zuò dìtiě yào bàn gè xiǎoshí.
turns.en: Half an hour on the Tube.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那你九点才能到，肯定来不及了。火车早就开了！
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ jiǔ diǎn cái néng dào, kěndìng láibují le. huǒchē zǎojiù kāi le!
turns.en: Then you won't get here till nine. You definitely won't make it. The train will be long gone!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 没办法。我们坐下一班吧。下一班几点？
turns.pinyin: méi bànfǎ. wǒmen zuò xia yī bān ba. xià yī bān jǐ diǎn?
turns.en: Oh well. Let's get the next one. What time's the next one?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我看看……九点半有一班。马克，你九点一刻以前一定要到！
turns.pinyin: wǒ kàn kan jiǔ diǎn bàn yǒu yī bān. Mǎkè, nǐ jiǔ diǎn yī kè yǐqián yīdìng yào dào!
turns.en: Let me see... There's one at half past nine. Mark, make sure you're here by quarter past nine!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，我一定到！
turns.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ yīdìng dào!
turns.en: OK, I'll be there!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我来了！对不起，对不起！
turns.pinyin: wǒ lái le! duìbuqǐ, duìbuqǐ!
turns.en: I'm here! Sorry, sorry!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你怎么才来？我们等了你一个多小时！
turns.pinyin: nǐ zěnme cái lái? wǒmen děng le nǐ yī gè duō xiǎoshí!
turns.en: What took you so long? We've been waiting for you for over an hour!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 今天地铁上人特别多，我等了二十分钟才上车。
turns.pinyin: jīntiān dìtiě shang rén tèbié duō, wǒ děng le èr shí fēnzhōng cái shàngchē.
turns.en: The Tube was packed today. I waited twenty minutes before I could get on.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你上次也迟到了。
turns.pinyin: nǐ shàng cì yě chídào le.
turns.en: You were late last time too.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对！上上个星期看电影，你迟到了半个小时。前天吃饭，你也来晚了！
turns.pinyin: duì! shàngshànggexīngqī kàn diànyǐng, nǐ chídào le bàn gè xiǎoshí. qiántiān chīfàn, nǐ yě lái wǎn le!
turns.en: Yes! When we went to the cinema the week before last, you were half an hour late. And you were late for dinner the day before yesterday!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 前天不是我的问题，是公交车晚点了！
turns.pinyin: qiántiān bù shì wǒ de wèntí, shì gōngjiāochē wǎndiǎn le!
turns.en: That wasn't my fault! The bus was late!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 好了好了。火车来了，快上车吧！
turns.pinyin: hǎole hǎole. huǒchē lái le, kuài shàngchē ba!
turns.en: All right, all right. Here's the train. Come on, let's get on!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，大后天是朵朵的生日，我们晚上七点在“老成都”吃饭。你别再迟到了！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, dàhòutiān shì Duǒduo de shēngrì, wǒmen wǎnshang qī diǎn zài Lǎochéngdū chīfàn. nǐ bié zài chídào le!
turns.en: Mark, it's Duoduo's birthday on Thursday. We're having dinner at Old Chengdu at seven. Don't be late again!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 放心！那天我一下班就去，一定第一个到！
turns.pinyin: fàngxīn! nà tiān wǒ yī xiàbān jiù qù, yīdìng dì yī gè dào!
turns.en: Don't worry! I'll go straight from work, and I'll be the first one there!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你第一个到？太阳从西边出来了！
turns.pinyin: nǐ dì yī gè dào? tàiyáng cóng xībiān chūlai le!
turns.en: You, first? Pigs might fly!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈！马克，我们在“老成都”等你！
turns.pinyin: hāhā! Mǎkè, wǒmen zài Lǎochéngdū děng nǐ!
turns.en: Ha ha! Mark, we'll be waiting for you at Old Chengdu!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，你下个星期就回成都了？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ xià gè xīngqī jiù huí chéngdū le?
turns.en: Xiaoyu, so you're going back to Chengdu next week?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对，下个星期六的飞机。暑假我在家待两个多月，九月底才回来。
turns.pinyin: duì, xià gè xīngqī liù de fēijī. shǔjià wǒ zài jiā dāi liǎng gè duō yuè, jiǔ yuè dǐ cái huí lai.
turns.en: Yes, my flight's next Saturday. I'm staying at home for over two months this summer, and I won't be back till the end of September.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 两个多月！那么长时间，我们会想你的。
turns.pinyin: liǎng gè duō yuè! nàme cháng shíjiān, wǒmen huì xiǎng nǐ de.
turns.en: Over two months! That's ages. We'll miss you.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我也会想你们的！你可以给我发微信，也可以给我写邮件。用中文写！
turns.pinyin: wǒ yě huì xiǎng nǐmen de! nǐ kěyǐ gěi wǒ fā wēixìn, yě kěyǐ gěi wǒ xiě yóujiàn. yòng zhōngwén xiě!
turns.en: I'll miss you all too! You can send me WeChat messages, or write me emails. In Chinese!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 用中文写邮件？我怕我写得不好。
turns.pinyin: yòng zhōngwén xiě yóujiàn? wǒ pà wǒ xiě de bù hǎo.
turns.en: Emails in Chinese? I'm worried my writing won't be good enough.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 没关系，写错了我帮你改。
turns.pinyin: méiguānxi, xiě cuò le wǒ bāng nǐ gǎi.
turns.en: Never mind. If you get something wrong, I'll correct it for you.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，那我试试。
turns.pinyin: hǎo, nà wǒ shì shi.
turns.en: OK, I'll give it a go.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 还有，你每天用中文写几句日记吧。写日记是学中文的好办法！
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu, nǐ měitiān yòng zhōngwén xiě jǐ jù rìjì ba. xiě rìjì shì xué zhōngwén de hǎo bànfǎ!
turns.en: And write a few lines of diary in Chinese every day. Keeping a diary is a great way to learn!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 每天都写？我上班那么忙……
turns.pinyin: měitiān dōu xiě? wǒ shàngbān nàme máng
turns.en: Every day? I'm so busy at work...

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 不用写很多，三四句就行：今天做了什么，吃了什么，觉得怎么样。
turns.pinyin: bùyòng xiě hěnduō, sān sì jù jiù xíng: jīntiān zuò le shénme, chī le shénme, juéde zěnmeyàng.
turns.en: You don't need to write much. Three or four sentences will do: what you did today, what you ate, how you felt.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，从今天开始！第一句：“今天小雨给我留了作业。”
turns.pinyin: hǎo, cóng jīntiān kāishǐ! dì yī jù: jīntiān Xiǎoyǔ gěi wǒ liú le zuòyè.
turns.en: OK, starting today! Sentence one: 'Today Xiaoyu gave me homework.'

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，写得不错！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, xiě de bùcuò!
turns.en: Ha ha, nicely written!

dialogues.title: Where are you going to stay?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，机票订好了，酒店呢？你打算在成都待几天？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, jīpiào dìnghǎo le, jiǔdiàn ne? nǐ dǎsuàn zài chéngdū dài jǐ tiān?
turns.en: Mark, you've booked your flights. What about hotels? How many days are you planning to stay in Chengdu?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我打算先在成都待九天，十九号再去北京，在北京住五晚，二十四号回伦敦。
turns.pinyin: wǒ dǎsuàn xiān zài chéngdū dài jiǔ tiān, shí jiǔ hào zài qù běijīng, zài běijīng zhù wǔ wǎn, èrshísì hào huí lúndūn.
turns.en: I'm planning nine days in Chengdu first, then Beijing on the nineteenth. Five nights in Beijing, and back to London on the twenty-fourth.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我爸妈说，你别订酒店了，就住我们家！
turns.pinyin: wǒ bàmā shuō, nǐ bié dìng jiǔdiàn le, jiù zhù wǒmen jiā!
turns.en: My mum and dad say don't book a hotel, just stay with us!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 谢谢叔叔阿姨！不过陈明的爸爸妈妈也住你们家，太麻烦你们了。我还是住酒店吧，离你们家近一点儿就行。
turns.pinyin: xièxie shūshu āyí! bùguò Chénmíng de bàba māma yě zhù nǐmen jiā, tài máfan nǐmen le. wǒ háishi zhù jiǔdiàn ba, lí nǐmen jiā jìn yīdiǎnr jiù xíng.
turns.en: That's so kind of them! But Chen Ming's mum and dad are staying with you too. It's too much trouble for you. I'd better stay in a hotel. Somewhere near your place would be great.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那好吧，我帮你找一家。天府广场附近的酒店又方便又不贵，坐地铁到我家只要半个小时。
turns.pinyin: nà hǎo ba, wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo yī jiā. Tiānfǔguǎngchǎng fùjìn de jiǔdiàn yòu fāngbiàn yòu bù guì, zuò dìtiě dào wǒ jiā zhǐ yào bàn gè xiǎoshí.
turns.en: All right then, I'll find you one. Hotels near Tianfu Square are handy and not expensive, and it's only half an hour to ours on the metro.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 北京呢？你打算住哪儿？
turns.pinyin: běijīng ne? nǐ dǎsuàn zhù nǎr?
turns.en: What about Beijing? Where are you going to stay?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 还没想好。你是北京人，你说呢？
turns.pinyin: hái méi xiǎng hǎo. nǐ shì běijīng rén, nǐ shuō ne?
turns.en: I haven't decided yet. You're from Beijing. What do you think?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 住胡同里吧！现在很多老四合院都改成了小酒店，特别有老北京的感觉。
turns.pinyin: zhù hútòng lǐ ba! xiànzài hěnduō lǎo sìhéyuàn dōu gǎi chéng le xiǎo jiǔdiàn, tèbié yǒu lǎo běijīng de gǎnjué.
turns.en: Stay in a hutong! Lots of old courtyard houses have been turned into little hotels now. They really feel like old Beijing.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好主意！贵不贵？
turns.pinyin: hǎozhǔyi! guì bù guì?
turns.en: Good idea! Are they expensive?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 有贵的，也有便宜的。一晚四五百块的就挺好。我爸妈过了中秋节也回北京，有问题就找他们。
turns.pinyin: yǒu guì de, yě yǒu piányi de. yī wǎn sì wǔ bǎi kuài de jiù tǐng hǎo. wǒ bàmā guò le zhōngqiūjié yě huí běijīng, yǒu wèntí jiù zhǎo tāmen.
turns.en: Some are, some aren't. One at four or five hundred yuan a night will be fine. My mum and dad are going back to Beijing after Mid-Autumn too, so if you need anything, ask them.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，我明天就打电话预订。
turns.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ míngtiān jiù dǎdiànhuà yùdìng.
turns.en: OK, I'll ring and book tomorrow.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 对了，到了北京，别忘了……
turns.pinyin: duìle, dào le běijīng, bié wàng le
turns.en: Oh, and when you get to Beijing, don't forget...

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 知道知道，一定要吃烤鸭！你已经说了一百遍了！
turns.pinyin: zhīdào zhīdào, yīdìng yào chī kǎoyā! nǐ yǐjīng shuō le yī bǎi biàn le!
turns.en: I know, I know: I have to eat roast duck! You've told me a hundred times!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，表哥就是这样！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, biǎogē jiùshì zhèyàng!
turns.en: Ha ha, that's my cousin for you!

dialogues.title: I'd like to book a room

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 您好，小院酒店。
turns.pinyin: nín hǎo, Xiǎoyuànjiǔdiàn.
turns.en: Hello, Courtyard Hotel.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 您好！我想预订一个房间，九月十九号入住，住五晚。
turns.pinyin: nín hǎo! wǒ xiǎng yùdìng yī gè fángjiān, jiǔ yuè shí jiǔ hào rùzhù, zhù wǔ wǎn.
turns.en: Hello! I'd like to book a room, checking in on the nineteenth of September, for five nights.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 好的，十九号到二十四号，五个晚上。请问几位？
turns.pinyin: hǎode, shí jiǔ hào dào èrshísì hào, wǔ gè wǎnshang. qǐngwèn jǐ wèi?
turns.en: Certainly: the nineteenth to the twenty-fourth, five nights. For how many people?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 就我一个人。
turns.pinyin: jiù wǒ yī gè rén.
turns.en: Just me.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 您要单人间、双人间，还是大床房？
turns.pinyin: nín yào dānrénjiān, shuāngrénjiān, háishi dàchuángfáng?
turns.en: Would you like a single room, a twin room, or a double?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 双人间跟大床房有什么不一样？
turns.pinyin: shuāngrénjiān gēn dàchuángfáng yǒu shénme bù yīyàng?
turns.en: What's the difference between a twin and a double?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 双人间有两张单人床，大床房是一张大床。大床房四百八一晚，窗户外面就是院子，很安静。
turns.pinyin: shuāngrénjiān yǒu liǎng zhāng dānrénchuáng, dàchuángfáng shì yī zhāng dà chuáng. dàchuángfáng sìbǎi bāyī wǎn, chuānghu wàimiàn jiùshì yuànzi, hěn ānjìng.
turns.en: A twin has two single beds, and a double has one big bed. The double is four hundred and eighty a night. It looks straight out onto the courtyard, and it's very quiet.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我要大床房。房费包括早餐吗？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ yào dàchuángfáng. fángfèi bāokuò zǎocān ma?
turns.en: Then I'll have the double. Does the rate include breakfast?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 包括。早餐是北京小吃，豆浆、油条、包子都有，七点到十点在一楼餐厅。
turns.pinyin: bāokuò. zǎocān shì běijīng xiǎochī, dòujiāng, yóutiáo, bāozi dōu yǒu, qī diǎn dào shí diǎn zài yī lóu cāntīng.
turns.en: It does. Breakfast is Beijing street food: soya milk, fried dough sticks, steamed buns. It's from seven to ten in the ground-floor dining room.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 太好了！请问几点可以入住？我的航班晚上九点才到。
turns.pinyin: tàihǎole! qǐngwèn jǐ diǎn kěyǐ rùzhù? wǒ de hángbān wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn cái dào.
turns.en: Great! What time can I check in? My flight doesn't get in till nine in the evening.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 两点以后都可以，前台二十四小时有人。入住的时候请带好护照，还要交五百块押金，退房的时候退给您。
turns.pinyin: liǎng diǎn yǐhòu dōu kěyǐ, qiántái èrshísì xiǎoshí yǒu rén. rùzhù de shíhou qǐng dàihǎo hùzhào, hái yào jiāo wǔ bǎi kuài yājīn, tuìfáng de shíhou tuì gěi nín.
turns.en: Any time after two. There's someone on reception twenty-four hours a day. Please bring your passport when you check in. There's also a five-hundred-yuan deposit, which we give back when you check out.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好的。我叫马克，姓 Smith。退房是几点？
turns.pinyin: hǎode. wǒ jiào Mǎkè, xìngSmith. tuìfáng shì jǐ diǎn?
turns.en: Fine. My name's Mark Smith. What time is check-out?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 中午十二点以前。马克先生，已经给您订好了，一会儿我们给您发确认短信。……哈哈，你说得很好！现在给酒店打电话吧。
turns.pinyin: zhōngwǔ shí èr diǎn yǐqián. Mǎkè xiānsheng, yǐjīng gěi nín dìnghǎo le, yīhuìr wǒmen gěi nín fā quèrèn duǎnxìn. hāhā, nǐ shuō de hěn hǎo! xiànzài gěi jiǔdiàn dǎdiànhuà ba.
turns.en: Before twelve noon. Mr Smith, you're all booked. We'll send you a confirmation text in a moment. ...Ha ha, you did really well! Now ring the hotel.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，去动物园站怎么坐？
turns.pinyin: shūshu, qù dòngwùyuán zhàn zěnme zuò?
turns.en: How do we get to Zoo station?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我早上就是坐地铁来的。先坐二号线，坐一站，到春熙路换乘三号线。
turns.pinyin: wǒ zǎoshang jiùshì zuò dìtiě lái de. xiān zuò èr hàoxiàn, zuò yī zhàn, dào Chūnxīlù huànchéng sān hàoxiàn.
turns.en: I came by metro this morning. Take Line 2 one stop to Chunxi Road, and change to Line 3 there.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 换乘要出站吗？
turns.pinyin: huànchéng yào chūzhàn ma?
turns.en: Do we have to go out through the gates to change?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 不用出站。早上我问了工作人员，下车以后，跟着三号线的牌子走就行。
turns.pinyin: bùyòng chūzhàn. zǎoshang wǒ wèn le gōngzuòrényuán, xiàchē yǐhòu, gēnzhe sān hàoxiàn de páizi zǒu jiù xíng.
turns.en: No, we don't. I asked a member of staff this morning. When you get off, just follow the signs for Line 3.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好。我没有地铁卡，可以用手机吗？
turns.pinyin: hǎo. wǒ méiyǒu dìtiěkǎ, kěyǐ yòng shǒujī ma?
turns.en: OK. I haven't got a metro card. Can I use my phone?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 可以，扫码进站。换三号线的时候要看好方向，别坐反了！早上我就坐反了。
turns.pinyin: kěyǐ, sǎomǎ jìnzhàn. huàn sān hàoxiàn de shíhou yào kànhǎo fāngxiàng, bié zuòfǎn le! zǎoshang wǒ jiù zuòfǎn le.
turns.en: Yes, scan the code to get in. When we change to Line 3, check the direction carefully. Don't go the wrong way! I did this morning.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，那今天我来看方向！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, nà jīntiān wǒ lái kàn fāngxiàng!
turns.en: Ha ha, then I'll check the direction today!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 喂，马克，你们到哪儿了？
turns.pinyin: wèi, Mǎkè, nǐmen dào nǎr le?
turns.en: Hi, Mark, where have you two got to?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我们刚在春熙路换乘了。春熙路我去过，前天我在那儿买了一件衬衫。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen gāng zài Chūnxīlù huànchéng le. Chūnxīlù wǒ qù guo, qiántiān wǒ zài nàr mǎi le yī jiàn chènshān.
turns.en: We've just changed at Chunxi Road. I know Chunxi Road: I bought a shirt there the day before yesterday.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你已经是半个成都人了！从春熙路坐到动物园，差不多六站，二十分钟左右。
turns.pinyin: nǐ yǐjīng shì bàn gè chéngdū rén le! cóng Chūnxīlù zuò dào dòngwùyuán, chàbuduō liù zhàn, èr shí fēnzhōng zuǒyòu.
turns.en: You're half a Chengdu local already! From Chunxi Road to the Zoo it's about six stops, around twenty minutes.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 出站以后呢？
turns.pinyin: chūzhàn yǐhòu ne?
turns.en: And when we come out of the station?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你们从B口出来，我在出口等你们。对了，月饼你别买了，我妈买了好多！
turns.pinyin: nǐmen cóngB kǒu chūlai, wǒ zài chūkǒu děng nǐmen. duìle, yuèbǐng nǐ bié mǎi le, wǒ mā mǎi le hǎoduō!
turns.en: Come out of Exit B, and I'll be waiting at the exit. Oh, and don't buy any mooncakes. My mum's bought loads!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 已经买了……一盒月饼，还有一盒英国茶。
turns.pinyin: yǐjīng mǎi le yī hé yuèbǐng, hái yǒu yī hé yīngguó chá.
turns.en: Too late... one box of mooncakes, and a box of English tea.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，那我爸肯定很高兴！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, nà wǒ bà kěndìng hěn gāoxìng!
turns.en: Ha ha, then my dad will be delighted!

dialogues.title: Don't be shy, have some more!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克来了！快进来，快进来！路上好找吗？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè lái le! kuài jìnlai, kuài jìnlai! lùshang hǎozhǎo ma?
turns.en: Mark's here! Come in, come in! Did you find us all right?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨好！很好找，地铁特别方便。这是我从伦敦带来的茶，给小雨爸妈的，一点儿小礼物。
turns.pinyin: āyí hǎo! hěn hǎozhǎo, dìtiě tèbié fāngbiàn. zhè shì wǒ cóng lúndūn dàilai de chá, gěi Xiǎoyǔ bàmā de, yīdiǎnr xiǎo lǐwù.
turns.en: Hello! It was easy, the metro's really handy. This is some tea I brought from London for Xiaoyu's mum and dad. Just a little present.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，来就来嘛，还带什么礼物！你太客气了。
turns.pinyin: āiyā, lái jiù lái ma, hái dài shénme lǐwù! nǐ tài kèqi le.
turns.en: Oh, you shouldn't have! Just coming is enough. That's too kind.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 快坐，菜都做好了。马克，辣的你能吃吗？
turns.pinyin: kuài zuò, cài dōu zuò hǎole. Mǎkè, là de nǐ néng chī ma?
turns.en: Sit down, the food's all ready. Mark, can you eat spicy food?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 能吃一点点。小雨说，她妈妈做的菜比陈明做的还辣！
turns.pinyin: néng chī yīdiǎndiǎn. Xiǎoyǔ shuō, tā māma zuò de cài bǐ Chénmíng zuò de hái là!
turns.en: A tiny bit. Xiaoyu says her mum's cooking is even hotter than Chen Ming's!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 放心，今天每个菜我妈都少放了辣椒。这个回锅肉你尝尝，是她的拿手菜，我最爱吃。
turns.pinyin: fàngxīn, jīntiān měi gè cài wǒ mā dōu shǎo fàng le làjiāo. zhège huíguōròu nǐ cháng cháng, shì tā de náshǒucài, wǒ zuì ài chī.
turns.en: Don't worry, Mum's gone easy on the chilli in every dish today. Try this twice-cooked pork. It's her speciality, and my favourite.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 太好吃了！一点儿也不辣。
turns.pinyin: tài hǎochī le! yīdiǎnr yěbù là.
turns.en: It's delicious! Not spicy at all.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 好吃就多吃点儿，别客气，就当在自己家！
turns.pinyin: hǎochī jiù duō chī diǎnr, bié kèqi, jiù dàng zài zìjǐ jiā!
turns.en: If you like it, have more. Don't be shy, make yourself at home!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你们别一直给他夹菜了，他的碗都满了！
turns.pinyin: nǐmen bié yīzhí gěi tā jiā cài le, tā de wǎn dōu mǎn le!
turns.en: Stop piling food on his plate, all of you! His bowl's already full!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 多吃点儿怕什么？你看他，太瘦了。
turns.pinyin: duō chī diǎnr pà shénme? nǐ kàn tā, tài shòu le.
turns.en: What's wrong with eating a bit more? Look at him, he's far too thin.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克，熊猫基地你去过没有？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, Xióngmāojīdì nǐ qù guo méiyǒu?
turns.en: Mark, have you been to the panda base?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 还没去过。小雨说后天带我去。
turns.pinyin: hái méi qù guo. Xiǎoyǔ shuō hòutiān dài wǒ qù.
turns.en: Not yet. Xiaoyu says she'll take me the day after tomorrow.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那得早点儿去。熊猫早上最精神，下午都在睡觉。
turns.pinyin: nà děi zǎo diǎnr qù. xióngmāo zǎoshang zuì jīngshen, xiàwǔ dōu zài shuìjiào.
turns.en: Then you'll have to go early. Pandas are at their liveliest in the morning. In the afternoon they're all asleep.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好了，先别说熊猫了。你们看，月亮出来了！
turns.pinyin: hǎole, xiān bié shuō xióngmāo le. nǐmen kàn, yuèliang chūlai le!
turns.en: All right, enough about pandas. Look, the moon's come out!

dialogues.title: Can I have it a size bigger?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，我十三号在这儿买了这件衬衫，可是太小了。你说能换吗？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, wǒ shí sān hào zài zhèr mǎi le zhè jiàn chènshān, kěshì tài xiǎo le. nǐ shuō néng huàn ma?
turns.en: Xiaoyu, I bought this shirt here on the thirteenth, but it's too small. Do you think I can change it?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 能。你看那个牌子：“欢迎光临！七天以内可以退换。”小票带了吗？
turns.pinyin: néng. nǐ kàn nàge páizi: huānyíngguānglín! qī tiān yǐnèi kěyǐ tuìhuàn. xiǎopiào dài le ma?
turns.en: Yes. Look at that sign: 'Welcome! Returns and exchanges within seven days.' Have you got the receipt?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 带了，在这儿。我在英国一直穿L号，没想到这儿的L号这么小。
turns.pinyin: dài le, zài zhèr. wǒ zài yīngguó yīzhí chuānL hào, méixiǎngdào zhèr deL hào zhème xiǎo.
turns.en: Yes, here it is. I've always been a large in Britain. I didn't expect a large here to be so small.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 中国的号比较小，你在这儿得穿XL，大一号。
turns.pinyin: zhōngguó de hào bǐjiào xiǎo, nǐ zài zhèr děi chuānXL, dàyīhào.
turns.en: Chinese sizes are on the small side. Here you'll need an XL, one size up.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我就说吧，你应该先试试再买！
turns.pinyin: wǒjiùshuōba, nǐ yīnggāi xiān shì shi zài mǎi!
turns.en: Told you so. You should have tried it on before you bought it!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那天试衣间门口人太多了，我不想排队。
turns.pinyin: nà tiān shìyījiān ménkǒu rén tài duōle, wǒ bù xiǎng páiduì.
turns.en: There were too many people outside the fitting rooms that day. I didn't want to queue.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你看，这件是XL的，跟你那件一样，也是蓝色的。试衣间在那边，快去试试。
turns.pinyin: nǐ kàn, zhè jiàn shìXL de, gēn nǐ nà jiàn yīyàng, yě shì lánsè de. shìyījiān zài nàbian, kuài qù shì shi.
turns.en: Look, this one's an XL. It's the same as yours, blue as well. The fitting rooms are over there. Go and try it on.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: ……这件大小正好，就是袖子有点儿长。
turns.pinyin: zhè jiàn dàxiǎo zhènghǎo, jiùshì xiùzi yǒudiǎnr cháng.
turns.en: ...This one's the right size. It's just that the sleeves are a bit long.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 挺好看的！现在流行穿大一点儿的。
turns.pinyin: tǐng hǎokàn de! xiànzài liúxíng chuān dà yīdiǎnr de.
turns.en: It looks good! Loose is in fashion at the moment.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，就换这件。要是回去以后觉得不合适，还能退吗？
turns.pinyin: hǎo, jiù huàn zhè jiàn. yàoshi huíqu yǐhòu juéde bù héshì, hái néng tuì ma?
turns.en: OK, I'll swap it for this one. If I decide it doesn't fit after all, can I still return it?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 能，七天以内都可以退换。不过小票别丢了。
turns.pinyin: néng, qī tiān yǐnèi dōu kěyǐ tuìhuàn. bùguò xiǎopiào bié diū le.
turns.en: Yes, you can return or exchange anything within seven days. But don't lose the receipt.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 小票给我吧，我帮你放好。
turns.pinyin: xiǎopiào gěi wǒ ba, wǒ bāng nǐ fàng hǎo.
turns.en: Give me the receipt. I'll look after it for you.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好的，谢谢阿姨！
turns.pinyin: hǎode, xièxie āyí!
turns.en: OK, thank you!

dialogues.title: You two look like father and son!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你看，你的衬衫……怎么跟马克的一样？
turns.pinyin: nǐ kàn, nǐ de chènshān zěnme gēn Mǎkè de yīyàng?
turns.en: Look, your shirt... how come it's the same as Mark's?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，真的！一模一样！马克，你这件在哪儿买的？
turns.pinyin: āiyā, zhēnde! yīmúyīyàng! Mǎkè, nǐ zhè jiàn zài nǎr mǎi de?
turns.en: Hey, so it is! Exactly the same! Mark, where did you get yours?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 春熙路。今天下午刚换的，大一号。
turns.pinyin: Chūnxīlù. jīntiān xiàwǔ gāng huàn de, dàyīhào.
turns.en: Chunxi Road. I only changed it this afternoon, for a size bigger.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我这件也是在春熙路买的！
turns.pinyin: wǒ zhè jiàn yě shì zài Chūnxīlù mǎi de!
turns.en: I got mine on Chunxi Road too!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，你们俩个子差不多，站在一起，像父子一样！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, nǐmen liǎ gèzi chàbuduō, zhàn zài yīqǐ, xiàng fùzǐ yīyàng!
turns.en: Ha ha, you two are about the same height. Standing together, you look like father and son!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我看不像父子，像兄弟。
turns.pinyin: wǒ kàn bù xiàng fùzǐ, xiàng xiōngdì.
turns.en: I don't think you look like father and son. More like brothers.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 还是小雨会说话！我要是有个女儿就好了。
turns.pinyin: háishi Xiǎoyǔ huìshuōhuà! wǒ yàoshi yǒu gè nǚ'ér jiù hǎole.
turns.en: Trust Xiaoyu to say the right thing! If only I had a daughter.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好了，先点菜吧。锅底要哪种？红锅还是鸳鸯锅？
turns.pinyin: hǎole, xiān diǎncài ba. guōdǐ yào nǎ zhǒng? hóngguō háishi yuānyangguō?
turns.en: All right, let's order. Which broth shall we have? Spicy, or the split pot?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 鸳鸯锅吧，一半红锅，一半清汤。马克吃清汤那边。
turns.pinyin: yuānyangguō ba, yībàn hóngguō, yībàn qīngtāng. Mǎkè chī qīngtāng nàbian.
turns.en: The split pot: half spicy, half clear. Mark can eat from the clear side.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克，来成都不吃红锅，跟没来一样！你尝一口，就一口。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, lái chéngdū bù chī hóngguō, gēn méi lái yīyàng! nǐ cháng yī kǒu, jiù yī kǒu.
turns.en: Mark, coming to Chengdu and not eating the spicy one is like not coming at all! Try a mouthful, just one.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好……哇，辣死了！水，水！
turns.pinyin: hǎo wa, là sǐ le! shuǐ, shuǐ!
turns.en: OK... Whoa, it's so hot! Water, water!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你怎么又这样！
turns.pinyin: nǐ zěnme yòu zhèyàng!
turns.en: Not again!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，辣了喝豆奶，豆奶比水好。服务员，来一瓶豆奶！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, là le hē dòunǎi, dòunǎi bǐ shuǐ hǎo. fúwùyuán, lái yī píng dòunǎi!
turns.en: Ha ha, when it's too hot, drink soya milk. It's better than water. Waiter, a bottle of soya milk, please!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克，这包东西你带上，在飞机上吃。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, zhè bāo dōngxi nǐ dàishang, zài fēijī shang chī.
turns.en: Mark, take this bag with you to eat on the plane.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨，又给我吃的！我的行李箱已经满了。
turns.pinyin: āyí, yòu gěi wǒ chī de! wǒ de xínglixiāng yǐjīng mǎn le.
turns.en: More food! My suitcase is already full.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 都是成都小吃，不辣的，放心吧。
turns.pinyin: dōu shì chéngdū xiǎochī, bù là de, fàngxīn ba.
turns.en: It's all Chengdu snacks, and none of it's spicy. Don't worry.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，这几天真是太麻烦你们了。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, zhè jǐ tiān zhēnshi tài máfan nǐmen le.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, I've put you all to so much trouble these last few days.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 麻烦什么！我爸妈说，你来了，我们家热闹多了。
turns.pinyin: máfan shénme! wǒ bàmā shuō, nǐ lái le, wǒmen jiā rènao duōle.
turns.en: Trouble? Nonsense! Mum and Dad say it's been much livelier with you here.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 你们对我这么好，让我觉得像在自己家一样。这是我最难忘的一个中秋节。
turns.pinyin: nǐmen duì wǒ zhème hǎo, ràng wǒ juéde xiàng zài zìjǐ jiā yīyàng. zhè shì wǒ zuì nánwàng de yī gè zhōngqiūjié.
turns.en: You've all been so good to me. You made me feel completely at home. It's the most unforgettable Mid-Autumn I've ever had.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我们都舍不得你走。以后一定要再来！
turns.pinyin: wǒmen dōu shěbude nǐ zǒu. yǐhòu yīdìng yào zài lái!
turns.en: We're all sad to see you go. You must come again!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 到了北京给我们发个微信，报个平安。
turns.pinyin: dào le běijīng gěi wǒmen fā gè wēixìn, bào gè píng'ān.
turns.en: Send us a message when you get to Beijing, so we know you're safe.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好。北京的酒店我已经订好了，就在一个胡同里。
turns.pinyin: hǎo. běijīng de jiǔdiàn wǒ yǐjīng dìnghǎo le, jiù zài yī gè hútòng lǐ.
turns.en: Will do. My hotel in Beijing's all booked. It's in a hutong.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 北京秋天最好，不冷不热。我们后天也回北京，到时候带你去吃烤鸭！
turns.pinyin: běijīng qiūtiān zuì hǎo, bùlěngbùrè. wǒmen hòutiān yě huí běijīng, dàoshíhou dài nǐ qù chī kǎoyā!
turns.en: Autumn's the best time in Beijing, not too hot, not too cold. We're going back the day after tomorrow too, and then we'll take you for roast duck!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 太好了！小雨，你什么时候回伦敦？
turns.pinyin: tàihǎole! Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ shénmeshíhou huí lúndūn?
turns.en: Great! Xiaoyu, when are you going back to London?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 过了生日就回，二十八号。伦敦见！多拍点儿照片给我看！
turns.pinyin: guò le shēngrì jiù huí, èrshíbā hào. lúndūn jiàn! duō pāi diǎnr zhàopiàn gěi wǒ kàn!
turns.en: Right after my birthday, on the twenty-eighth. See you in London! Take lots of photos to show me!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 一路平安！
turns.pinyin: yīlùpíng'ān!
turns.en: Have a safe trip!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，你来得正好！快帮我把这幅画挂上去。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ lái de zhènghǎo! kuài bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fú huà guà shangqu.
turns.en: Mark, perfect timing! Quick, help me hang this painting up.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 挂在哪儿？这面墙上吗？
turns.pinyin: guà zài nǎr? zhè miàn qiáng shang ma?
turns.en: Where does it go? On this wall?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对，挂在中间。……哎，有点儿低，再挂高一点儿。
turns.pinyin: duì, guà zài zhōngjiān. āi, yǒudiǎnr dī, zài guà gāo yīdiǎnr.
turns.en: Yes, in the middle. ...Hmm, it's a bit low. A bit higher.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这样呢？
turns.pinyin: zhèyàng ne?
turns.en: How's that?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好多了。不过有点儿歪，左边再往上一点儿……好，别动！
turns.pinyin: hǎoduō le. bùguò yǒudiǎnr wāi, zuǒbian zài wǎng shàng yīdiǎnr hǎo, bié dòng!
turns.en: Much better. But it's a bit crooked. The left side up a bit more... that's it, don't move!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 你们学设计的都这么认真吗？
turns.pinyin: nǐmen xué shèjì de dōu zhème rènzhēn ma?
turns.en: Are all you design students this fussy?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这是我的毕业展啊，当然要认真！地上那幅你帮我拿过来。
turns.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de bìyèzhǎn a, dāngrán yào rènzhēn! dìshang nà fú nǐ bāng wǒ ná guolai.
turns.en: It's my graduation show! Of course I'm fussy! Can you bring me the one on the floor?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这幅画的是地铁吗？只用了黑色，可是特别有伦敦的感觉。
turns.pinyin: zhè fú huà de shì dìtiě ma? zhǐ yòng le hēisè, kěshì tèbié yǒu lúndūn de gǎnjué.
turns.en: Is this one the Tube? It's only in black, but it really feels like London.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 谢谢！这些画我画了一年多。……哎，谁在楼下叫我？
turns.pinyin: xièxie! zhèxiē huà wǒ huà le yī nián duō. āi, shéi zài lóuxià jiào wǒ?
turns.en: Thanks! I've been painting these for over a year. ...Hey, who's that calling me from downstairs?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 小雨！我给你们带午饭来了！饺子太多了，快下来帮我拿！
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ! wǒ gěi nǐmen dài wǔfàn lái le! jiǎozi tài duōle, kuài xiàlai bāng wǒ ná!
turns.en: Xiaoyu! I've brought you lunch! There are too many dumplings, come down and help me carry them!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，你先下去帮他拿一下吧。我把这幅挂好就下去。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ xiān xiàqu bāng tā ná yīxià ba. wǒ bǎ zhè fú guà hǎo jiù xiàqu.
turns.en: Mark, can you go down first and give him a hand? I'll come down as soon as I've hung this one.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，我马上下去！陈明，你别上来了，在那儿等我！
turns.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ mǎshàng xiàqu! Chénmíng, nǐ bié shànglai le, zài nàr děng wǒ!
turns.en: OK, I'm coming down! Chen Ming, don't come up, wait there for me!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 快点儿！饺子凉了就不好吃了！
turns.pinyin: kuài diǎnr! jiǎozi liáng le jiù bù hǎochī le!
turns.en: Hurry up! Dumplings are no good once they've gone cold!

dialogues.title: Thanks for all your hard work!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 大家辛苦了！画都挂好了。现在我们把这张桌子搬到门口去吧。
turns.pinyin: dàjiā xīnkǔ le! huà dōu guà hǎole. xiànzài wǒmen bǎ zhè zhāng zhuōzi bān dào ménkǒu qù ba.
turns.en: Thanks, everyone, you've worked so hard! The paintings are all up. Now let's move this table over to the door.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 这张桌子太重了。马克，你过来帮我一下。
turns.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuōzi tài zhòng le. Mǎkè, nǐ guòlai bāng wǒ yīxià.
turns.en: This table's really heavy. Mark, come over and give me a hand.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 来了！一、二、三！……放在这儿行吗？
turns.pinyin: lái le! yī, èr, sān! fàng zài zhèr xíng ma?
turns.en: Coming! One, two, three! ...Is here all right?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 再往左一点儿……好！开幕那天，客人进来以后，先在这儿签名。
turns.pinyin: zài wǎng zuǒ yīdiǎnr hǎo! kāimù nà tiān, kèrén jìnlai yǐhòu, xiān zài zhèr qiānmíng.
turns.en: A bit more to the left... great! On opening night, guests will sign in here when they come in.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 小雨，这几个空箱子怎么办？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, zhè jǐ gè kōng xiāngzi zěnmebàn?
turns.en: Xiaoyu, what shall we do with these empty boxes?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 先拿出去吧，放在门外面。
turns.pinyin: xiān ná chuqu ba, fàng zài mén wàimiàn.
turns.en: Take them out for now. Put them outside the door.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 外面在下雨呢！我把箱子搬下去，放在楼下吧。
turns.pinyin: wàimiàn zài xiàyǔ ne! wǒ bǎ xiāngzi bān xiaqu, fàng zài lóuxià ba.
turns.en: It's raining out there! I'll carry the boxes downstairs and leave them there.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 也行，谢谢！马克，你把灯都打开，我看看效果。
turns.pinyin: yě xíng, xièxie! Mǎkè, nǐ bǎ dēng dōu dǎkāi, wǒ kàn kan xiàoguǒ.
turns.en: That works too, thanks! Mark, turn all the lights on so I can see how it looks.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 开了。怎么样？
turns.pinyin: kāi le. zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: They're on. How's that?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这个灯太亮了，照在画上不好看。你把它关上吧。
turns.pinyin: zhège dēng tài liàng le, zhào zài huà shang bù hǎokàn. nǐ bǎ tā guān shang ba.
turns.en: This light's too bright. It doesn't look good on the painting. Turn it off.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 关上了。咦，陈明呢？他刚才还在这儿。
turns.pinyin: guān shang le. yí, Chénmíng ne? tā gāngcái hái zài zhèr.
turns.en: It's off. Hang on, where's Chen Ming? He was here a minute ago.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爸爸回饭馆去了。他说晚上客人多，得回去准备。
turns.pinyin: bàba huí fànguǎn qù le. tā shuō wǎnshang kèrén duō, děi huíqu zhǔnbèi.
turns.en: Dad's gone back to the restaurant. He said it'll be busy tonight, so he had to go back and get ready.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥就是这样，来得快，走得也快！好了，今天就到这儿。我们把灯关了，回家吧！
turns.pinyin: biǎogē jiùshì zhèyàng, lái de kuài, zǒu de yě kuài! hǎole, jīntiān jiù dào zhèr. wǒmen bǎ dēng guān le, huí jiā ba!
turns.en: That's my cousin: here one minute, gone the next! Right, that's it for today. Let's turn the lights off and go home!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你们看，这件旗袍是我妈从成都寄来的，那件汉服是跟同学借的。开幕那天我穿哪件好？
turns.pinyin: nǐmen kàn, zhè jiàn qípáo shì wǒ mā cóng chéngdū jì lái de, nà jiàn hànfú shì gēn tóngxué jiè de. kāimù nà tiān wǒ chuān nǎ jiàn hǎo?
turns.en: Look, this qipao is one my mum sent from Chengdu, and that hanfu I've borrowed from a classmate. Which should I wear on opening night?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 旗袍我知道。汉服是什么？跟旗袍有什么不同？
turns.pinyin: qípáo wǒ zhīdào. hànfú shì shénme? gēn qípáo yǒu shénme bùtóng?
turns.en: I know what a qipao is. What's hanfu? How's it different from a qipao?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 汉服是很古老的衣服，比旗袍早得多。旗袍一百年前才开始流行。
turns.pinyin: hànfú shì hěn gǔlǎo de yīfu, bǐ qípáo zǎo deduō. qípáo yī bǎi nián qián cái kāishǐ liúxíng.
turns.en: Hanfu is very old. It's much older than the qipao. The qipao only became fashionable a hundred years ago.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 汉服的袖子那么长，吃饺子的时候怎么办？
turns.pinyin: hànfú de xiùzi nàme cháng, chī jiǎozi de shíhou zěnmebàn?
turns.en: Those hanfu sleeves are so long. What do you do when you're eating dumplings?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥！那天不吃饺子！你说，哪件好看？
turns.pinyin: biǎogē! nà tiān bù chī jiǎozi! nǐ shuō, nǎ jiàn hǎokàn?
turns.en: Cousin! We're not eating dumplings that night! Which one looks better?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我喜欢汉服。汉服的颜色比旗袍的漂亮得多。
turns.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan hànfú. hànfú de yánsè bǐ qípáo de piàoliang deduō.
turns.en: I like the hanfu. Its colours are much nicer than the qipao's.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我觉得旗袍更适合你。汉服太长了，走路不方便。
turns.pinyin: wǒ juéde qípáo gèng shìhé nǐ. hànfú tài cháng le, zǒulù bù fāngbiàn.
turns.en: I think the qipao suits you better. The hanfu's too long to walk in.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 也是。汉服没有旗袍那么方便，那天我要走来走去，跟很多人说话。
turns.pinyin: yěshì. hànfú méiyǒu qípáo nàme fāngbiàn, nà tiān wǒ yào zǒuláizǒuqù, gēn hěnduō rén shuōhuà.
turns.en: True. Hanfu isn't as practical as a qipao, and on the night I'll be walking about and talking to lots of people.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那就穿旗袍！我也穿我的唐装，陪你一起穿中国衣服。
turns.pinyin: nà jiù chuān qípáo! wǒ yě chuān wǒ de tángzhuāng, péi nǐ yīqǐ chuān zhōngguó yīfu.
turns.en: Then wear the qipao! And I'll wear my Tang jacket, so you're not the only one in Chinese clothes.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 唐装？你还有唐装？
turns.pinyin: tángzhuāng? nǐ hái yǒu tángzhuāng?
turns.en: A Tang jacket? You've got one of those too?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 有啊，是我爸结婚那年买的，比我还大两岁呢！
turns.pinyin: yǒu a, shì wǒ bà jiéhūn nànián mǎi de, bǐ wǒ hái dà liǎng suì ne!
turns.en: Sure. My dad bought it the year he got married. It's two years older than me!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我呢？我也想穿中国衣服！
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ ne? wǒ yě xiǎng chuān zhōngguó yīfu!
turns.en: What about me? I want to wear Chinese clothes too!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你穿什么都行，就是别再迟到了！
turns.pinyin: nǐ chuān shénme dōu xíng, jiùshì bié zài chídào le!
turns.en: You can wear whatever you like. Just don't be late again!

dialogues.title: These shrimps look like they're swimming!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哇，这几只虾画得跟活的一样！这是谁画的？
turns.pinyin: wa, zhè jǐ zhī xiā huà de gēn huó de yīyàng! zhè shì shéi huà de?
turns.en: Wow, these shrimps look alive! Who painted this?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 齐白石。他是中国最有名的画家之一，特别会画虾。
turns.pinyin: Qíbáishí. tā shì zhōngguó zuì yǒumíng de huàjiā zhīyī, tèbié huì huà xiā.
turns.en: Qi Baishi. He's one of China's most famous painters, and he was brilliant at shrimps.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可是纸上只有虾，一点儿水也没有啊。
turns.pinyin: kěshì zhǐ shang zhǐ yǒu xiā, yīdiǎnr shuǐ yě méiyǒu a.
turns.en: But there's nothing on the paper except shrimps. There's no water at all.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你再看看，这些虾是不是在水里游？
turns.pinyin: nǐ zài kàn kan, zhèxiē xiā shì bùshì zài shuǐ lǐ yóu?
turns.en: Look again. Aren't these shrimps swimming in water?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 真的，好像在游！可是齐白石一点儿水也没画。
turns.pinyin: zhēnde, hǎoxiàng zài yóu! kěshì Qíbáishí yīdiǎnr shuǐ yě méi huà.
turns.en: You're right, they look like they're swimming! But Qi Baishi didn't paint any water.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对，这就叫“留白”。不画的地方，让看画的人自己去想。
turns.pinyin: duì, zhè jiù jiào liúbái. bù huà de dìfang, ràng kàn huà de rén zìjǐ qù xiǎng.
turns.en: Exactly. That's called 'leaving white'. The parts you don't paint are left for the viewer to imagine.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我们做设计也一样，东西不能放得太满。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen zuò shèjì yě yīyàng, dōngxi bù néng fàng de tài mǎn.
turns.en: It's the same in design. You mustn't cram too much in.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 没错！所以我的毕业展也用了很多留白。
turns.pinyin: méicuò! suǒyǐ wǒ de bìyèzhǎn yě yòng le hěnduō liúbái.
turns.en: That's right! That's why my graduation show had lots of empty space too.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 他画一只虾要多长时间？
turns.pinyin: tā huà yī zhī xiā yào duōchángshíjiān?
turns.en: How long did it take him to paint one shrimp?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 可能只要几十秒。可是为了画好虾，他看了几十年的虾！
turns.pinyin: kěnéng zhǐ yào jǐ shí miǎo. kěshì wèile huà hǎo xiā, tā kàn le jǐ shí nián de xiā!
turns.en: Maybe less than a minute. But to paint shrimps well, he spent decades looking at them!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 旁边那幅是马吧？跑得真快！
turns.pinyin: pángbiān nà fú shì mǎ ba? pǎo de zhēn kuài!
turns.en: That one next to it is a horse, isn't it? It's really galloping!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那是徐悲鸿的马。他在巴黎学过油画，所以他的马跟一般的国画不太一样。
turns.pinyin: nà shì Xúbēihóng de mǎ. tā zài Bālí xué guo yóuhuà, suǒyǐ tā de mǎ gēn yībān de guóhuà bù tài yīyàng.
turns.en: That's one of Xu Beihong's horses. He studied oil painting in Paris, so his horses aren't quite like most Chinese paintings.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 徐悲鸿？叔叔说过他的马！一会儿见了叔叔，我们问问他。
turns.pinyin: Xúbēihóng? shūshu shuō guo tā de mǎ! yīhuìr jiàn le shūshu, wǒmen wèn wèn tā.
turns.en: Xu Beihong? Uncle's told me about his horses! Let's ask him when we see him later.

dialogues.title: How is Chinese painting different from oil painting?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我跟朵朵上午在国家美术馆看了半天油画，眼睛都累了。你们呢？
turns.pinyin: wǒ gēn Duǒduo shàngwǔ zài Guójiāměishùguǎn kàn le bàntiān yóuhuà, yǎnjing dōu lèi le. nǐmen ne?
turns.en: Duoduo and I spent the whole morning looking at oil paintings in the National Gallery. My eyes are tired. What about you?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我们看了国画。小雨，国画和油画到底有什么不同？
turns.pinyin: wǒmen kàn le guóhuà. Xiǎoyǔ, guóhuà hé yóuhuà dàodǐ yǒu shénme bùtóng?
turns.en: We've been looking at Chinese paintings. Xiaoyu, what exactly is the difference between Chinese painting and oil painting?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 首先，工具不一样。国画用毛笔和墨来画，一般画在纸上；油画用油画颜料，画在布上。
turns.pinyin: shǒuxiān, gōngjù bù yīyàng. guóhuà yòng máobǐ hé mò lái huà, yībān huà zài zhǐ shang; yóuhuà yòng yóuhuà yánliào, huà zài bù shang.
turns.en: First, the tools are different. Chinese painting uses a brush and ink, usually on paper. Oil painting uses oil paints, on canvas.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 还有颜色！油画的颜色又多又重，很多国画只用黑色。
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu yánsè! yóuhuà de yánsè yòu duō yòu zhòng, hěnduō guóhuà zhǐ yòng hēisè.
turns.en: And the colours! Oil paintings have lots of strong colour, and a lot of Chinese paintings only use black.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 可是国画的黑不只一种。墨可以浓，也可以淡，画家用浓淡来表现远近。
turns.pinyin: kěshì guóhuà de hēi bù zhǐ yī zhǒng. mò kěyǐ nóng, yě kěyǐ dàn, huàjiā yòng nóng dàn lái biǎoxiàn yuǎnjìn.
turns.en: But there's more than one kind of black in Chinese painting. Ink can be dark or pale, and painters use dark and pale to show what's near and far.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 还有留白。油画一般把整张画布都画满，国画喜欢留一些地方不画。
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu liúbái. yóuhuà yībān bǎ zhěng zhāng huàbù dōu huà mǎn, guóhuà xǐhuan liú yīxiē dìfang bù huà.
turns.en: And the empty space. Oil painters usually cover the whole canvas, and Chinese painting likes to leave some parts unpainted.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 对。很多油画家想把看到的东西画得很像。
turns.pinyin: duì. hěnduō yóu huàjiā xiǎng bǎ kàn dào de dōngxi huà de hěn xiàng.
turns.en: Right. Lots of oil painters want to paint exactly what they see.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 国画家不太一样。齐白石说过，画画最好在“像”和“不像”之间。
turns.pinyin: guóhuà jiā bù tài yīyàng. Qíbáishí shuō guo, huàhuà zuì hǎo zài xiàng hé bù xiàng zhījiān.
turns.en: Chinese painters are a bit different. Qi Baishi said the best painting is somewhere between 'like' and 'not like'.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 有意思！那徐悲鸿呢？他在巴黎学的是油画啊。
turns.pinyin: yǒuyìsi! nà Xúbēihóng ne? tā zài Bālí xué de shì yóuhuà a.
turns.en: Interesting! What about Xu Beihong, then? What he studied in Paris was oil painting.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对。他把西方画画的方法用到了国画里，所以他的马又真实又有精神。
turns.pinyin: duì. tā bǎ xīfāng huàhuà de fāngfǎ yòng dào le guóhuà lǐ, suǒyǐ tā de mǎ yòu zhēnshí yòu yǒu jīngshen.
turns.en: Yes. He brought Western ways of painting into Chinese painting, so his horses are both true to life and full of energy.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 中西结合！跟小雨的毕业展一样：用中国画的方法来画伦敦。
turns.pinyin: zhōngxījiéhé! gēn Xiǎoyǔ de bìyèzhǎn yīyàng: yòng zhōngguóhuà de fāngfǎ lái huà lúndūn.
turns.en: East meets West! Just like Xiaoyu's graduation show: London painted the Chinese way.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 那你们俩谁会画国画？
turns.pinyin: nà nǐmen liǎ shéi huì huà guóhuà?
turns.en: So which of you two can do Chinese painting?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我会一点儿。马克，朵朵，下次我教你们画虾吧！
turns.pinyin: wǒ huì yīdiǎnr. Mǎkè, Duǒduo, xià cì wǒ jiāo nǐmen huà xiā ba!
turns.en: I can a bit. Mark, Duoduo, next time I'll teach you to paint shrimps!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好啊！不过我画的虾，肯定在“像”和“不像”之间……更像鱼！
turns.pinyin: hǎo a! bùguò wǒ huà de xiā, kěndìng zài xiàng hé bù xiàng zhījiān gèng xiàng yú!
turns.en: Great! But my shrimps will definitely be somewhere between 'like' and 'not like'... more like fish!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 马克，菜单做完了没有？下个星期就要拿去印了。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, càidān zuò wán le méiyǒu? xià gè xīngqī jiù yào ná qù yìn le.
turns.en: Mark, have you finished the menu yet? It's got to go to the printer next week.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 快做完了，就差最后一页。我发给你的照片，你看见了吗？
turns.pinyin: kuài zuò wán le, jiùchà zuìhòu yī yè. wǒ fā gěi nǐ de zhàopiàn, nǐ kànjiàn le ma?
turns.en: Nearly, there's just the last page left. Did you see the photos I sent you?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 看见了！饺子拍得真好，比真的还好吃……不对，还好看！
turns.pinyin: kànjiàn le! jiǎozi pāi de zhēn hǎo, bǐ zhēnde hái hǎochī bù duì, hái hǎokàn!
turns.en: I saw them! The dumplings look great. Even tastier than the real thing... no, I mean better-looking!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哈哈。英文菜名我都写好了，中文的还没写完。
turns.pinyin: hāhā. yīngwén càimíng wǒ dōu xiě hǎole, zhōngwén de hái méi xiě wán.
turns.en: Ha ha. I've done all the English names of the dishes, but I haven't finished the Chinese ones yet.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你把写好的发过来，我先看看。
turns.pinyin: nǐ bǎ xiě hǎode fā guolai, wǒ xiān kàn kan.
turns.en: Send me what you've done, and I'll have a look.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 发过去了，收到了吗？
turns.pinyin: fā guoqu le, shōudào le ma?
turns.en: Sent. Have you got it?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 收到了。……“牛肉”的“肉”字你写错了。里面有两个“人”，你只写了一个。
turns.pinyin: shōudào le. niúròu de ròu zì nǐ xiě cuò le. lǐmiàn yǒu liǎng gè rén, nǐ zhǐ xiě le yī gè.
turns.en: Got it. ...You've written the 肉 in 'beef' wrong. There are two 人 inside it, and you've only written one.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哎呀！我看了三遍都没看见。还好你看见了，我马上改好。
turns.pinyin: āiyā! wǒ kàn le sān biàn dōu méi kànjiàn. háihǎo nǐ kànjiàn le, wǒ mǎshàng gǎi hǎo.
turns.en: Oh no! I read it three times and didn't spot it. Good thing you did. I'll fix it now.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 还有这句英文，我没看懂，是什么意思？
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu zhè jù yīngwén, wǒ méi kàndǒng, shì shénme yìsi?
turns.en: And this line of English, I don't get it. What does it mean?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “Hand-made every morning”，就是“每天早上手工做的”。
turns.pinyin: Handmadeeverymorning, jiùshì měitiān zǎoshang shǒugōng zuò de.
turns.en: 'Hand-made every morning': it means they're made by hand every morning.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 好！我们的饺子就是每天早上手工做的。
turns.pinyin: hǎo! wǒmen de jiǎozi jiùshì měitiān zǎoshang shǒugōng zuò de.
turns.en: Good! Our dumplings really are made by hand every morning.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 改好了！全部做完了！
turns.pinyin: gǎi hǎole! quánbù zuò wán le!
turns.en: Fixed it! It's all done!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 辛苦了！这个周末好好休息休息。下次来吃饭，我请客！
turns.pinyin: xīnkǔ le! zhège zhōumò hǎohāo xiūxi xiūxi. xià cì lái chīfàn, wǒ qǐngkè!
turns.en: Thanks for all your work! Get some proper rest this weekend. Next time you come to eat, it's on me!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 你们家哪次不请客？
turns.pinyin: nǐmen jiā nǎ cì bù qǐngkè?
turns.en: When has your family ever let me pay?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 喂，马克，起来了吗？
turns.pinyin: wèi, Mǎkè, qǐlai le ma?
turns.en: Hi, Mark, are you up?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 刚起来。今天我睡到十点才起床，太舒服了！
turns.pinyin: gāng qǐlai. jīntiān wǒ shuì dào shí diǎn cái qǐchuáng, tài shūfu le!
turns.en: Just. I slept till ten today. It was wonderful!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我也是。毕业展结束了，今天什么都不想干。
turns.pinyin: wǒ yěshì. bìyèzhǎn jiéshù le, jīntiān shénme dōu bù xiǎng gàn.
turns.en: Me too. The show's over, and today I don't feel like doing anything.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我们干什么？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒmen gàn shénme?
turns.en: So what shall we do?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 什么都不干！就随便逛逛、看看，找个地方喝喝咖啡，聊聊天。
turns.pinyin: shénme dōu bù gàn! jiù suíbiàn guàng guàng, kàn kan, zhǎo gè dìfang hē hē kāfēi, liáo liáotiān.
turns.en: Nothing! Just wander round, have a look at things, find somewhere for a coffee and a chat.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好主意！去哪儿逛逛？
turns.pinyin: hǎozhǔyi! qù nǎr guàng guàng?
turns.en: Good idea! Where shall we go?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 南岸有个圣诞市场，我们去看看吧。听说那儿的热红酒不错，你可以试一试。
turns.pinyin: Nán'àn yǒu gè shèngdàn shìchǎng, wǒmen qù kàn kan ba. tīngshuō nàr de rè hóngjiǔ bùcuò, nǐ kěyǐ shì yī shì.
turns.en: There's a Christmas market on the South Bank. Let's go and have a look. I hear the mulled wine there's good. You could give it a try.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好啊。逛完了，我们还可以沿着河边散散步。对了，你毕业了，以后有什么打算？
turns.pinyin: hǎo a. guàng wán le, wǒmen háikěyǐ yánzhe hébiān sànsànbù. duìle, nǐ bìyè le, yǐhòu yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
turns.en: Sure. When we've had a look round, we can go for a walk along the river. Oh, by the way, now you've graduated, what are your plans?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 先找工作吧。伦敦、上海、墨尔本，我都看看……哎，今天不聊这个！
turns.pinyin: xiān zhǎo gōngzuò ba. lúndūn, Shànghǎi, Mò'ěrběn, wǒ dōu kàn kan āi, jīntiān bù liáo zhège!
turns.en: Find a job first, I suppose. London, Shanghai, Melbourne, I'm looking at all of them... hey, we're not talking about that today!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，不聊工作。那聊聊春节吧：陈明说他们一家人今年回北京过年，问我想不想一起去！
turns.pinyin: hǎo, bù liáo gōngzuò. nà liáo liáo chūnjié ba: Chénmíng shuō tāmen yījiārén jīnnián huí běijīng guònián, wèn wǒ xiǎng bù xiǎng yīqǐ qù!
turns.en: OK, no work talk. Let's talk about Spring Festival, then. Chen Ming says the whole family is going home to Beijing for New Year, and he's asked if I want to come!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 真的？在北京过春节，一定特别热闹！
turns.pinyin: zhēnde? zài běijīng guò chūnjié, yīdìng tèbié rènao!
turns.en: Really? Spring Festival in Beijing will be so lively!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我当然想去！不过，我得先看看机票……
turns.pinyin: wǒ dāngrán xiǎng qù! bùguò, wǒ děi xiān kàn kan jīpiào
turns.en: Of course I want to go! But I'd better look at flights first...

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 今天不看机票！今天就逛逛、聊聊天，别的什么都不想。一个小时以后，南岸见！
turns.pinyin: jīntiān bù kàn jīpiào! jīntiān jiù guàng guàng, liáo liáotiān, biéde shénme dōu bù xiǎng. yī gè xiǎoshí yǐhòu, Nán'àn jiàn!
turns.en: No looking at flights today! Today we just wander and chat, and don't think about anything else. See you on the South Bank in an hour!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克来了！快进来，外面冷吧？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè lái le! kuài jìnlai, wàimiàn lěng ba?
turns.en: Mark's here! Come in, come in. It's cold out, isn't it?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔、阿姨，过年好！这是我从伦敦带来的一点儿小礼物。
turns.pinyin: shūshu, āyí, guòniánhǎo! zhè shì wǒ cóng lúndūn dàilai de yīdiǎnr xiǎo lǐwù.
turns.en: Happy New Year! This is a little something I brought from London.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哟，还带礼物来了！甭这么客气。我跟老邻居说起你，他们都想见见这个会说中文的英国人！
turns.pinyin: yō, hái dài lǐwù lái le! béng zhème kèqi. wǒ gēn lǎo línjū shuōqǐ nǐ, tāmen dōu xiǎng jiàn jiàn zhège huì shuō zhōngwén de yīngguó rén!
turns.en: Oh, you've brought a present! There's no need for that. I've told our old neighbours about you, and they all want to meet the Englishman who speaks Chinese!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，快洗手，我们在包饺子呢，你也来一块儿包！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, kuài xǐshǒu, wǒmen zài bāo jiǎozi ne, nǐ yě lái yīkuàir bāo!
turns.en: Mark, go and wash your hands. We're making dumplings. Come and make some too!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好啊！不过我只会吃，不会包。
turns.pinyin: hǎo a! bùguò wǒ zhǐ huì chī, bù huì bāo.
turns.en: Great! But I only know how to eat them, not make them.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 没事儿，阿姨教你。拿一张皮，放点儿馅儿，对折，两只手这么一捏……看，一个元宝！
turns.pinyin: méishìr, āyí jiāo nǐ. ná yī zhāng pí, fàng diǎnr xiànr, duìzhé, liǎng zhī shǒu zhème yī niē kàn, yī gè yuánbǎo!
turns.en: No problem, I'll show you. Take a wrapper, put in a bit of filling, fold it in half, then pinch it with both hands like this... look, a gold ingot!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 元宝？是什么？
turns.pinyin: yuánbǎo? shì shénme?
turns.en: A gold ingot? What's that?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 以前的钱就是这个样子。过年吃饺子，就是希望明年多挣钱呗！
turns.pinyin: yǐqián de qián jiùshì zhège yàngzi. guònián chī jiǎozi, jiùshì xīwàng míngnián duō zhèngqián bei!
turns.en: It's what money looked like in the old days. We eat dumplings at New Year because we want to make lots of money next year, of course!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我妈还在几个饺子里包了硬币。谁吃到硬币，谁明年就有福气。
turns.pinyin: wǒ mā hái zài jǐ gè jiǎozi lǐ bāo le yìngbì. shéi chī dào yìngbì, shéi míngnián jiù yǒu fúqi.
turns.en: My mum's also put coins in a few of them. Whoever gets a coin will have good luck next year.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我今天晚上得多吃几个！阿姨，您看我包的这个怎么样？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang děiduō chī jǐ gè! āyí, nín kàn wǒ bāo de zhège zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: Then I'd better eat plenty tonight! What do you think of this one I've made?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 挺好，挺好！就是馅儿放得太多了，一煮就破。
turns.pinyin: tǐng hǎo, tǐng hǎo! jiùshì xiànr fàng de tài duōle, yī zhǔ jiù pò.
turns.en: Lovely, lovely! It's just got too much filling. It'll burst as soon as it's boiled.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 没关系，破了的我吃！除了饺子以外，今天晚上还有鱼、有鸡、有肉，保证让你吃饱！
turns.pinyin: méiguānxi, pò le de wǒ chī! chúle jiǎozi yǐwài, jīntiān wǎnshang hái yǒu yú, yǒu jī, yǒu ròu, bǎozhèng ràng nǐ chī bǎo!
turns.en: Never mind, I'll eat the burst ones! And besides dumplings, tonight there's fish, chicken and meat. You won't go hungry, I promise!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 吃完年夜饭，一家人一起看春晚，等到十二点。这就是北京人过年！
turns.pinyin: chī wán niányèfàn, yījiārén yīqǐ kàn chūnwǎn, děng dào shí èr diǎn. zhè jiùshì běijīng rén guònián!
turns.en: After the New Year's Eve dinner, the whole family watches the gala on TV and waits up till midnight. That's New Year, Beijing style!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 太好了！在伦敦的时候我就开始期待了！
turns.pinyin: tàihǎole! zài lúndūn de shíhou wǒ jiù kāishǐ qīdài le!
turns.en: Brilliant! I've been looking forward to this since I was in London!

dialogues.title: Happy New Year to you both!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔、阿姨，新年好！给您二位拜年了！
turns.pinyin: shūshu, āyí, xīnniánhǎo! gěi nín èrwèi bàinián le!
turns.en: Happy New Year! Wishing you both a very happy New Year!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 好好好，新年好！来，这是给你的红包。
turns.pinyin: hǎohǎo hǎo, xīnniánhǎo! lái, zhè shì gěi nǐ de hóngbāo.
turns.en: Thank you, thank you, Happy New Year! Here, this red envelope is for you.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 不行不行！我都这么大了，怎么能要您的红包？
turns.pinyin: bùxíng bùxíng! wǒ dōu zhème dà le, zěnme néng yào nín de hóngbāo?
turns.en: No, no, I can't! I'm a grown man. How can I take a red envelope from you?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 没结婚就还是孩子！快收下，这是压岁钱，图个吉利。
turns.pinyin: méi jiéhūn jiù háishi háizi! kuài shōuxia, zhè shì yāsuìqián, túgejílì.
turns.en: If you're not married, you're still a child! Go on, take it. It's New Year money, for luck.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，长辈给的红包不能不要。你看我：用两只手接，说“谢谢爷爷”就行了。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, zhǎngbèi gěi de hóngbāo bù néng bù yào. nǐ kàn wǒ: yòng liǎng zhī shǒu jiē, shuō xièxie yéye jiù xíng le.
turns.en: Mark, you can't refuse a red envelope from your elders. Watch me: take it with both hands and say 'thank you, Grandpa'. That's all.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那……谢谢叔叔阿姨！祝您二位身体健康，万事如意！
turns.pinyin: nà xièxie shūshu āyí! zhù nín èrwèi shēntǐ jiànkāng, wànshìrúyì!
turns.en: Well... thank you! Wishing you both good health, and may everything go well for you!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 哎哟，这孩子嘴真甜！快来吃早饭，饺子还有好多呢。
turns.pinyin: āiyō, zhè háizi zuǐ zhēn tián! kuài lái chī zǎofàn, jiǎozi hái yǒu hǎoduō ne.
turns.en: Oh, what a sweet talker! Come and have breakfast. There are still loads of dumplings.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 还有饺子？昨天晚上我吃了三十多个，一个硬币也没吃到……
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu jiǎozi? zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ chī le sān shí duō gè, yī gè yìngbì yě méi chī dào
turns.en: More dumplings? I ate over thirty last night and didn't get a single coin...

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那今天接着吃！对了，昨天的春晚你看懂了吗？
turns.pinyin: nà jīntiān jiēzhe chī! duìle, zuótiān de chūnwǎn nǐ kàndǒng le ma?
turns.en: Then keep eating today! Oh, by the way, could you follow the gala last night?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 除了相声以外，别的都看懂了。相声说得太快了。
turns.pinyin: chúle xiàngsheng yǐwài, biéde dōu kàndǒng le. xiàngsheng shuō de tài kuài le.
turns.en: Everything except the comic dialogues. They talk too fast.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 相声里有很多北京话，听不懂很正常。
turns.pinyin: xiàngsheng lǐ yǒu hěnduō běijīng huà, tīng bu dǒng hěn zhèngcháng.
turns.en: Comic dialogues are full of Beijing slang. It's normal not to understand them.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 还有，十二点的时候，我只听见了一点儿鞭炮。我还以为北京过年到处都放鞭炮呢。
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu, shí èr diǎn de shíhou, wǒ zhǐ tīngjiàn le yīdiǎnr biānpào. wǒ hái yǐwéi běijīng guònián dàochù dōu fàngbiānpào ne.
turns.en: And at midnight I only heard a few firecrackers. I thought there'd be firecrackers going off everywhere in Beijing at New Year.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 以前是这样，胡同里到处都是鞭炮。现在城里不让放了，为了安全，也为了空气。想放的话，得去很远的地方。
turns.pinyin: yǐqián shì zhèyàng, hútòng lǐ dàochù dōu shì biānpào. xiànzài chénglǐ bùràng fàng le, wèile ānquán, yě wèile kōngqì. xiǎng fàng dehuà, děi qù hěn yuǎn de dìfang.
turns.en: It used to be like that. The hutongs were full of firecrackers. Now you can't set them off in town, for safety and for the air. If you want to, you have to go a long way out.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 不放也好，又安全又干净。来来来，快吃，饺子凉了就不好吃了！
turns.pinyin: bù fàng yě hǎo, yòu ānquán yòu gānjìng. lái lái lái, kuài chī, jiǎozi liáng le jiù bù hǎochī le!
turns.en: It's better without them, safer and cleaner. Come on, come on, eat up. Dumplings are no good once they've gone cold!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这家茶馆很有名。一边喝茶，一边看节目，这就是老北京！
turns.pinyin: zhè jiā cháguǎn hěn yǒumíng. yībiān hē chá, yībiān kàn jiémù, zhè jiùshì lǎo běijīng!
turns.en: This teahouse is famous. Drinking tea and watching a show: that's old Beijing!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，台上那个乐器是什么？只有两根弦，声音那么好听！
turns.pinyin: shūshu, tái shang nàge yuèqì shì shénme? zhǐ yǒu liǎng gēn xián, shēngyīn nàme hǎotīng!
turns.en: What's that instrument on the stage? It's only got two strings, and it sounds lovely!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那是二胡。听起来有点儿难过，是不是？
turns.pinyin: nà shì èrhú. tīngqilai yǒudiǎnr nánguò, shì bùshì?
turns.en: That's an erhu. It sounds a bit sad, doesn't it?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对，听起来好像有人在哭。旁边那个很长的呢？
turns.pinyin: duì, tīngqilai hǎoxiàng yǒu rén zài kū. pángbiān nàge hěn cháng de ne?
turns.en: Yes, it sounds like someone crying. What about the long one next to it?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那叫古筝，是用手弹的。你听听，像不像水的声音？
turns.pinyin: nà jiào gǔzhēng, shì yòng shǒu tán de. nǐ tīng tīng, xiàng bù xiàng shuǐ de shēngyīn?
turns.en: That's called a guzheng. You play it with your fingers. Listen: doesn't it sound like water?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 像！……下一个节目是京剧吧？叔叔，他们唱的，您听得懂吗？
turns.pinyin: xiàng! xià yī gè jiémù shì jīngjù ba? shūshu, tāmen chàng de, nín tīngdedǒng ma?
turns.en: It does! ...The next one's Beijing opera, isn't it? Can you understand what they're singing?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 当然听得懂，我从小就听京剧。你呢？
turns.pinyin: dāngrán tīngdedǒng, wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù tīng jīngjù. nǐ ne?
turns.en: Of course. I've listened to Beijing opera since I was little. What about you?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我一句也听不懂。可是他们的衣服和脸谱太漂亮了！
turns.pinyin: wǒ yī jù yě tīng bu dǒng. kěshì tāmen de yīfu hé liǎnpǔ tài piàoliang le!
turns.en: I can't understand a word. But their costumes and face paint are gorgeous!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 旁边有字幕，你看得清楚吗？
turns.pinyin: pángbiān yǒu zìmù, nǐ kàndeqīngchu ma?
turns.en: There are subtitles at the side. Can you see them?

turns.name: 马克
