turns.hanzi: 太远了，看不清楚……哇！那个人的脸怎么变了？刚才是红的，现在是黑的！
turns.pinyin: tài yuǎn le, kàn bu qīngchu wa! nàge rén de liǎn zěnme biàn le? gāngcái shì hóng de, xiànzài shì hēi de!
turns.en: They're too far away, I can't see them properly... Whoa! What happened to that man's face? It was red a second ago, and now it's black!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 这是川剧变脸，小雨老家四川的。他一会儿变一张，一会儿又变一张，谁也看不出来是怎么变的。
turns.pinyin: zhè shì chuānjù biànliǎn, Xiǎoyǔ lǎojiā sìchuān de. tā yīhuìr biàn yī zhāng, yīhuìr yòu biàn yī zhāng, shéi yě kànbuchūlai shì zěnme biàn de.
turns.en: That's face-changing, from Sichuan opera, where Xiaoyu's from. He changes to one face, then another, and nobody can work out how he does it.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 太神奇了！爷爷，您知道是怎么变的吗？
turns.pinyin: tài shénqí le! yéye, nín zhīdào shì zěnme biàn de ma?
turns.en: That's amazing! Grandpa, do you know how he does it?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这可是秘密！我看过好多次，也看不出来。走，咱们去后面跟他拍张照片。
turns.pinyin: zhè kěshì mìmì! wǒ kàn guo hǎoduō cì, yě kànbuchūlai. zǒu, zánmen qù hòumiàn gēn tā pāi zhāng zhàopiàn.
turns.en: That's a secret! I've seen it loads of times and I still can't tell. Come on, let's go round the back and get a photo with him.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好！我要把照片发给小雨，让她猜猜！
turns.pinyin: hǎo! wǒ yào bǎ zhàopiàn fā gěi Xiǎoyǔ, ràng tā cāi cāi!
turns.en: Great! I'll send the photo to Xiaoyu and get her to guess!

dialogues.title: How many strings has your guitar got?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，新年好！你看，我在给我爸妈弹吉他呢。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, xīnniánhǎo! nǐ kàn, wǒ zài gěi wǒ bàmā tán jítā ne.
turns.en: Mark, Happy New Year! Look, I'm playing the guitar for my mum and dad.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 新年好！叔叔阿姨好！小雨，我今天听了二胡。你的吉他有几根弦？
turns.pinyin: xīnniánhǎo! shūshu āyí hǎo! Xiǎoyǔ, wǒ jīntiān tīng le èrhú. nǐ de jítā yǒu jǐ gēn xián?
turns.en: Happy New Year! Hello to your mum and dad! Xiaoyu, I heard the erhu today. How many strings has your guitar got?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 六根。二胡只有两根弦，可是声音特别丰富，比吉他难多了。
turns.pinyin: liù gēn. èrhú zhǐ yǒu liǎng gēn xián, kěshì shēngyīn tèbié fēngfù, bǐ jítā nán duōle.
turns.en: Six. The erhu's only got two, but it can make so many different sounds. It's much harder than the guitar.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 二胡是拉的？我还以为是弹的。
turns.pinyin: èrhú shì lā de? wǒ hái yǐwéi shì tán de.
turns.en: You play the erhu with a bow? I thought you plucked it.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 二胡是拉的，古筝和吉他是弹的。我小时候学过两年古筝，现在还在我房间里呢。
turns.pinyin: èrhú shì lā de, gǔzhēng hé jítā shì tán de. wǒ xiǎoshíhou xué guo liǎng nián gǔzhēng, xiànzài hái zài wǒ fángjiān lǐ ne.
turns.en: The erhu's bowed, and the guzheng and the guitar are plucked. I learned the guzheng for two years when I was little. It's still in my room.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 真的？那你弹一段给我听听！
turns.pinyin: zhēnde? nà nǐ tán yī duàn gěi wǒ tīng tīng!
turns.en: Really? Then play me something!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好久没弹了……我试试。……怎么样？
turns.pinyin: hǎojiǔ méi tán le wǒ shì shi. zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: I haven't played for ages... I'll give it a go. ...How was that?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 听起来真美，像下小雨一样！
turns.pinyin: tīngqilai zhēn měi, xiàng xià Xiǎoyǔ yīyàng!
turns.en: It sounds beautiful, like gentle rain falling!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，谢谢！对了，你看变脸了吗？
turns.pinyin: hāhā, xièxie! duìle, nǐ kàn biànliǎn le ma?
turns.en: Ha ha, thanks! Oh, did you see the face-changing?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 看了！我到现在还没想明白是怎么变的。你是四川人，你知道吗？
turns.pinyin: kàn le! wǒ dào xiànzài hái méi xiǎng míngbai shì zěnme biàn de. nǐ shì sìchuān rén, nǐ zhīdào ma?
turns.en: I did! I still can't work out how it's done. You're from Sichuan. Do you know?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我看过好多次，也看不出来。听说变脸的方法是秘密，一般不教外人。
turns.pinyin: wǒ kàn guo hǎoduō cì, yě kànbuchūlai. tīngshuō biànliǎn de fāngfǎ shì mìmì, yībān bù jiāo wàirén.
turns.en: I've seen it loads of times and I can't tell either. They say the way it's done is a secret, and they don't usually teach it to outsiders.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 京剧我一句也听不懂，可是二胡、古筝，我都听得懂。
turns.pinyin: jīngjù wǒ yī jù yě tīng bu dǒng, kěshì èrhú, gǔzhēng, wǒ dōu tīngdedǒng.
turns.en: I can't understand a word of Beijing opera, but the erhu and the guzheng, I understand them fine.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对啊，好听的音乐不用翻译，谁都听得懂！
turns.pinyin: duì a, hǎotīng de yīnyuè bùyòng fānyì, shéi dōu tīngdedǒng!
turns.en: Exactly. Good music doesn't need translating. Everyone understands it!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说得好！那你再弹一段吧。我在北京听，就当我们一起过年了！
turns.pinyin: shuō de hǎo! nà nǐ zài tán yī duàn ba. wǒ zài běijīng tīng, jiù dàng wǒmen yīqǐ guònián le!
turns.en: Well said! Then play another one. I'll listen here in Beijing, and it'll be like we're spending New Year together!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 妈，您怎么又在看《红楼梦》？这部电视剧您都看了多少遍了？
turns.pinyin: mā, nín zěnme yòu zài kàn Hónglóumèng? zhè bù diànshìjù nín dōu kàn le duōshǎo biàn le?
turns.en: Mum, why are you watching Dream of the Red Chamber again? How many times have you seen this series?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 十几遍了吧。虽然看了这么多遍，但是每次看都想哭。
turns.pinyin: shí jǐ biàn le ba. suīrán kàn le zhème duō biàn, dànshì měi cì kàn dōu xiǎng kū.
turns.en: Over ten, I suppose. I've seen it so many times, but I still want to cry every time.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨，《红楼梦》讲的是什么故事？
turns.pinyin: āyí, Hónglóumèng jiǎng de shì shénme gùshi?
turns.en: What's Dream of the Red Chamber about?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 讲的是一个大家族，本来特别有钱，后来慢慢穷了。最有名的是贾宝玉和林黛玉的爱情故事。
turns.pinyin: jiǎng de shì yī gè dà jiāzú, běnlái tèbié yǒuqián, hòulái mànmàn qióng le. zuì yǒumíng de shì Jiǎbǎoyù hé Líndàiyù de àiqíng gùshi.
turns.en: It's about a big family who are very rich at first, and slowly lose everything. The most famous part is the love story of Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 林黛玉？她也姓林，跟小雨一样！
turns.pinyin: Líndàiyù? tā yě xìng Lín, gēn Xiǎoyǔ yīyàng!
turns.en: Lin Daiyu? Her surname's Lin too, like Xiaoyu!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，可是小雨没有林黛玉那么爱哭。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, kěshì Xiǎoyǔ méiyǒu Líndàiyù nàme àikū.
turns.en: Ha ha, but Xiaoyu doesn't cry as much as Lin Daiyu.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 林黛玉不但长得漂亮，而且特别有才，诗写得最好。可惜身体不好，最后……哎，不说了，我又要哭了。
turns.pinyin: Líndàiyù bùdàn zhǎngde piàoliang, érqiě tèbié yǒucái, shī xiě de zuì hǎo. kěxī shēntǐ bù hǎo, zuìhòu āi, bù shuō le, wǒ yòu yào kū le.
turns.en: Lin Daiyu is not only beautiful, but really talented too. She writes the best poems of them all. It's a shame she's so ill, and in the end... oh, I'll stop, or I'll cry again.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这本书是谁写的？
turns.pinyin: zhè běn shū shì shéi xiě de?
turns.en: Who wrote the book?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 曹雪芹，两百多年前写的。在中国，连小学生也知道《红楼梦》。
turns.pinyin: Cáoxuěqín, liǎng bǎi duō nián qián xiě de. zài zhōngguó, lián xiǎoxuéshēng yě zhīdào Hónglóumèng.
turns.en: Cao Xueqin, over two hundred years ago. In China, even primary school children know Dream of the Red Chamber.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我也想读读。可是就我的中文水平，读得懂吗？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ yě xiǎng dú dú. kěshì jiù wǒ de zhōngwén shuǐpíng, dú de dǒng ma?
turns.en: Then I'd like to read it too. But with my Chinese, could I understand it?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 连很多中国人也觉得原著难读！书里的人物有好几百个呢。
turns.pinyin: lián hěnduō zhōngguó rén yě juéde yuánzhù nán dú! shū lǐ de rénwù yǒu hǎojǐ bǎi gè ne.
turns.en: Even lots of Chinese people find the original hard to read! There are several hundred characters in it.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你可以先看电视剧。虽然也不容易，但是有字幕。
turns.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ xiān kàn diànshìjù. suīrán yě bù róngyì, dànshì yǒu zìmù.
turns.en: You could watch the series first. It's not easy either, but it has subtitles.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好主意！阿姨，那我陪您一起看吧，您给我讲讲。
turns.pinyin: hǎozhǔyi! āyí, nà wǒ péi nín yīqǐ kàn ba, nín gěi wǒ jiǎng jiǎng.
turns.en: Good idea! Then I'll watch it with you, and you can explain it to me.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 好啊！不过先说好，看到林黛玉死的那一集，你得给我递纸巾！
turns.pinyin: hǎo a! bùguò xiānshuōhǎo, kàn dào Líndàiyù sǐ de nà yī jí, nǐ děi gěi wǒ dì zhǐjīn!
turns.en: Lovely! But let's get one thing straight: when we get to the episode where Lin Daiyu dies, you're in charge of the tissues!

dialogues.title: Have you got an easier one?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈明，我想买一本《红楼梦》。可是我的中文还不太好，有没有简单一点儿的？
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn Hónglóumèng. kěshì wǒ de zhōngwén hái bù tài hǎo, yǒu méiyǒu jiǎndān yīdiǎnr de?
turns.en: Chen Ming, I'd like a copy of Dream of the Red Chamber. But my Chinese isn't great yet. Is there an easier version?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你看这本，是给中学生看的。虽然字不少，但是句子都比较短。
turns.pinyin: nǐ kàn zhè běn, shì gěi zhōngxuéshēng kàn de. suīrán zì bù shǎo, dànshì jùzi dōu bǐjiào duǎn.
turns.en: Have a look at this one. It's for secondary school students. There are quite a lot of characters, but the sentences are fairly short.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: （看了看）……不行，第一页就有十几个字我不认识。
turns.pinyin: kàn le kàn bùxíng, dì yī yè jiù yǒu shí jǐ gè zì wǒ bù rènshi.
turns.en: (Having a look) ...No good. There are more than ten characters I don't know on the first page alone.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，你来这边！这本是漫画版的，不但有图，而且每个字上面都有拼音。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ lái zhèbian! zhè běn shì mànhuà bǎn de, bùdàn yǒu tú, érqiě měi gè zì shàng miàn dōu yǒu pīnyīn.
turns.en: Mark, come over here! This one's a comic version. Not only has it got pictures, but there's pinyin over every character.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这不是给小朋友看的吗？
turns.pinyin: zhè bùshì gěi xiǎopéngyou kàn de ma?
turns.en: Isn't this one for kids?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 很多大人也看，特别是外国人。连我自己也看过，画得挺好的。
turns.pinyin: hěnduō dàren yě kàn, tèbiéshì wàiguórén. lián wǒ zìjǐ yě kàn guo, huà de tǐng hǎode.
turns.en: Lots of adults read it too, especially foreigners. Even I've read it. The drawings are really good.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，就要这本。还有英文版的吗？我想中文英文一起看。
turns.pinyin: hǎo, jiù yào zhè běn. hái yǒu yīngwén bǎn de ma? wǒ xiǎng zhōngwén yīngwén yīqǐ kàn.
turns.en: Right, I'll take it. Is there an English version too? I want to read the Chinese and English side by side.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 外文书在那边，我带你去！……找到了，英文的叫 The Story of the Stone。
turns.pinyin: wàiwén shū zài nàbian, wǒ dài nǐ qù! zhǎodào le, yīngwén de jiàoTheStoryoftheStone.
turns.en: The foreign-language books are over there. I'll show you! ...Found it. In English it's called The Story of the Stone.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 马克，你这是要当红学家啊！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ zhè shì yào dāng hóngxuéjiā a!
turns.en: Mark, you're turning into a Red Chamber scholar!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哪里哪里！我只想看懂林黛玉为什么那么爱哭。
turns.pinyin: nǎlǐnǎlǐ! wǒ zhǐ xiǎng kàndǒng Líndàiyù wèishénme nàme àikū.
turns.en: Hardly! I just want to understand why Lin Daiyu cries so much.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 两本一共一百八十六块，在那边扫码就行。
turns.pinyin: liǎng běn yīgòng yībǎibā shí liù kuài, zài nàbian sǎomǎ jiù xíng.
turns.en: That's a hundred and eighty-six yuan for the two. You can scan to pay over there.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好。陈明、朵朵，回去我们先别告诉阿姨，给她一个惊喜！
turns.pinyin: hǎo. Chénmíng, Duǒduo, huíqu wǒmen xiān bié gàosu āyí, gěi tā yī gè jīngxǐ!
turns.en: OK. Chen Ming, Duoduo, let's not tell Auntie when we get back. It'll be a surprise!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 我保证不说！
turns.pinyin: wǒ bǎozhèng bù shuō!
turns.en: I promise I won't say a word!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我妈看见你读《红楼梦》，肯定比看电视剧还高兴！
turns.pinyin: wǒ mā kànjiàn nǐ dú Hónglóumèng, kěndìng bǐ kàn diànshìjù hái gāoxìng!
turns.en: When my mum sees you reading Dream of the Red Chamber, she'll be even happier than when she's watching the series!

dialogues.title: The more I climb, the more tired I get!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 到了！你们三个走上去吧，我坐缆车，在上面等你们。
turns.pinyin: dào le! nǐmen sān gè zǒu shàngqu ba, wǒ zuò lǎnchē, zài shàng miàn děng nǐmen.
turns.en: We're here! You three walk up. I'll take the cable car and wait for you at the top.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，您不跟我们一起爬吗？
turns.pinyin: shūshu, nín bù gēn wǒmen yīqǐ pá ma?
turns.en: Aren't you climbing with us?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我年轻的时候爬过好多次了，现在膝盖不行了。你们慢慢爬，注意安全！朵朵，不要跑！
turns.pinyin: wǒ niánqīng de shíhou pá guo hǎoduō cì le, xiànzài xīgài bùxíng le. nǐmen mànmàn pá, zhùyì ānquán! Duǒduo, bù yào pǎo!
turns.en: I climbed it lots of times when I was young. My knees aren't up to it now. Take your time, and be careful! Duoduo, no running!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈明，这些台阶怎么越来越陡？我越爬越累！
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng, zhèxiē táijiē zěnme yuèláiyuè dǒu? wǒ yuè pá yuè lèi!
turns.en: Chen Ming, why are these steps getting steeper and steeper? The more I climb, the more tired I get!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 这才刚开始呢！你看上面，还有好几个烽火台。
turns.pinyin: zhè cái gāng kāishǐ ne! nǐ kàn shàng miàn, hái yǒu hǎojǐ gè fēnghuǒtái.
turns.en: We've only just started! Look up there: there are still several watchtowers to go.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我在伦敦天天跑步，怎么爬了二十分钟就不行了？
turns.pinyin: wǒ zài lúndūn tiān tiān pǎobù, zěnme pá le èr shí fēnzhōng jiù bùxíng le?
turns.en: I run every day in London. How come I'm done in after twenty minutes?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 跑步跟爬长城不一样。来，喝口水，休息一下。你看，风景多美！
turns.pinyin: pǎobù gēn pá Chángchéng bù yīyàng. lái, hē kǒu shuǐ, xiūxi yīxià. nǐ kàn, fēngjǐng duō měi!
turns.en: Running isn't the same as climbing the Great Wall. Here, have some water and take a break. Look, what a view!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哇！长城好像一条龙，从这座山一直到那座山。
turns.pinyin: wa! Chángchéng hǎoxiàng yī tiáo lóng, cóng zhè zuò shān yīzhí dào nà zuò shān.
turns.en: Wow! The Wall's like a dragon, running from this mountain all the way to that one.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 听说野长城更漂亮，可是很危险，很多地方也不让爬。咱们还是爬这段吧。
turns.pinyin: tīngshuō yěchángchéng gèng piàoliang, kěshì hěn wēixiǎn, hěnduō dìfang yě bùràng pá. zánmen háishi pá zhè duàn ba.
turns.en: They say the wild Wall's even more beautiful, but it's dangerous, and you're not allowed on a lot of it. We'll stick to this stretch.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对，安全第一！……还有多远？我的腿都不是自己的了！
turns.pinyin: duì, ānquándìyī! hái yǒu duō yuǎn? wǒ de tuǐ dōu bùshì zìjǐ de le!
turns.en: Right, safety first! ...How much further? I can't feel my legs!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，加油！前面那个烽火台就是最高的地方。我一点儿也不累，我先上去等你们！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, jiāyóu! qiánmiàn nàge fēnghuǒtái jiùshì zuì gāo de dìfang. wǒ yīdiǎnr yěbù lèi, wǒ xiān shàngqu děng nǐmen!
turns.en: Come on, Mark! That watchtower up ahead is the highest point. I'm not tired at all. I'll go up first and wait for you!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 终于到了！累死了！……咦，叔叔，您怎么已经在这儿了？
turns.pinyin: zhōngyú dào le! lèisǐle! yí, shūshu, nín zěnme yǐjīng zài zhèr le?
turns.en: We're finally here! I'm exhausted! ...Hang on, how are you already here?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我坐缆车上来的，保温杯里的茶都喝完了！朵朵也等了半天了。你们怎么才来？
turns.pinyin: wǒ zuò lǎnchē shànglai de, bǎowēnbēi lǐ de chá dōu hē wán le! Duǒduo yě děng le bàntiān le. nǐmen zěnme cái lái?
turns.en: I came up on the cable car, and I've already finished the tea in my flask! Duoduo's been waiting for ages too. What took you so long?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，下山的时候我也坐缆车！
turns.pinyin: shūshu, xiàshān de shíhou wǒ yě zuò lǎnchē!
turns.en: When we go down, I'm taking the cable car too!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 马克，你怎么了？脸色这么难看。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ zěnmele? liǎnsè zhème nánkàn.
turns.en: Mark, what's up? You look awful.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 别提了，今天倒霉死了！我的手机被偷了！
turns.pinyin: biétíle, jīntiān dǎoméi sǐ le! wǒ de shǒujī bèi tōu le!
turns.en: Don't ask. Today's been a total disaster! My phone's been stolen!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 啊？在哪儿被偷的？
turns.pinyin: a? zài nǎr bèi tōu de?
turns.en: What? Where did it get stolen?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 在地铁上。下班的时候人多得要命，出站一摸口袋，手机没了！
turns.pinyin: zài dìtiě shang. xiàbān de shíhou rén duō de yàomìng, chūzhàn yī mō kǒudai, shǒujī méile!
turns.en: On the Tube. It was absolutely packed after work, and when I came out of the station I felt my pocket and it was gone!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你是不是放在裤子后面的口袋里了？
turns.pinyin: nǐ shì bùshì fàng zài kùzi hòumiàn de kǒudai lǐ le?
turns.en: Did you have it in your back trouser pocket?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 让你说对了……
turns.pinyin: ràng nǐ shuōduì le
turns.en: You guessed it...

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你怎么全身都湿了？
turns.pinyin: nǐ zěnme quánshēn dōu shī le?
turns.en: And why are you soaked from head to toe?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 早上出门忘了带伞，被雨淋湿了。到了公司又迟到了，被老板批评了一顿。
turns.pinyin: zǎoshang chūmén wàng le dài sǎn, bèi yǔ lín shī le. dào le gōngsī yòu chídào le, bèi lǎobǎn pīpíng le yī dùn.
turns.en: I forgot my umbrella this morning and got drenched. Then I was late for work and got a telling-off from my boss.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，你今天真是个倒霉蛋！先坐下，喝碗热汤。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, nǐ jīntiān zhēnshi gè dǎoméidàn! xiān zuòxia, hē wǎn rè tāng.
turns.en: Ha ha, you really are having a bad day! Sit down and have some hot soup.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨，您还笑！手机壳里还有一张银行卡呢，不会被人用了吧？
turns.pinyin: āyí, nín hái xiào! shǒujīké lǐ hái yǒu yī zhāng yínhángkǎ ne, bù huì bèi rén yòng le ba?
turns.en: It's not funny! There's a bank card in my phone case too. Nobody's going to use it, are they?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 别着急。先给银行打电话，把卡挂失。然后上网把手机锁了，这样小偷就用不了了。
turns.pinyin: bié zháojí. xiān gěi yínháng dǎdiànhuà, bǎ kǎ guàshī. ránhòu shàngwǎng bǎ shǒujī suǒ le, zhèyàng xiǎotōu jiù yòngbuliǎo le.
turns.en: Don't panic. First ring the bank and report the card lost. Then go online and lock the phone, so the thief can't use it.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 还有，得去报警。明天上午我爸爸陪你去警察局，就在唐人街附近。
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu, děi qù bàojǐng. míngtiān shàngwǔ wǒ bàba péi nǐ qù jǐngchájú, jiù zài Tángrénjiē fùjìn.
turns.en: And you need to report it to the police. My dad will go to the police station with you tomorrow morning. It's just by Chinatown.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 报警有用吗？手机肯定找不回来了。
turns.pinyin: bàojǐng yǒuyòng ma? shǒujī kěndìng zhǎo bu huílai le.
turns.en: Is there any point? I'm never going to get the phone back.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 找不回来也得报。没有警察的记录，保险公司不会赔你的。
turns.pinyin: zhǎo bu huílai yě děi bào. méiyǒu jǐngchá de jìlù, bǎoxiǎngōngsī bù huì péi nǐ de.
turns.en: You still have to report it. Without a police record, the insurance company won't pay out.

dialogues.title: You're here to report a crime?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 来报案的人真不少。我们先看看这张表吧，我在华人中心常常帮别人填。我问，你说，就当我是警官。你是来报案的吧？什么东西被偷了？
turns.pinyin: lái bào'àn de rén zhēn bù shǎo. wǒmen xiān kàn kan zhè zhāng biǎo ba, wǒ zài Huárénzhōngxīn chángcháng bāng biéren tián. wǒ wèn, nǐ shuō, jiù dàng wǒ shì jǐngguān. nǐ shì lái bào'àn de ba? shénme dōngxi bèi tōu le?
turns.en: What a lot of people reporting crimes. Let's look at this form first. I often help people fill it in at the community centre. I'll ask, you answer, as if I were the officer. You're here to report a crime, I take it? What was stolen?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我的手机。昨天晚上六点半左右，在北线地铁上被偷的。
turns.pinyin: wǒ de shǒujī. zuótiān wǎnshang liù diǎn bàn zuǒyòu, zài Běixiàn dìtiě shang bèi tōu de.
turns.en: My phone. At about half past six yesterday evening, on the Northern line.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 什么样的手机？
turns.pinyin: shénmeyàng de shǒujī?
turns.en: What kind of phone?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 黑色的，买了一年多了。外面有一个蓝色的手机壳，壳里还有一张银行卡。
turns.pinyin: hēisè de, mǎi le yī nián duōle. wàimiàn yǒu yī gè lánsè de shǒujīké, ké lǐ hái yǒu yī zhāng yínhángkǎ.
turns.en: A black one. I've had it just over a year. It's got a blue case on it, and there's a bank card in the case too.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 银行卡挂失了吗？
turns.pinyin: yínhángkǎ guàshī le ma?
turns.en: Have you reported the card lost?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 昨天晚上就挂失了，手机也在网上锁了。
turns.pinyin: zuótiān wǎnshang jiù guàshī le, shǒujī yě zài wǎngshang suǒ le.
turns.en: I did it last night, and I locked the phone online too.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 很好。下一个问题：你当时有没有注意到身边有什么奇怪的人？
turns.pinyin: hěn hǎo. xià yī gè wèntí: nǐ dāngshí yǒu méiyǒu zhùyìdào shēnbiān yǒu shénme qíguài de rén?
turns.en: Good. Next question: did you notice anyone odd near you at the time?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 没有。车厢里特别挤，我一直在看书，什么都没注意到。
turns.pinyin: méiyǒu. chēxiāng lǐ tèbié jǐ, wǒ yīzhí zài kàn shū, shénme dōu méi zhùyìdào.
turns.en: No. The carriage was really crowded and I was reading the whole time. I didn't notice a thing.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 在那么挤的车上还看书？你啊！
turns.pinyin: zài nàme jǐ de chē shang hái kàn shū? nǐ a!
turns.en: Reading, on a train that packed? Honestly, you!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，这种事多吗？
turns.pinyin: shūshu, zhè zhǒng shì duō ma?
turns.en: Uncle, does this happen a lot?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 不少。前年我的钱包也叫人偷了，到现在也没找到。小偷一般在上下车的时候下手，人越多，越容易被偷。
turns.pinyin: bù shǎo. qián nián wǒ de qiánbāo yě jiào rén tōu le, dào xiànzài yě méi zhǎodào. xiǎotōu yībān zài shàng xiàchē de shíhou xiàshǒu, rén yuè duō, yuè róngyì bèi tōu.
turns.en: Quite a lot. My wallet got nicked the year before last too, and it's never turned up. Thieves usually strike when people are getting on and off. The more crowded it is, the easier it is to get robbed.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我的手机还找得回来吗？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ de shǒujī hái zhǎo de huílai ma?
turns.en: So is there any chance of getting my phone back?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 说实话，希望不大。你先把这张表填了，警察有消息会马上通知你。……哎，这些话你都会用中文说了，不错嘛！
turns.pinyin: shuōshíhuà, xīwàng bù dà. nǐ xiān bǎ zhè zhāng biǎo tián le, jǐngchá yǒu xiāoxi huì mǎshàng tōngzhī nǐ. āi, zhèxiē huà nǐ dōu huì yòng zhōngwén shuō le, bùcuò ma!
turns.en: To be honest, not much. Fill in this form first, and if the police hear anything they'll let you know straight away. ...Hey, you can say all this in Chinese now. Not bad!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 学了快两年了。下个月我还要用中文给一个上海的客户讲我们的设计呢。
turns.pinyin: xué le kuài liǎng nián le. xià gè yuè wǒ hái yào yòng zhōngwén gěi yī gè Shànghǎi de kèhù jiǎng wǒmen de shèjì ne.
turns.en: I've been learning for nearly two years. Next month I'm presenting our designs to a client in Shanghai, in Chinese.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那祝你一切顺利！手机丢了还能再买，学会的中文可是谁也偷不走的。
turns.pinyin: nà zhù nǐ yī qiè shùnlì! shǒujī diū le hái néng zài mǎi, xuéhuì de zhōngwén kěshì shéi yě tōubuzǒu de.
turns.en: Then good luck with it! You can always buy another phone, but the Chinese you've learned, nobody can steal that.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，准备得怎么样了？明天上午就要讲了吧？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, zhǔnbèi de zěnmeyàng le? míngtiān shàngwǔ jiù yào jiǎng le ba?
turns.en: Mark, how's it going? You're presenting tomorrow morning, aren't you?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 别问了，我现在头都晕了。伦敦上午九点，上海下午五点，福和的王经理和他的同事都会在视频上看我讲。
turns.pinyin: bié wèn le, wǒ xiànzài tóu dōu yūn le. lúndūn shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn, Shànghǎi xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn, Fúhé de Wángjīnglǐ hé tā de tóngshì dōu huì zài shìpín shang kàn wǒ jiǎng.
turns.en: Don't ask. My head's spinning. Nine in the morning here, five in the afternoon in Shanghai, and Manager Wang from Fuhe and his colleagues will all be watching me on video.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 老板为什么让你讲？
turns.pinyin: lǎobǎn wèishénme ràng nǐ jiǎng?
turns.en: Why has your boss asked you to do it?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 福和是我们第一个上海的客户。老板说我会说中文，以后就让我跟他们联系。这是我第一次用中文给客户讲方案。
turns.pinyin: Fúhé shì wǒmen dì yī gè Shànghǎi de kèhù. lǎobǎn shuō wǒ huì shuō zhōngwén, yǐhòu jiù ràng wǒ gēn tāmen liánxì. zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì yòng zhōngwén gěi kèhù jiǎng fāng'àn.
turns.en: Fuhe is our first client in Shanghai. My boss says since I speak Chinese, I'll be the one dealing with them from now on. It's the first time I've presented a proposal to a client in Chinese.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那你先给我讲一遍，我就是王经理。
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ xiān gěi wǒ jiǎng yī biàn, wǒ jiùshì Wángjīnglǐ.
turns.en: Then run through it for me first. I'll be Manager Wang.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好……王经理，您好！福和的点心有一百多年的历史，为了让英国的年轻人也对它感兴趣……哎，下面那句我明明背过，怎么想不起来了？
turns.pinyin: hǎo Wángjīnglǐ, nín hǎo! Fúhé de diǎnxin yǒu yī bǎi duō nián de lìshǐ, wèile ràng yīngguó de niánqīngrén yě duì tā gǎnxìngqù āi, xià miàn nà jù wǒ míngmíng bèi guo, zěnme xiǎngbuqǐlai le?
turns.en: OK... Good afternoon, Manager Wang! Fuhe's pastries have more than a hundred years of history, and to get young people in Britain interested in them too... Argh, I've definitely learned the next line. Why can't I remember it?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 正常！紧张的时候谁都这样。别把每个字都背下来，这是你自己的设计，用自己的话说就行。
turns.pinyin: zhèngcháng! jǐnzhāng de shíhou shéi dōu zhèyàng. bié bǎ měi gè zì dōu bèi xialai, zhè shì nǐ zìjǐ de shèjì, yòng zìjǐ dehuà shuō jiù xíng.
turns.en: That's normal! It happens to everyone when they're nervous. Don't try to learn every word by heart. It's your own design, so just say it in your own words.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 为了明天，我每天早上在地铁上背生词，晚上还把要说的话都写出来，每句都练了好几遍。
turns.pinyin: wèile míngtiān, wǒ měitiān zǎoshang zài dìtiě shang bèi shēngcí, wǎnshang hái bǎ yào shuō dehuà dōu xiěchulai, měi jù dōu liàn le hǎojǐ biàn.
turns.en: For tomorrow, I've been learning new words on the Tube every morning, and in the evenings I've written out everything I want to say and practised every line again and again.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你对中文这么感兴趣，又这么努力，明天一定没问题。
turns.pinyin: nǐ duì zhōngwén zhème gǎnxìngqù, yòu zhème nǔlì, míngtiān yīdìng méiwèntí.
turns.en: You're so interested in Chinese, and you've worked so hard. You'll be fine tomorrow.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 希望吧。讲还行，我就怕他们问问题。上海人说话快，我的听力……要是听不懂，就太没面子了。
turns.pinyin: xīwàng ba. jiǎng háixíng, wǒ jiù pà tāmen wèn wèntí. Shànghǎi rén shuōhuà kuài, wǒ de tīnglì yàoshi tīng bu dǒng, jiù tài méimiànzi le.
turns.en: I hope so. The talking's OK. It's their questions I'm worried about. People in Shanghai talk fast, and my listening... If I can't understand them, I'll look such an idiot.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 听不懂就请他们再说一遍，这不丢面子。对客户来说，你用中文讲，就已经很给他们面子了。
turns.pinyin: tīng bu dǒng jiù qǐng tāmen zàishuō yī biàn, zhè bù diū miànzi. duì kèhù lái shuō, nǐ yòng zhōngwén jiǎng, jiù yǐjīng hěn gěi tāmen miànzi le.
turns.en: If you don't understand, ask them to say it again. You won't lose face. For a client, the very fact that you're presenting in Chinese shows them real respect.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，记住了。对了，你那个面试怎么样了？
turns.pinyin: hǎo, jìzhù le. duìle, nǐ nàge miànshì zěnmeyàng le?
turns.en: OK, got it. Oh, by the way, how did your interview go?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 墨尔本那家公司？下个星期二第二次面试，我也紧张得要命。
turns.pinyin: Mò'ěrběn nà jiā gōngsī? xià gè xīngqī èr dì èr cì miànshì, wǒ yě jǐnzhāng de yàomìng.
turns.en: The company in Melbourne? The second interview's next Tuesday, and I'm a nervous wreck too.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那我们俩今天都别想了！明天讲完了，我请你吃火锅，庆祝一下！
turns.pinyin: nà wǒmen liǎ jīntiān dōu bié xiǎng le! míngtiān jiǎng wán le, wǒ qǐng nǐ chī huǒguō, qìngzhù yīxià!
turns.en: Then let's both stop thinking about it today! Once tomorrow's over, I'll take you for hotpot to celebrate!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，福和回复了没有？快查查邮件！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, Fúhé huífù le méiyǒu? kuài chá cha yóujiàn!
turns.en: Mark, has Fuhe replied? Go on, check your email!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 回复了，可是我不敢看……阿姨，您帮我看吧。
turns.pinyin: huífù le, kěshì wǒ bù gǎn kàn āyí, nín bāng wǒ kàn ba.
turns.en: They have, but I daren't look... Auntie, you look for me.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 好……“我们对你们的方案非常满意，方案通过了！”还有一句：“马克，你的中文讲得很好，我给你打满分！”
turns.pinyin: hǎo wǒmen duì nǐmen de fāng'àn fēicháng mǎnyì, fāng'àn tōngguò le! hái yǒu yī jù: Mǎkè, nǐ de zhōngwén jiǎng de hěn hǎo, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ mǎnfēn!
turns.en: OK... 'We are very pleased with your proposal, and it has been approved!' And there's one more line: 'Mark, you presented very well in Chinese. I'd give you full marks!'

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 真的？我们的方案真的通过了！
turns.pinyin: zhēnde? wǒmen de fāng'àn zhēnde tōngguò le!
turns.en: Really? Our proposal's really been approved!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 太棒了！今天这顿我请！
turns.pinyin: tài bàng le! jīntiān zhè dùn wǒ qǐng!
turns.en: Brilliant! Tonight's meal is on me!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，你进步真大。我记得第一次见你的时候，你只会说“你好”和“谢谢”。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ jìnbù zhēn dà. wǒ jìde dì yī cì jiàn nǐ de shíhou, nǐ zhǐ huì shuō nǐhǎo hé xièxie.
turns.en: Mark, you've come so far. I remember when I first met you, all you could say was 'hello' and 'thank you'.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哪里哪里，还差得远呢。那天王经理说话太快，我只听懂了大部分。
turns.pinyin: nǎlǐnǎlǐ, hái chàdeyuǎn ne. nà tiān Wángjīnglǐ shuōhuà tài kuài, wǒ zhǐ tīngdǒng le dàbùfen.
turns.en: Oh, not really, I've still got a long way to go. Manager Wang talked so fast that day, I only understood most of it.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 你别客气了！朵朵在中文学校学了三年汉字了，可是一写作业就头疼。你有什么经验？给她介绍介绍。
turns.pinyin: nǐ bié kèqi le! Duǒduo zài zhōngwén xuéxiào xué le sān nián hànzì le, kěshì yī xiě zuòyè jiù tóuténg. nǐ yǒu shénme jīngyàn? gěi tā jièshào jièshào.
turns.en: Don't be so modest! Duoduo's been learning characters at Chinese school for three years, and she still gets a headache as soon as she does her homework. What's your secret? Tell her about it.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我的经验就是每天学一点儿，一天也别停。还有，多跟中国朋友聊天。
turns.pinyin: wǒ de jīngyàn jiùshì měitiān xué yīdiǎnr, yī tiān yě bié tíng. hái yǒu, duō gēn zhōngguó péngyou liáotiān.
turns.en: What worked for me was learning a bit every day, and never missing a day. And chatting with Chinese friends as much as you can.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 说得容易！你每天在地铁上有半个小时，我上哪儿找时间？
turns.pinyin: shuōderóngyì! nǐ měitiān zài dìtiě shang yǒu bàn gè xiǎoshí, wǒ shàngnǎr zhǎo shíjiān?
turns.en: Easy for you to say! You get half an hour on the Tube every day. Where am I supposed to find the time?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 少看一会儿视频，时间就有了！其实马克最大的优点是不怕说错。说错了，改过来就行了。
turns.pinyin: shǎo kàn yīhuìr shìpín, shíjiān jiù yǒu le! qíshí Mǎkè zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì bù pà shuōcuò. shuōcuò le, gǎiguolai jiù xíng le.
turns.en: Watch a few less videos and you'll have the time! Actually, Mark's biggest strength is that he's not afraid of making mistakes. If you get it wrong, you just put it right.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 对！他第一次来我的饭馆，把“水饺”说成了“睡觉”！
turns.pinyin: duì! tā dì yī cì lái wǒ de fànguǎn, bǎ shuǐjiǎo shuōchéng le shuìjiào!
turns.en: That's right! The first time he came to my restaurant, he said 'sleep' instead of 'dumplings'!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 别提了！……叔叔，为了庆祝，今天我请客！
turns.pinyin: biétíle! shūshu, wèile qìngzhù, jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè!
turns.en: Don't remind me! ...Uncle, to celebrate, tonight's on me!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 在我们家的饭馆？你别想了，我爸爸每次都这样！
turns.pinyin: zài wǒmen jiā de fànguǎn? nǐ bié xiǎng le, wǒ bàba měi cì dōu zhèyàng!
turns.en: In our family's restaurant? Forget it. My dad's always like this!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克？这么巧！你也来唐人街买东西？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè? zhème qiǎo! nǐ yě lái Tángrénjiē mǎi dōngxi?
turns.en: Mark? What a coincidence! You're shopping in Chinatown too?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨！叔叔！好久不见！你们也来买菜？
turns.pinyin: āyí! shūshu! hǎojiǔbùjiàn! nǐmen yě lái mǎi cài?
turns.en: Auntie! Uncle! Long time no see! Are you shopping for food too?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 我们来买点儿调料，今天晚上你叔叔做饭。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen lái mǎi diǎnr tiáoliào, jīntiān wǎnshang nǐ shūshu zuòfàn.
turns.en: We've come to buy some seasonings. Your uncle's cooking tonight.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔都会做饭了？厉害！
turns.pinyin: shūshu dōu huì zuòfàn le? lìhai!
turns.en: Uncle can cook now? Impressive!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 刚学的，只会一个西红柿炒鸡蛋。你最近忙什么呢？好久没来饭馆了。
turns.pinyin: gāng xué de, zhǐ huì yī gè xīhóngshì chǎo jīdàn. nǐ zuìjìn máng shénme ne? hǎojiǔ méi lái fànguǎn le.
turns.en: I've only just learned. The only thing I can make is tomato and egg. What have you been up to? You haven't been to the restaurant for ages.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 忙死了，公司最近项目特别多，天天加班。
turns.pinyin: máng sǐ le, gōngsī zuìjìn xiàngmù tèbié duō, tiān tiān jiābān.
turns.en: I've been rushed off my feet. We've got loads of projects at work, and I'm working late every day.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 年轻人别太累了。哎，我们好久没聚了，改天聚聚吧！
turns.pinyin: niánqīngrén bié tài lèi le. āi, wǒmen hǎojiǔ méi jù le, gǎitiān jùju ba!
turns.en: You young people shouldn't wear yourselves out. Hey, we haven't got together for ages. Let's meet up some time!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你每次都说“改天”，最后都没聚成。
turns.pinyin: nǐ měi cì dōu shuō gǎitiān, zuìhòu dōu méi jùchéng.
turns.en: You always say 'some time', and it never actually happens.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 说得对。那我们现在就约个时间吧。马克，下个星期六晚上怎么样？
turns.pinyin: shuō de duì. nà wǒmen xiànzài jiù yuē gè shíjiān ba. Mǎkè, xià gè xīngqī liù wǎnshang zěnmeyàng?
turns.en: Fair point. So let's fix a time right now. Mark, how about next Saturday evening?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 下星期六我好像有事……我先看看，有空再说？
turns.pinyin: xià xīngqī liù wǒ hǎoxiàng yǒushì wǒ xiān kàn kan, yǒukòngzàishuō?
turns.en: I think I've got something on next Saturday... Let me check, and we'll see?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 又是“有空再说”！这次不行，下星期六是朵朵的十岁生日，她天天问你来不来。
turns.pinyin: yòu shì yǒukòngzàishuō! zhè cì bùxíng, xià xīngqī liù shì Duǒduo de shí suì shēngrì, tā tiān tiān wèn nǐ lái bù lái.
turns.en: 'We'll see' again! Not this time. Next Saturday is Duoduo's tenth birthday, and she asks every day whether you're coming.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 啊？朵朵都十岁了？那我一定去！去哪儿吃，你们定吧。
turns.pinyin: a? Duǒduo dōu shí suì le? nà wǒ yīdìng qù! qù nǎr chī, nǐmen dìng ba.
turns.en: What? Duoduo's ten already? Then I'll definitely come! You two decide where we eat.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 就去老成都吧，七点。我叫上小雨。不见不散！
turns.pinyin: jiù qù Lǎochéngdū ba, qī diǎn. wǒ jiàoshang Xiǎoyǔ. bùjiànbùsàn!
turns.en: Let's go to Lao Chengdu, at seven. I'll ask Xiaoyu. Be there!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 不见不散！回头见！
turns.pinyin: bùjiànbùsàn! huítóujiàn!
turns.en: I'll be there! See you!

dialogues.title: Why are you all staring at me?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 喂，朵朵，我到老成都了！今天我第一个到吧？
turns.pinyin: wèi, Duǒduo, wǒ dào Lǎochéngdū le! jīntiān wǒ dì yī gè dào ba?
turns.en: Hi, Duoduo, I'm at Lao Chengdu! I'm first today, right?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 太阳从西边出来了！可惜我们早就到了。你往里走，看见楼梯了吗？
turns.pinyin: tàiyángcóngxībiānchūlaile! kěxī wǒmen zǎojiù dào le. nǐ wǎng lǐ zǒu, kànjiàn lóutī le ma?
turns.en: Wonders will never cease! Shame we got here ages ago. Go on in. Can you see the stairs?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 看见了。楼梯口站着一个服务员。
turns.pinyin: kànjiàn le. lóutīkǒu zhàn zhe yī gè fúwùyuán.
turns.en: Yes. There's a waiter standing at the bottom of the stairs.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 我们在楼上的包间，门开着，你直接上来吧。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen zài lóushàng de bāojiān, mén kāi zhe, nǐ zhíjiē shànglai ba.
turns.en: We're in the private room upstairs. The door's open, just come straight up.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: ……大家好！朵朵，生日快乐！哇，桌子上已经放着这么多菜了！
turns.pinyin: dàjiā hǎo! Duǒduo, shēngrì kuàilè! wa, zhuōzi shang yǐjīng fàng zhe zhème duō cài le!
turns.en: ...Hi, everyone! Happy birthday, Duoduo! Wow, there's already so much food on the table!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克，快坐！小雨呢？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, kuài zuò! Xiǎoyǔ ne?
turns.en: Mark, sit down! Where's Xiaoyu?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨说她路上堵车，马上就到。陈明呢？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ shuō tā lùshang dǔchē, mǎshàng jiù dào. Chénmíng ne?
turns.en: Xiaoyu says she's stuck in traffic and she'll be here any minute. Where's Chen Ming?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 星期六饭馆太忙，他八点以前来不了，让我们替他多吃点儿。
turns.pinyin: xīngqī liù fànguǎn tài máng, tā bā diǎn yǐqián láibuliǎo, ràng wǒmen tì tā duō chī diǎnr.
turns.en: The restaurant's too busy on a Saturday. He can't get here before eight, and he says we should eat a bit extra for him.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克，小雨在墨尔本找的那个工作，有消息了吗？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, Xiǎoyǔ zài Mò'ěrběn zhǎo de nàge gōngzuò, yǒu xiāoxi le ma?
turns.en: Mark, that job Xiaoyu went for in Melbourne: is there any news?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 不知道。第二次面试以后，她已经等了一个多月了。
turns.pinyin: bù zhīdào. dì èr cì miànshì yǐhòu, tā yǐjīng děng le yī gè duō yuè le.
turns.en: I don't know. She's been waiting for more than a month since the second interview.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对不起，我来晚了！……咦，你们都看着我干什么？
turns.pinyin: duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le! yí, nǐmen dōu kàn zhe wǒ gàn shénme?
turns.en: Sorry I'm late! ...Huh, why are you all staring at me?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 你手里拿着什么？好漂亮的花！
turns.pinyin: nǐ shǒuli ná zhe shénme? hǎo piàoliang de huā!
turns.en: What have you got there? What beautiful flowers!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 送给你的，朵朵，生日快乐！还有，我也有个消息要告诉大家：墨尔本那家公司要我了！七月我就要走了。
turns.pinyin: sòng gěi nǐ de, Duǒduo, shēngrì kuàilè! hái yǒu, wǒ yě yǒu gè xiāoxi yào gàosu dàjiā: Mò'ěrběn nà jiā gōngsī yào wǒ le! qī yuè wǒ jiù yào zǒu le.
turns.en: They're for you, Duoduo. Happy birthday! And I've got some news for everyone too: the company in Melbourne has offered me the job! I'm leaving in July.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 墨尔本？那么远……
turns.pinyin: Mò'ěrběn? nàme yuǎn
turns.en: Melbourne? That's so far away...

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 朵朵，怎么不高兴了？是中文学校的作业吗？别着急，坐下慢慢说。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo, zěnme bù gāoxìng le? shì zhōngwén xuéxiào de zuòyè ma? bié zháojí, zuòxia mànmàn shuō.
turns.en: Duoduo, why the long face? Is it your Chinese school homework? Don't panic. Sit down and tell me about it.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 是汉字。我……学了三年了，还是写不好。
turns.pinyin: shì hànzì. wǒ xué le sān nián le, háishi xiě bu hǎo.
turns.en: It's the characters. I've... been learning them for three years, and I still can't write them properly.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哦，你学了三年汉字了？我看看……写得很好啊！
turns.pinyin: ó, nǐ xué le sān nián hànzì le? wǒ kàn kan xiě de hěn hǎo a!
turns.en: Oh, you've been learning characters for three years? Let me see... You write really well!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 谢谢。可是……老师发的故事，我看不懂。字太多了。
turns.pinyin: xièxie. kěshì lǎoshī fā de gùshi, wǒ kàn bu dǒng. zì tài duōle.
turns.en: Thank you. But... the stories the teacher gives us, I can't read them. Too many characters.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我刚开始的时候也看不懂。你知道吗？我第一次来这儿，站在门口不敢进来，是小雨走过来问我：“请问，你是马克吗？”
turns.pinyin: wǒ gāng kāishǐ de shíhou yě kàn bu dǒng. nǐ zhīdào ma? wǒ dì yī cì lái zhèr, zhàn zài ménkǒu bù gǎn jìnlai, shì Xiǎoyǔ zǒuguòlai wèn wǒ: qǐngwèn, nǐ shì Mǎkè ma?
turns.en: I couldn't read anything at first either. You know what? The first time I came here, I stood at the door and didn't dare come in. Xiaoyu walked over and asked me: 'Excuse me, are you Mark?'

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对，那天他紧张得说不出话来，连自己姓什么都忘了。
turns.pinyin: duì, nà tiān tā jǐnzhāng de shuōbuchūhuàlai, lián zìjǐ xìng shénme dōu wàng le.
turns.en: That's right. He was so nervous that day he couldn't get a word out. He even forgot his own surname.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 我记得！那天我也在。你现在说得这么好！你有什么……秘诀？
turns.pinyin: wǒ jìde! nà tiān wǒ yě zài. nǐ xiànzài shuō de zhème hǎo! nǐ yǒu shénme mìjué?
turns.en: I remember! I was there that day. You speak so well now! Have you got a... secret?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 秘诀？第一，多听。我每天在地铁上听中文播客，已经听了两年了。
turns.pinyin: mìjué? dì yī, duō tīng. wǒ měitiān zài dìtiě shang tīng zhōngwén bōkè, yǐjīng tīng le liǎng nián le.
turns.en: A secret? First, listen a lot. I listen to Chinese podcasts on the Tube every day. I've been doing it for two years.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 播客？我都听得懂，可是听了也不会写啊。
turns.pinyin: bōkè? wǒ dōu tīngdedǒng, kěshì tīng le yě bù huì xiě a.
turns.en: Podcasts? I can understand all of those, but listening won't teach me to write.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那你就多看。先看简单的故事，看不懂就多看几遍。第二，别怕写错。我写错过很多次，可是写错了才记得住。
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ jiù duō kàn. xiān kàn jiǎndān de gùshi, kàn bu dǒng jiù duō kàn jǐ biàn. dì èr, bié pà xiě cuò. wǒ xiě cuò guo hěnduō cì, kěshì xiě cuò le cái jìdezhù.
turns.en: Then read a lot. Start with easy stories, and if you don't understand, read them a few more times. Second, don't be afraid of writing things wrong. I've got things wrong loads of times, but that's how you remember them.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 可是汉字太难了，我老是记不住。
turns.pinyin: kěshì hànzì tài nán le, wǒ lǎoshi jìbuzhù.
turns.en: But characters are so hard. I can never remember them.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我也是一个一个慢慢记住的。我从去年开始写中文日记，现在写得快多了。你也试试，每天写三句话。
turns.pinyin: wǒ yěshì yīgèyīgè mànmàn jìzhù de. wǒ cóng qùnián kāishǐ xiě zhōngwén rìjì, xiànzài xiě de kuài duōle. nǐ yě shì shi, měitiān xiě sān jù huà.
turns.en: I learned them slowly too, one at a time. I started keeping a diary in Chinese last year, and now I write much faster. Give it a try: three sentences a day.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 好，我今天回去就开始写！谢谢你，马克老师！
turns.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ jīntiān huíqu jiù kāishǐ xiě! xièxie nǐ, Mǎkè lǎoshī!
turns.en: OK, I'll start as soon as I get home today! Thank you, Teacher Mark!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克老师？……马克，你看，现在轮到你帮别人了。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè lǎoshī? Mǎkè, nǐ kàn, xiànzài lúndào nǐ bāng biéren le.
turns.en: Teacher Mark? ...Mark, look, now it's your turn to help someone.

dialogues.title: The best coffee I've ever had!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 怎么样？这是我在墨尔本最喜欢的一家咖啡馆。
turns.pinyin: zěnmeyàng? zhè shì wǒ zài Mò'ěrběn zuì xǐhuan de yī jiā kāfēiguǎn.
turns.en: Well? This is my favourite café in Melbourne.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哇，这杯澳白太香了！这可能是我喝过最好的咖啡。
turns.pinyin: wa, zhè bēi àobái tài xiāng le! zhè kěnéng shì wǒ hē guo zuìhǎo de kāfēi.
turns.en: Wow, this flat white smells amazing! It might be the best coffee I've ever had.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我就说吧！在我看来，墨尔本的咖啡比哪儿都好。
turns.pinyin: wǒjiùshuōba! zài wǒ kànlái, Mò'ěrběn de kāfēi bǐ nǎr dōu hǎo.
turns.en: Told you! If you ask me, Melbourne's coffee is better than anywhere's.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 伦敦的咖啡也不错啊。拿我们公司楼下那家来说，每天早上都排长队。
turns.pinyin: lúndūn de kāfēi yě bùcuò a. ná wǒmen gōngsī lóuxià nà jiā láishuō, měitiān zǎoshang dōu páichángduì.
turns.en: London coffee's not bad either. Take the place downstairs from my office: there's a long queue every morning.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那不见得。排队的人多，不一定说明咖啡好。墨尔本人对咖啡特别讲究，比如牛奶多热、咖啡多浓，都有自己的要求。
turns.pinyin: nà bùjiànde. páiduì de rén duō, bù yīdìng shuōmíng kāfēi hǎo. Mò'ěrběn rén duì kāfēi tèbié jiǎngjiu, bǐrú niúnǎi duō rè, kāfēi duō nóng, dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yāoqiú.
turns.en: Not necessarily. A long queue doesn't prove the coffee's good. Melbourne people are really fussy about coffee. How hot the milk is, how strong the coffee is: everyone has their own way.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好吧，咖啡你赢了。可是天气呢？昨天下飞机的时候热得要命，今天早上又这么凉快。
turns.pinyin: hǎo ba, kāfēi nǐ yíng le. kěshì tiānqì ne? zuótiān xià fēijī de shíhou rè de yàomìng, jīntiān zǎoshang yòu zhème liángkuai.
turns.en: All right, you win on coffee. But what about the weather? When I got off the plane yesterday it was boiling, and this morning it's so cool.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这就是墨尔本！大家都说这儿一天有四季，出门最好带件外套。
turns.pinyin: zhè jiùshì Mò'ěrběn! dàjiā dōu shuō zhèr yī tiān yǒu sìjì, chūmén zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào.
turns.en: That's Melbourne for you! Everyone says you get four seasons in one day here. It's best to take a jacket when you go out.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那跟伦敦差不多嘛，天气说变就变。
turns.pinyin: nà gēn lúndūn chàbuduō ma, tiānqì shuōbiànjiùbiàn.
turns.en: So it's much like London. The weather changes at the drop of a hat.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那可不一样。墨尔本的阳光比伦敦多得多，夏天下了班还能去海边游泳。在伦敦，你能想象吗？
turns.pinyin: nà kě bù yīyàng. Mò'ěrběn de yángguāng bǐ lúndūn duō deduō, xiàtiān xià le bān hái néng qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng. zài lúndūn, nǐ néng xiǎngxiàng ma?
turns.en: It's not the same at all. Melbourne gets far more sunshine than London. In summer you can go for a swim at the beach after work. Can you imagine that in London?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说真的，我认为两个城市各有各的好。伦敦的博物馆大部分都免费；墨尔本的生活节奏慢一点儿，人也更放松。
turns.pinyin: shuōzhēnde, wǒ rènwéi liǎng gè chéngshì gèyǒugèdehǎo. lúndūn de bówùguǎn dàbùfen dōu miǎnfèi; Mò'ěrběn de shēnghuó jiézòu màn yīdiǎnr, rén yě gèng fàngsōng.
turns.en: Seriously, I think each city has its good points. Most of London's museums are free, and in Melbourne life's a bit slower and people are more relaxed.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 有道理。那缺点呢？
turns.pinyin: yǒudàoli. nà quēdiǎn ne?
turns.en: Fair point. And the downsides?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 两个城市的房租都贵得要命！没有比这更让人头疼的了。
turns.pinyin: liǎng gè chéngshì de fángzū dōu guì de yàomìng! méiyǒubǐ zhè gèng ràng rén tóuténg dele.
turns.en: Rent's ridiculously expensive in both! Nothing's more of a headache than that.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这一点我完全同意。好，喝完咖啡，我带你去坐电车。市中心的电车是免费的！
turns.pinyin: zhèyīdiǎn wǒ wánquán tóngyì. hǎo, hē wán kāfēi, wǒ dài nǐ qù zuò diànchē. shìzhōngxīn de diànchē shì miǎnfèi de!
turns.en: I completely agree with you there. Right, when we've finished our coffee, I'll take you on a tram. The trams in the city centre are free!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 免费的？那再好不过了！
turns.pinyin: miǎnfèi de? nà zài hǎo bùguò le!
turns.en: Free? That couldn't be better!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 你们看，从花园里就看得见海！小雨，你帮我们找的这个房子真不错。
turns.pinyin: nǐmen kàn, cóng huāyuán lǐ jiù kàndejiàn hǎi! Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ bāng wǒmen zhǎo de zhège fángzi zhēn bùcuò.
turns.en: Look, you can see the sea from the garden! Xiaoyu, this house you found for us is really nice.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 离我家也近，走路十分钟就到了。我的室友回国过年了，马克正好住她的房间。
turns.pinyin: lí wǒ jiā yě jìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. wǒ de shìyǒu huíguó guònián le, Mǎkè zhènghǎo zhù tā de fángjiān.
turns.en: It's close to my place too, just ten minutes' walk. My flatmate's gone back to China for New Year, so Mark can have her room.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨常说，陈明做的饺子是全伦敦最好吃的。今天在墨尔本吃，也一样好吃！
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ cháng shuō, Chénmíng zuò de jiǎozi shì quán lúndūn zuì hǎochī de. jīntiān zài Mò'ěrběn chī, yě yīyàng hǎochī!
turns.en: Xiaoyu's always saying Chen Ming's dumplings are the best in the whole of London. They taste just as good in Melbourne!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那当然！不是我吹，全伦敦没有比我家饺子更地道的了。
turns.pinyin: nà dāngrán! bùshì wǒ chuī, quán lúndūn méiyǒubǐ wǒ jiā jiǎozi gèng dìdao dele.
turns.en: Of course! I'm not bragging, but there are no more authentic dumplings in London than mine.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈明，我和小雨今天一直在讨论，墨尔本好还是伦敦好。你觉得呢？
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng, wǒ hé Xiǎoyǔ jīntiān yīzhí zài tǎolùn, Mò'ěrběn hǎo háishi lúndūn hǎo. nǐ juéde ne?
turns.en: Chen Ming, Xiaoyu and I have been discussing all day whether Melbourne or London is better. What do you think?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 这还用问？当然是伦敦！拿吃的来说，伦敦什么菜都有，比如……
turns.pinyin: zhèháiyòngwèn? dāngrán shì lúndūn! ná chī de láishuō, lúndūn shénme cài dōu yǒu, bǐrú
turns.en: Need you ask? London, of course! Take food: London has every kind of food there is, for instance...

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 墨尔本也一样啊！这里的人来自世界各地，意大利菜、希腊菜、越南菜，想吃什么都有。
turns.pinyin: Mò'ěrběn yě yīyàng a! zhè lǐ de rén láizì shìjiè gèdì, yìdàlì cài, xīlà cài, yuènán cài, xiǎng chī shénme dōu yǒu.
turns.en: Melbourne's just the same! People here come from all over the world. Italian, Greek, Vietnamese: whatever you fancy, it's here.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那中国菜呢？伦敦的唐人街可热闹了，还有我们陈家饺子！
turns.pinyin: nà zhōngguó cài ne? lúndūn de Tángrénjiē kě rènao le, hái yǒu wǒmen Chénjiājiǎozi!
turns.en: What about Chinese food? London's Chinatown is really lively, and it's got Chen Family Dumplings!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 墨尔本的唐人街历史更长！一八五几年就有了，是淘金的时候来的华人建起来的。
turns.pinyin: Mò'ěrběn de Tángrénjiē lìshǐ gèng cháng! yī bāwǔ jǐ nián jiù yǒu le, shì táojīn de shíhou lái de huárén jiàn qǐlai de.
turns.en: Melbourne's Chinatown has a longer history! It's been here since the 1850s, built by the Chinese who came in the gold rush.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 是吗？这个我还真不知道。那天气呢？墨尔本的夏天热得受不了吧？
turns.pinyin: shì ma? zhège wǒ háizhēn bù zhīdào. nà tiānqì ne? Mò'ěrběn de xiàtiān rè de shòubuliǎo ba?
turns.en: Really? I honestly didn't know that. What about the weather, then? Melbourne must be unbearably hot in summer?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那倒是，有时候是挺热的。可是比北京的冬天舒服多了。去年春节在长城上，我冻得说不出话来！
turns.pinyin: nàdàoshì, yǒushíhou shì tǐng rè de. kěshì bǐ běijīng de dōngtiān shūfu duōle. qùnián chūnjié zài Chángchéng shang, wǒ dòng de shuōbuchūhuàlai!
turns.en: That's true, sometimes it's pretty hot. But it's much nicer than winter in Beijing. Last Spring Festival I was so cold on the Great Wall I couldn't speak!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 冷怎么了？在我看来，北京比哪儿都好。有长城，有京剧，伦敦和墨尔本都比不上！
turns.pinyin: lěng zěnmele? zài wǒ kànlái, běijīng bǐ nǎr dōu hǎo. yǒu Chángchéng, yǒu jīngjù, lúndūn hé Mò'ěrběn dōu bǐbushàng!
turns.en: What's wrong with cold? If you ask me, Beijing's better than anywhere. It's got the Great Wall and Beijing opera. London and Melbourne can't compare!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 好了好了，先吃饺子。我认为，哪个城市最好不重要，重要的是跟谁在一起。
turns.pinyin: hǎole hǎole, xiān chī jiǎozi. wǒ rènwéi, nǎge chéngshì zuìhǎo bù zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì gēn shéi zài yīqǐ.
turns.en: All right, all right, eat your dumplings. I reckon it doesn't matter which city is best. What matters is who you're with.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我完全同意！你们在哪儿，哪儿就是最好的城市。
turns.pinyin: wǒ wánquán tóngyì! nǐmen zài nǎr, nǎr jiùshì zuìhǎo de chéngshì.
turns.en: I couldn't agree more! Wherever you lot are, that's the best city.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，马克，你的中文越来越会说话了！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, Mǎkè, nǐ de zhōngwén yuèláiyuè huìshuōhuà le!
turns.en: Ha ha, Mark, your Chinese is getting smoother by the day!

dialogues.title: Is a panda a bear or a cat?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，我们班的小朋友看见你，都说“老外来了”。可是你一点儿也不老啊！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, wǒmen bān de xiǎopéngyou kànjiàn nǐ, dōu shuō lǎowài lái le. kěshì nǐ yīdiǎnr yěbù lǎo a!
turns.en: Mark, when the kids in our class saw you, they all said 'here comes the laowai'. But you're not old at all!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，谢谢！“老外”的“老”不是年纪大的意思。“老师”也不一定老嘛。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, xièxie! lǎowài de lǎo bùshì niánjì dà de yìsi. lǎoshī yě bù yīdìng lǎo ma.
turns.en: Ha ha, thank you! The 老 in 老外 doesn't mean 'old'. And a 老师 isn't necessarily old, either.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对。朵朵，今天老师教你们怎么“拆”词了吧？很多词是两个字组成的。
turns.pinyin: duì. Duǒduo, jīntiān lǎoshī jiāo nǐmen zěnme chāi cí le ba? hěnduō cí shì liǎng gè zì zǔchéng de.
turns.en: That's right. Duoduo, your teacher showed you how to take words apart today, didn't she? Lots of words are made of two characters.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 教了！马克，你知道“电脑”是哪两个字吗？
turns.pinyin: jiāo le! Mǎkè, nǐ zhīdào diànnǎo shì nǎ liǎng gè zì ma?
turns.en: She did! Mark, do you know which two characters make 电脑?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 嗯……你告诉我吧。
turns.pinyin: ń nǐ gàosu wǒ ba.
turns.en: Hmm... You tell me.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: “电”和“脑”！电的脑，就是电脑！
turns.pinyin: diàn hé nǎo! diàn de nǎo, jiùshì diànnǎo!
turns.en: 电 and 脑! An electric brain: a computer!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说得真好！那“手机”呢？
turns.pinyin: shuō de zhēn hǎo! nà shǒujī ne?
turns.en: Well said! What about 手机?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 手里拿着的机器！
turns.pinyin: shǒuli ná zhe de jīqì!
turns.en: A machine you hold in your hand!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 没错。“火车”呢？火车里为什么有“火”？
turns.pinyin: méicuò. huǒchē ne? huǒchē lǐ wèishénme yǒu huǒ?
turns.en: Exactly. And 火车? Why is there fire in a train?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 因为最早的火车要烧火才能开，车上真的有火。
turns.pinyin: yīnwèi zuì zǎo de huǒchē yào shāo huǒ cái néng kāi, chē shang zhēnde yǒu huǒ.
turns.en: Because the first trains had to burn a fire to run. There really was a fire on board.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 那“熊猫”是熊还是猫？
turns.pinyin: nà xióngmāo shì xióng háishi māo?
turns.en: So is a panda a bear or a cat?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 问得好！熊猫其实是一种熊。所以看字猜意思，有时候也会猜错。
turns.pinyin: wèndehǎo! xióngmāo qíshí shì yī zhǒng xióng. suǒyǐ kàn zì cāi yìsi, yǒushíhou yě huì cāi cuò.
turns.en: Good question! A panda is actually a kind of bear. So guessing the meaning from the characters sometimes goes wrong.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我刚学中文的时候也常猜错。我以为“小心”是“小的心”呢！
turns.pinyin: wǒ gāng xué zhōngwén de shíhou yě cháng cāi cuò. wǒ yǐwéi xiǎoxīn shì xiǎo de xīn ne!
turns.en: When I first started learning Chinese I often guessed wrong. I thought 小心 meant 'a small heart'!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 哈哈！老师还教了我们，最早的汉字是怎么造出来的。你们看，我画的是什么？
turns.pinyin: hāhā! lǎoshī hái jiāo le wǒmen, zuì zǎo de hànzì shì zěnme zào chūlai de. nǐmen kàn, wǒ huà de shì shénme?
turns.en: Ha ha! Our teacher showed us how the very first characters were made, too. Look, you two: what have I drawn?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，朵朵的中文课真有意思。我听见那些孩子说话了，他们的中文说得比我还地道！
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, Duǒduo de zhōngwén kè zhēn yǒuyìsi. wǒ tīngjiàn nàxiē háizi shuōhuà le, tāmen de zhōngwén shuō de bǐ wǒ hái dìdao!
turns.en: Xiaoyu, Duoduo's Chinese class sounds really good fun. I heard those kids talking. Their Chinese is more natural than mine!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 他们大部分在家说中文。黄老师小时候可不一样，她家说广东话，普通话是她上大学以后才学的。
turns.pinyin: tāmen dàbùfen zài jiā shuō zhōngwén. Huánglǎoshī xiǎoshíhou kě bù yīyàng, tā jiā shuō guǎngdōnghuà, pǔtōnghuà shì tā shàng dàxué yǐhòu cái xué de.
turns.en: Most of them speak Chinese at home. It was different for their teacher, Ms Huang, when she was little. Her family spoke Cantonese, and she only learned Mandarin after she went to university.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 真的吗？怪不得她的英文名字是Lily Wong，不是Huang。
turns.pinyin: zhēnde ma? guàibude tā de yīngwén míngzi shìLilyWong, bùshìHuang.
turns.en: Really? No wonder her English name is Lily Wong, not Huang.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对，广东话的“黄”就念Wong。她家到澳大利亚已经一百多年了。听说最早来的那个人，是来淘金的。
turns.pinyin: duì, guǎngdōnghuà de Huáng jiù niànWong. tā jiā dào àodàlìyà yǐjīng yī bǎi duō nián le. tīngshuō zuì zǎo lái de nàge rén, shì lái táojīn de.
turns.en: Yes, in Cantonese 黄 is pronounced Wong. Her family's been in Australia for over a hundred years. They say the first one to come here came for the gold.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 原来是这样！对了，你的同事都叫你“小林”，可是饭馆里的人都叫陈明“老陈”。他才三十多岁，到底老不老？
turns.pinyin: yuánlái shì zhèyàng! duìle, nǐ de tóngshì dōu jiào nǐ Xiǎolín, kěshì fànguǎn lǐ de rén dōu jiào Chénmíng Lǎochén. tā cái sān shí duō suì, dàodǐ lǎo bù lǎo?
turns.en: So that's how it is! Oh, by the way, your colleagues all call you 小林, but everyone at the restaurant calls Chen Ming 老陈. He's only thirty-something. So is he old or not?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，这里的“老”和“小”都不是说年纪。大家叫他“老陈”，是因为关系好。可是在他妈妈眼里，他永远是孩子，她到现在还叫他“小明”呢。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, zhè lǐ de lǎo hé xiǎo dōu bùshì shuō niánjì. dàjiā jiào tā Lǎochén, shì yīnwèi guānxi hǎo. kěshì zài tā māma yǎnli, tā yǒngyuǎn shì háizi, tā dào xiànzài hái jiào tā Xiǎomíng ne.
turns.en: Ha ha, neither 老 nor 小 is about age here. They call him 老陈 because they're close. But to his mum he'll always be a child. She still calls him 小明 even now.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 中文的“老”真忙！老师、老板、老虎、老鼠……老鼠一点儿也不老。
turns.pinyin: zhōngwén de lǎo zhēn máng! lǎoshī, lǎobǎn, lǎohǔ, lǎoshǔ lǎoshǔ yīdiǎnr yěbù lǎo.
turns.en: 老 is a busy little word! Teacher, boss, tiger, mouse... and mice aren't old at all.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这些“老”没有什么意思，只是个词头。还有词尾，比如“家”：画家、作家、科学家。
turns.pinyin: zhèxiē lǎo méiyǒu shénme yìsi, zhǐ shì gè cítóu. hái yǒu cíwěi, bǐrú jiā: huàjiā, zuòjiā, kēxuéjiā.
turns.en: That 老 doesn't really mean anything. It's just a prefix. There are suffixes too, like 家: painter, writer, scientist.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “者”也是吧？作者、读者、记者，还有两年前的我——初学者！
turns.pinyin: zhě yěshì ba? zuòzhě, dúzhě, jìzhě, hái yǒu liǎng nián qián de wǒ chūxuézhě!
turns.en: 者 as well, right? Author, reader, journalist, and me two years ago: a beginner!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你早就不是初学者了。再给你两个：“化”和“性”。“现代”加上“化”，就是……
turns.pinyin: nǐ zǎojiù bùshì chūxuézhě le. zài gěi nǐ liǎng gè: huà hé xìng. xiàndài jiāshàng huà, jiùshì
turns.en: You stopped being a beginner long ago. Here are two more: 化 and 性. 现代 plus 化 makes...

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “现代化”！那“国际化”就是变得更国际？
turns.pinyin: xiàndàihuà! nà guójìhuà jiùshì biàn de gèng guójì?
turns.en: 现代化, modernisation! So 国际化 means becoming more international?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 对！墨尔本就是一个很国际化的城市。“性”呢，比如“重要性”“可能性”，说的是一件事有多重要、有多大可能。
turns.pinyin: duì! Mò'ěrběn jiùshì yī gè hěn guójìhuà de chéngshì. xìng ne, bǐrú zhòngyàoxìng kěnéngxìng, shuō de shì yī jiàn shì yǒu duō zhòngyào, yǒu duōdà kěnéng.
turns.en: Exactly! Melbourne's a very international city. And 性: take 重要性 and 可能性. They're about how important something is, how likely it is.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我明白了！学会这些，看见新词也能猜出意思来。
turns.pinyin: wǒ míngbai le! xuéhuì zhèxiē, kànjiàn xīn cí yě néng cāichū yìsi lai.
turns.en: I get it! Once you've learned these, you can work out what new words mean.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 没错。下个星期你也一起去吧？朵朵已经告诉小朋友们了，她有一个“老外学生”！
turns.pinyin: méicuò. xià gè xīngqī nǐ yě yīqǐ qù ba? Duǒduo yǐjīng gàosu xiǎopéngyou men le, tā yǒu yī gè lǎowài xuésheng!
turns.en: Exactly. Why don't you come along next week? Duoduo's already told the other kids she's got a 'laowai pupil'!

dialogues.title: Whatever you do, don't give a clock!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨，今天晚上在您家吃年夜饭，我不能空着手去。我带什么礼物好？
turns.pinyin: āyí, jīntiān wǎnshang zài nín jiā chī niányèfàn, wǒ bù néng kōng zhe shǒu qù. wǒ dài shénme lǐwù hǎo?
turns.en: We're having New Year's Eve dinner at yours tonight, and I can't turn up empty-handed. What should I bring?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你人来了就行，买什么礼物！……你一定要买的话，就送点儿实用的吧。
turns.pinyin: nǐ rén lái le jiù xíng, mǎi shénme lǐwù! nǐ yīdìng yào mǎi dehuà, jiù sòng diǎnr shíyòng de ba.
turns.en: Just bring yourself. What do you want to buy presents for! ...If you really must, get something useful.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 您看这个钟！红色的，上面还有一只金色的鸡。今年是鸡年，送给叔叔再合适不过了！
turns.pinyin: nín kàn zhège zhōng! hóngsè de, shàng miàn hái yǒu yī zhī jīnsè de jī. jīnnián shì jīnián, sòng gěi shūshu zài héshì bùguòle!
turns.en: Look at this clock! It's red, with a golden rooster on it. It's the Year of the Rooster, so it couldn't be more perfect for him!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 千万别！钟可不能送人，特别是送老人。“送钟”听起来像“送终”。
turns.pinyin: qiānwàn bié! zhōng kě bù néng sòng rén, tèbiéshì sòng lǎorén. sòng zhōng tīngqilai xiàng sòngzhōng.
turns.en: Whatever you do, don't! You must never give anyone a clock, especially an older person. 送钟 sounds like 送终.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 送终？什么意思？
turns.pinyin: sòngzhōng? shénme yìsi?
turns.en: 送终? What does that mean?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 就是老人去世的时候，陪在他身边。过年送这个，太不吉利了。
turns.pinyin: jiùshì lǎorén qùshì de shíhou, péi zài tā shēnbiān. guònián sòng zhège, tài bù jílì le.
turns.en: It means being with an old person when they die. Giving that at New Year would be terribly unlucky.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好险！那送把伞吧？墨尔本的天气说变就变，伞肯定用得上。
turns.pinyin: hǎoxiǎn! nà sòng bǎ sǎn ba? Mò'ěrběn de tiānqì shuōbiànjiùbiàn, sǎn kěndìng yòngdeshàng.
turns.en: That was close! How about an umbrella, then? Melbourne's weather changes at the drop of a hat, so you'll definitely use it.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 伞也不行。“伞”跟“散”差不多，听起来像要分开。
turns.pinyin: sǎn yě bùxíng. sǎn gēn sàn chàbuduō, tīngqilai xiàng yào fēnkāi.
turns.en: Umbrellas are no good either. 伞 sounds almost like 散, as if you're going to split up.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 中文怎么这么多讲究！那水果总可以吧？这些梨又大又新鲜。
turns.pinyin: zhōngwén zěnme zhème duō jiǎngjiu! nà shuǐguǒ zǒng kěyǐ ba? zhèxiē lí yòu dà yòu xīnxiān.
turns.en: Why are there so many rules in Chinese! Fruit's got to be OK, surely? These pears are big and fresh.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 梨最好也别送，“梨”听起来像“离开”的“离”。你看旁边的橘子多好，又圆又甜，“橘”听起来还像“吉利”的“吉”。
turns.pinyin: lí zuìhǎo yě bié sòng, lí tīngqilai xiàng líkāi de lí. nǐ kàn pángbiān de júzi duō hǎo, yòu yuán yòu tián, jú tīngqilai hái xiàng jílì de jí.
turns.en: Better not give pears either. 梨 sounds like the 离 in 离开, to leave. Look how nice the mandarins next to them are, round and sweet. And 橘 sounds like the 吉 in 吉利, lucky.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，就买橘子！再买四瓶红酒吧？
turns.pinyin: hǎo, jiù mǎi júzi! zài mǎi sì píng hóngjiǔ ba?
turns.en: OK, mandarins it is! And shall I get four bottles of red wine?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 四瓶？你又来了！“四”听起来像“死”。买两瓶吧，好事成双。
turns.pinyin: sì píng? nǐyòuláile! sì tīngqilai xiàng sǐ. mǎi liǎng píng ba, hǎoshìchéngshuāng.
turns.en: Four? There you go again! 四 sounds like 死, death. Get two. Good things come in pairs.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好事成双……我明白了。那朵朵呢？
turns.pinyin: hǎoshìchéngshuāng wǒ míngbai le. nà Duǒduo ne?
turns.en: Good things come in pairs... Got it. And Duoduo?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 孩子最简单了，给红包！走，我们先去银行换点儿新钱。
turns.pinyin: háizi zuì jiǎndān le, gěi hóngbāo! zǒu, wǒmen xiān qù yínháng huàn diǎnr xīnqián.
turns.en: Children are easiest of all: a red envelope! Come on, let's go to the bank first and get some new notes.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 快进来，快进来！外面热吧？伦敦现在才三度，这儿三十五度，我到现在还不习惯。
turns.pinyin: kuài jìnlai, kuài jìnlai! wàimiàn rè ba? lúndūn xiànzài cái sān dù, zhèr sānshíwǔ dù, wǒ dào xiànzài hái bù xíguàn.
turns.en: Come in, come in! Hot out there, isn't it? It's only three degrees in London right now and thirty-five here. I still haven't got used to it.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，过年好！这是我送您和阿姨的，一点儿心意。祝您身体健康！
turns.pinyin: shūshu, guòniánhǎo! zhè shì wǒ sòng nín hé āyí de, yīdiǎnr xīnyì. zhù nín shēntǐjiànkāng!
turns.en: Happy New Year! This is for you and your wife, just a little something. Wishing you good health!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，你太客气了，来就来吧，还带什么东西！
turns.pinyin: āiyā, nǐ tài kèqi le, láijiùláiba, hái dài shénme dōngxi!
turns.en: Oh, you shouldn't have! Coming is enough. Why bring anything?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 马克，小雨，快坐。朵朵，快过来拜年！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, Xiǎoyǔ, kuài zuò. Duǒduo, kuài guòlai bàinián!
turns.en: Mark, Xiaoyu, sit down. Duoduo, come here and wish them a happy new year!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克、小雨，新年好！祝你们……恭喜发财！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, Xiǎoyǔ, xīnniánhǎo! zhù nǐmen gōngxǐfācái!
turns.en: Mark, Xiaoyu, Happy New Year! Wishing you... lots of money!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 朵朵真乖！来，这是我给你的红包。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo zhēn guāi! lái, zhè shì wǒ gěi nǐ de hóngbāo.
turns.en: What a good girl! Here, this red envelope is from me.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这个是我的。朵朵，祝你学习进步！
turns.pinyin: zhège shì wǒ de. Duǒduo, zhù nǐ xuéxíjìnbù!
turns.en: And this one's from me. Duoduo, I hope school goes well this year!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 谢谢！奶奶，我可以打开吗？
turns.pinyin: xièxie! nǎinai, wǒ kěyǐ dǎkāi ma?
turns.en: Thank you! Granny, can I open them?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 不能当着客人的面打开，没礼貌。先给奶奶，奶奶替你保管。
turns.pinyin: bù néng dāngzhe kèrén demiàn dǎkāi, méi lǐmào. xiān gěi nǎinai, nǎinai tì nǐ bǎoguǎn.
turns.en: You mustn't open them in front of the guests. It's rude. Give them to Granny, and Granny will look after them for you.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，每年都这样。红包一到手，就被奶奶“保管”了。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, měi nián dōu zhèyàng. hóngbāo yī dàoshǒu, jiù bèi nǎinai bǎoguǎn le.
turns.en: Ha ha, it's the same every year. As soon as she gets a red envelope, Granny 'looks after' it.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈明，我正想问你：在中国，红包里一般放多少钱？
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng, wǒ zhèngxiǎng wèn nǐ: zài zhōngguó, hóngbāo lǐ yībān fàng duōshǎoqián?
turns.en: Chen Ming, I've been meaning to ask: in China, how much do people usually put in a red envelope?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 看关系。给孩子的，一两百块就够了。数字最好是双数，比如两百、六百。“八”最受欢迎，因为听起来像“发财”的“发”。
turns.pinyin: kàn guānxi. gěi háizi de, yī liǎng bǎi kuài jiù gòu le. shùzì zuìhǎo shì shuāngshù, bǐrú liǎngbǎi, liùbǎi. bā zuì shòuhuānyíng, yīnwèi tīngqilai xiàng fācái de fā.
turns.en: It depends on the relationship. For children, one or two hundred is enough. It's best to use an even number, like two hundred or six hundred. Eight is the most popular, because 八 sounds like the 发 in 发财, to get rich.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那四百块呢？……开玩笑的，我知道“四”不吉利。
turns.pinyin: nà sì bǎi kuài ne? kāiwánxiào de, wǒ zhīdào sì bù jílì.
turns.en: What about four hundred, then? ...Only joking. I know four's unlucky.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，你这个老外懂得真不少！来，吃饺子，今天阿姨包了三百个！
turns.pinyin: hāhā, nǐ zhège lǎowài dǒng de zhēn bù shǎo! lái, chī jiǎozi, jīntiān āyí bāo le sān bǎi gè!
turns.en: Ha ha, for a laowai you know a lot! Come on, have some dumplings. I've made three hundred today!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 小雨，我们星期三就走了。这是我们全家的一点儿心意。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, wǒmen xīngqī sān jiù zǒu le. zhè shì wǒmen quánjiā de yīdiǎnr xīnyì.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, we're off on Wednesday. This is a little something from all of us.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，你们太客气了！怎么还给我准备礼物？让你们破费了。
turns.pinyin: āiyā, nǐmen tài kèqi le! zěnme hái gěi wǒ zhǔnbèi lǐwù? ràng nǐmen pòfèi le.
turns.en: Oh, you really shouldn't have! Why did you get me a present? You've spent far too much.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 不值什么钱，小意思。打开看看吧，自己家里人，没那么多讲究。
turns.pinyin: bù zhí shénme qián, xiǎoyìsi. dǎkāi kàn kan ba, zìjǐ jiālirén, méi nàme duō jiǎngjiu.
turns.en: It's nothing much, just a small thing. Go on, open it. We're family. We don't stand on ceremony.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那我就不客气了。……哇，是一本相册！
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ jiù bùkèqi le. wa, shì yī běn xiàngcè!
turns.en: Then I won't say no. ...Wow, it's a photo album!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 里面的照片都是我选的！这张是你带我去上中文课，这张是年三十晚上吃饺子。
turns.pinyin: lǐmiàn de zhàopiàn dōu shì wǒ xuǎn de! zhè zhāng shì nǐ dài wǒ qù shàng zhōngwén kè, zhè zhāng shì nián sān shí wǎnshang chī jiǎozi.
turns.en: I chose all the photos in it! This one's you taking me to Chinese class, and this one's eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 朵朵，你真是太有心了！这是我今年收到的最好的礼物之一。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo, nǐ zhēnshi tài yǒuxīn le! zhè shì wǒ jīnnián shōudào de zuìhǎo de lǐwù zhīyī.
turns.en: Duoduo, that's so thoughtful of you! It's one of the best presents I've had this year.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 小雨，还有这个，是我自己织的围巾。墨尔本的冬天也冷，你用得上。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, hái yǒu zhège, shì wǒ zìjǐ zhī de wéijīn. Mò'ěrběn de dōngtiān yě lěng, nǐ yòngdeshàng.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, there's this too. It's a scarf I knitted myself. Melbourne's cold in winter too, so it'll come in handy.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这是您亲手织的？太珍贵了！到了冬天我天天戴着。
turns.pinyin: zhè shì nín qīnshǒu zhī de? tài zhēnguì le! dào le dōngtiān wǒ tiān tiān dài zhe.
turns.en: You knitted this yourself? It's so precious! I'll wear it every day when winter comes.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 喜欢就好。你们年轻人，一个在伦敦，一个在墨尔本，想见一面真不容易。
turns.pinyin: xǐhuanjiùhǎo. nǐmen niánqīngrén, yī gè zài lúndūn, yī gè zài Mò'ěrběn, xiǎng jiànyīmiàn zhēn bù róngyì.
turns.en: As long as you like it. You young people, one in London, one in Melbourne. It's not easy to see each other.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 您别担心，我和马克天天视频。
turns.pinyin: nín bié dānxīn, wǒ hé Mǎkè tiān tiān shìpín.
turns.en: Don't worry, Mark and I video-call every day.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对了，我也给大家准备了礼物。小雨，这是从伦敦带来的茶，一点儿小心意，请收下。
turns.pinyin: duìle, wǒ yě gěi dàjiā zhǔnbèi le lǐwù. Xiǎoyǔ, zhè shì cóng lúndūn dàilai de chá, yīdiǎnr xiǎoxīnyì, qǐng shōuxia.
turns.en: Oh, and I've got presents for everyone too. Xiaoyu, this is tea I brought from London. Just a little something. Please accept it.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 英国茶！那我就收下了，谢谢！
turns.pinyin: yīngguó chá! nà wǒ jiù shōuxia le, xièxie!
turns.en: English tea! Then I'll accept it. Thank you!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 朵朵，这个是给你的：一张伦敦的地铁图。我在每一站旁边都写了汉字。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo, zhège shì gěi nǐ de: yī zhāng lúndūn de dìtiě tú. wǒ zài měiyīzhàn pángbiān dōu xiě le hànzì.
turns.en: Duoduo, this one's for you: a London Underground map. I've written the Chinese characters next to every station.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 谢谢马克！我要把它挂在我房间的墙上！
turns.pinyin: xièxie Mǎkè! wǒ yào bǎ tā guà zài wǒ fángjiān de qiángshang!
turns.en: Thank you, Mark! I'm going to hang it on my bedroom wall!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，这是我送你的。你先别打开……算了，打开吧！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, zhè shì wǒ sòng nǐ de. nǐ xiān bié dǎkāi suànle, dǎkāi ba!
turns.en: Mark, this is for you. Don't open it yet... Oh, never mind, open it!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 一个杯子？上面画的是……伦敦和墨尔本！
turns.pinyin: yī gè bēizi? shàng miàn huà de shì lúndūn hé Mò'ěrběn!
turns.en: A mug? And what's painted on it is... London and Melbourne!

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 是我自己设计的。一边是伦敦的地铁，一边是墨尔本的电车，中间是一杯澳白。
turns.pinyin: shì wǒ zìjǐ shèjì de. yībiān shì lúndūn de dìtiě, yībiān shì Mò'ěrběn de diànchē, zhōngjiān shì yī bēi àobái.
turns.en: I designed it myself. On one side is the Tube, on the other a Melbourne tram, and in the middle a flat white.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 太有创意了！以后我每天早上都用它喝咖啡。
turns.pinyin: tài yǒu chuàngyì le! yǐhòu wǒ měitiān zǎoshang dōu yòng tā hē kāfēi.
turns.en: That's so creative! I'll drink my coffee out of it every morning from now on.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 你喜欢就好。你送我的那张地铁图，我一直挂在办公室里。
turns.pinyin: nǐ xǐhuanjiùhǎo. nǐ sòng wǒ de nà zhāng dìtiě tú, wǒ yīzhí guà zài bàngōngshì lǐ.
turns.en: As long as you like it. The Tube map you gave me has been on my office wall ever since.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 真的？……小雨，其实我也有个消息要告诉你。
turns.pinyin: zhēnde? Xiǎoyǔ, qíshí wǒ yě yǒu gè xiāoxi yào gàosu nǐ.
turns.en: Really? ...Xiaoyu, actually I've got some news for you too.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 什么消息？看你的样子，是好消息吧？
turns.pinyin: shénme xiāoxi? kàn nǐ de yàngzi, shì hǎo xiāoxi ba?
turns.en: What news? From the look on your face, it's good news?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 前天老板给我发了邮件，公司要派我去上海工作，至少一年，可能更长。
turns.pinyin: qiántiān lǎobǎn gěi wǒ fā le yóujiàn, gōngsī yào pài wǒ qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò, zhìshǎo yī nián, kěnéng gèng cháng.
turns.en: My boss emailed me the day before yesterday. The company wants to send me to work in Shanghai, for at least a year, maybe longer.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 上海？就是你一直在联系的那个客户？
turns.pinyin: Shànghǎi? jiùshì nǐ yīzhí zài liánxì de nàge kèhù?
turns.en: Shanghai? The client you've been dealing with?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对。他们对我们的设计很满意，希望我去那边跟他们一起做。你觉得我应该去吗？
turns.pinyin: duì. tāmen duì wǒmen de shèjì hěn mǎnyì, xīwàng wǒ qù nàbian gēn tāmen yīqǐ zuò. nǐ juéde wǒ yīnggāi qù ma?
turns.en: Yes. They're very happy with our designs, and they want me to go over and work with them. Do you think I should go?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这还用问？这是再好不过的机会了！你每天都能说中文，而且……
turns.pinyin: zhèháiyòngwèn? zhè shì zài hǎo bùguò de jīhuì le! nǐ měitiān dōu néng shuō zhōngwén, érqiě
turns.en: Need you ask? It's the best chance you could get! You'd speak Chinese every day, and besides...

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 而且什么？
turns.pinyin: érqiě shénme?
turns.en: Besides what?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 而且上海离墨尔本比伦敦近多了，坐飞机十一个小时左右就到了。
turns.pinyin: érqiě Shànghǎi lí Mò'ěrběn bǐ lúndūn jìn duōle, zuò fēijī shí yī gè xiǎoshí zuǒyòu jiù dào le.
turns.en: And besides, Shanghai's much closer to Melbourne than London is. It's only about eleven hours on the plane.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，这一点我完全同意！我还没想好，不过……这样的机会，真的很难得。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, zhèyīdiǎn wǒ wánquán tóngyì! wǒ hái méi xiǎng hǎo, bùguò zhèyàng de jīhuì, zhēnde hěn nándé.
turns.en: Ha ha, I completely agree with you there! I haven't made up my mind yet, but... a chance like this really doesn't come along often.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 明天就面试了，我们把一格发来的问题练一遍吧。我当面试官，你就当我是老板。
turns.pinyin: míngtiān jiù miànshì le, wǒmen bǎ Yīgé fā lái de wèntí liàn yī biàn ba. wǒ dāng miànshìguān, nǐ jiù dàng wǒ shì lǎobǎn.
turns.en: The interview's tomorrow, so let's run through the questions 一格 sent you. I'll be the interviewer. Pretend I'm the boss.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 好。那我先跟你握手、打招呼，再坐下。
turns.pinyin: hǎo. nà wǒ xiān gēn nǐ wòshǒu, dǎzhāohu, zài zuòxia.
turns.en: All right. So first I shake your hand and say hello, and then I sit down.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 请坐。别紧张，就当是聊聊天。第一个问题：请你先简单介绍一下自己。
turns.pinyin: qǐng zuò. bié jǐnzhāng, jiù dàng shì liáo liáotiān. dì yī gè wèntí: qǐng nǐ xiān jiǎndān jièshào yīxià zìjǐ.
turns.en: Have a seat. Don't be nervous, just think of it as a chat. First question: please begin by telling us a little about yourself.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 您好。我叫林小雨，2027年从伦敦一所大学的视觉传达专业毕业。在校期间，我曾在唐人街一家饭馆帮忙，主要负责海报和社交媒体的设计。
turns.pinyin: nín hǎo. wǒ jiào Línxiǎoyǔ,2027 nián cóng lúndūn yī suǒ dàxué de shìjuéchuándá zhuānyè bìyè. zàixiàoqījiān, wǒ céng zài Tángrénjiē yī jiā fànguǎn bāngmáng, zhǔyào fùzé hǎibào hé shèjiāoméitǐ de shèjì.
turns.en: Good afternoon. My name is Lin Xiaoyu, and in 2027 I graduated in visual communication from a university in London. During my studies I helped out at a restaurant in Chinatown, where I was mainly responsible for posters and social media design.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 唐人街一家饭馆？那不就是陈家饺子吗！你可别告诉他们，老板是你表哥。
turns.pinyin: Tángrénjiē yī jiā fànguǎn? nà bù jiùshì Chénjiājiǎozi ma! nǐ kě bié gàosu tāmen, lǎobǎn shì nǐ biǎogē.
turns.en: A restaurant in Chinatown? That's Chen Family Dumplings! Just don't tell them the owner's your cousin.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 陈明，我们在面试呢！小雨，你说“主要负责”，能具体说说吗？
turns.pinyin: Chénmíng, wǒmen zài miànshì ne! Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ shuō zhǔyào fùzé, néng jùtǐ shuō shuō ma?
turns.en: Chen Ming, this is an interview! Xiaoyu, you said 'mainly responsible'. Could you be more specific?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 毕业以后，我在墨尔本一家设计公司工作。去年公司给一个咖啡品牌做推广，我负责每个星期的公众号封面和活动海报。通过这份工作，我对品牌设计有了更深的了解。
turns.pinyin: bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ zài Mò'ěrběn yī jiā shèjì gōngsī gōngzuò. qùnián gōngsī gěi yī gè kāfēi pǐnpái zuò tuīguǎng, wǒ fùzé měi gè xīngqī de gōngzhònghào fēngmiàn hé huódòng hǎibào. tōngguò zhè fèn gōngzuò, wǒ duì pǐnpái shèjì yǒu le gèng shēn de liǎojiě.
turns.en: Since graduating I've worked at a design company in Melbourne. Last year the company ran a campaign for a coffee brand, and I did the weekly covers for its WeChat account and the event posters. Through that job I came to understand brand design much better.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 下一个问题：你为什么想来我们公司？
turns.pinyin: xià yī gè wèntí: nǐ wèishénme xiǎng lái wǒmen gōngsī?
turns.en: Next question: why do you want to join us?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我一直很关注贵公司的作品，尤其是去年给一家老字号做的包装，既传统又时尚。我希望能在这样的团队里学习、成长。
turns.pinyin: wǒ yīzhí hěn guānzhù guìgōngsī de zuòpǐn, yóuqí shì qùnián gěi yī jiā lǎozìhào zuò de bāozhuāng, jì chuántǒng yòu shíshàng. wǒ xīwàng néng zài zhèyàng de tuánduì lǐ xuéxí, chéngzhǎng.
turns.en: I've followed your company's work for a long time, especially the packaging you did last year for a time-honoured brand. It was traditional and stylish at once. I'd love to learn and grow in a team like yours.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我们的工作节奏比较快，截止日期前有时候要加班。对于这一点，你怎么看？
turns.pinyin: wǒmen de gōngzuò jiézòu bǐjiào kuài, jiézhǐrìqī qián yǒushíhou yào jiābān. duìyú zhèyīdiǎn, nǐ zěnme kàn?
turns.en: We work at quite a fast pace, and before a deadline we sometimes stay late. How do you feel about that?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我理解，设计这一行，项目紧的时候加班很正常。不过我认为，提高效率比延长时间更重要。
turns.pinyin: wǒ lǐjiě, shèjì zhè yī háng, xiàngmù jǐn de shíhou jiābān hěn zhèngcháng. bùguò wǒ rènwéi, tígāo xiàolǜ bǐ yáncháng shíjiān gèng zhòngyào.
turns.en: I understand. In design, working late when a project is tight is normal. But I believe working more efficiently matters more than working longer.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说得好，我们老板也常这么说。最后一个问题：你觉得自己最大的缺点是什么？
turns.pinyin: shuō de hǎo, wǒmen lǎobǎn yě cháng zhème shuō. zuìhòu yī gè wèntí: nǐ juéde zìjǐ zuì dà de quēdiǎn shì shénme?
turns.en: Well put. Our boss often says the same. Last question: what would you say is your biggest weakness?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我有时候太追求完美，一张图要改很多遍。现在我正在学着给自己定时间。
turns.pinyin: wǒ yǒushíhou tài zhuīqiú wánměi, yī zhāng tú yào gǎi hěnduō biàn. xiànzài wǒ zhèngzài xué zhe gěi zìjǐ dìng shíjiān.
turns.en: Sometimes I'm too much of a perfectionist, and I'll redo one image many times. I'm learning to give myself time limits.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，今天就到这儿。一个星期之内我们会通知你结果。你还有什么问题想问我们吗？
turns.pinyin: hǎo, jīntiān jiù dào zhèr. yī gè xīngqī zhīnèi wǒmen huì tōngzhī nǐ jiéguǒ. nǐ hái yǒu shénme wèntí xiǎng wèn wǒmen ma?
turns.en: Good, let's stop there for today. We'll let you know the result within a week. Is there anything you'd like to ask us?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 请问，新人入职以后，会有人带吗？
turns.pinyin: qǐngwèn, xīnrén rùzhí yǐhòu, huì yǒu rén dài ma?
turns.en: May I ask: when new people join, does someone train them?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 会的。每个新人都有一位经验丰富的设计师带。好了，面试结束！
turns.pinyin: huì de. měi gè xīnrén dōu yǒu yī wèi jīngyànfēngfù de shèjìshī dài. hǎole, miànshì jiéshù!
turns.en: Yes. Every new starter is mentored by an experienced designer. Right, interview over!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 小雨，你今天说话怎么这么正式啊？“贵公司”“在校期间”，听起来像在念简历。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ jīntiān shuōhuà zěnme zhème zhèngshì a? guìgōngsī zàixiàoqījiān, tīngqilai xiàng zài niàn jiǎnlì.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, why are you talking so formally today? 'Your esteemed company', 'during my studies'. It's like listening to you read out your CV.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 面试嘛，大家都这样。等我去上班了，当然还是跟平时一样说话。
turns.pinyin: miànshì ma, dàjiā dōu zhèyàng. děng wǒ qù shàngbān le, dāngrán háishi gēn píngshí yīyàng shuōhuà.
turns.en: That's interviews for you, everyone does it. Once I start work, I'll talk the way I normally do, of course.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 九点半了，你怎么才下班？我六点就走了。
turns.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn bàn le, nǐ zěnme cái xiàbān? wǒ liù diǎn jiù zǒu le.
turns.en: It's half past nine. You've only just finished? I left at six.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这还算早的。客户的方案星期五上午就要交，明天估计得十点以后了。
turns.pinyin: zhè hái suàn zǎo de. kèhù de fāng'àn xīngqī wǔ shàngwǔ jiù yào jiāo, míngtiān gūjì děi shí diǎn yǐhòu le.
turns.en: This counts as early. The client's proposal is due on Friday morning. Tomorrow I reckon it'll be after ten.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你这个星期天天加班到这么晚，身体受得了吗？快坐下，先吃饭。
turns.pinyin: nǐ zhège xīngqītiān tiān jiābān dào zhème wǎn, shēntǐ shòudeliǎo ma? kuài zuòxia, xiān chīfàn.
turns.en: You've worked this late every day this week. Can you keep it up? Sit down and eat something first.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 早就习惯了。我有个同学在一家互联网大厂工作，那才叫加班呢，标准的“996”。
turns.pinyin: zǎojiù xíguàn le. wǒ yǒu gè tóngxué zài yī jiā hùliánwǎng dàchǎng gōngzuò, nà cái jiào jiābān ne, biāozhǔn de996.
turns.en: I'm used to it. A friend from university works at a big tech company. Now that's real overtime: textbook 996.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “996”是什么意思？
turns.pinyin: 996 shì shénme yìsi?
turns.en: What does 996 mean?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 早上九点上班，晚上九点下班，一个星期上六天。
turns.pinyin: zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn shàngbān, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn xiàbān, yī gè xīngqī shàng liù tiān.
turns.en: Start at nine in the morning, finish at nine at night, six days a week.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 一个星期七十二个小时？这不违法吗？
turns.pinyin: yī gè xīngqī qī shí èr gè xiǎoshí? zhè bù wéifǎ ma?
turns.en: Seventy-two hours a week? Isn't that against the law?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 从法律上说，当然不行。可是有的公司说是员工“自愿”加班，谁也不好说什么。
turns.pinyin: cóng fǎlǜ shàng shuō, dāngrán bùxíng. kěshì yǒu de gōngsī shuō shì yuángōng zìyuàn jiābān, shéi yě bù hǎo shuō shénme.
turns.en: Legally, of course it's not allowed. But some companies say the staff are working late 'voluntarily', and then it's hard for anyone to say anything.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 你们那算什么？我刚到伦敦的时候，在别人的饭馆当厨师，一天干十四个小时。说实话，那几年我一方面学到了很多东西，另一方面，身体真的吃不消，休息的时候基本上都在补觉。
turns.pinyin: nǐmen nà suàn shénme? wǒ gāng dào lúndūn de shíhou, zài biéren de fànguǎn dāng chúshī, yī tiān gàn shí sì gè xiǎoshí. shuōshíhuà, nà jǐ nián wǒ yīfāngmiàn xué dào le hěnduō dōngxi, lìngyīfāngmiàn, shēntǐ zhēnde chībuxiāo, xiūxi de shíhou jīběnshang dōu zài bǔjiào.
turns.en: Call that overtime? When I first got to London I cooked in someone else's restaurant, fourteen hours a day. To be honest, in those years I learned a lot, but my health really couldn't take it. I spent most of my time off catching up on sleep.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我们年轻的时候也加班，可是那时候没有手机，一下班，老板就找不到你了。现在呢，微信一响，人在家里，心却还在公司。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen niánqīng de shíhou yě jiābān, kěshì nàshíhou méiyǒu shǒujī, yī xiàbān, lǎobǎn jiù zhǎo bù dào nǐ le. xiànzài ne, wēixìn yī xiǎng, rén zài jiā lǐ, xīn què hái zài gōngsī.
turns.en: We worked late too when we were young, but there were no mobiles then. The moment you left, the boss couldn't reach you. Now the WeChat pings, and you're at home in body but still at the office in spirit.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 在伦敦，下班以后老板很少给我们发消息。有的国家还规定，员工下班以后有权不回工作消息。
turns.pinyin: zài lúndūn, xiàbān yǐhòu lǎobǎn hěn shǎo gěi wǒmen fā xiāoxi. yǒu de guójiā hái guīdìng, yuángōng xiàbān yǐhòu yǒuquán bù huí gōngzuò xiāoxi.
turns.en: In London, the boss hardly ever messages us after work. Some countries even have a rule that staff have the right not to answer work messages after hours.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 真羡慕！不过我们这一行，客户什么时候改需求，谁也说不准，加班难免。
turns.pinyin: zhēn xiànmù! bùguò wǒmen zhè yī háng, kèhù shénmeshíhou gǎi xūqiú, shéi yě shuōbuzhǔn, jiābān nánmiǎn.
turns.en: Lucky you! But in our line of work, nobody can tell when a client will change the brief. Some overtime's unavoidable.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
