turns.hanzi: 加班可以，但是要加得有意义。最怕的是“表演式加班”：老板不走，谁也不敢走。
turns.pinyin: jiābān kěyǐ, dànshì yào jiā de yǒu yìyì. zuì pà de shì biǎoyǎn shì jiābān: lǎobǎn bù zǒu, shéi yě bù gǎn zǒu.
turns.en: Overtime's fine, as long as it's worth it. The worst is overtime for show: nobody dares leave until the boss does.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 一格不是这样。我们老板常说，效率比时间更重要。所以我每天六点就走，没人觉得我不努力。
turns.pinyin: Yīgé bùshì zhèyàng. wǒmen lǎobǎn cháng shuō, xiàolǜ bǐ shíjiān gèng zhòngyào. suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān liù diǎn jiù zǒu, méi rén juéde wǒ bù nǔlì.
turns.en: 一格 isn't like that. Our boss always says efficiency matters more than hours. So I leave at six every day, and nobody thinks I'm not pulling my weight.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 六点就走？真羡慕。我们开饭馆的，客人不走，谁也走不了。
turns.pinyin: liù diǎn jiù zǒu? zhēn xiànmù. wǒmen kāi fànguǎn de, kèrén bù zǒu, shéi yě zǒubuliǎo.
turns.en: Leave at six? Lucky you. In the restaurant trade, nobody leaves until the customers do.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 好了好了，都别说了，饺子要凉了。小雨，明天晚上我让你表哥给你送饺子去，就算是支持你了！
turns.pinyin: hǎole hǎole, dōu bié shuō le, jiǎozi yào liáng le. Xiǎoyǔ, míngtiān wǎnshang wǒ ràng nǐ biǎogē gěi nǐ sòng jiǎozi qù, jiù suàn shì zhīchí nǐ le!
turns.en: All right, all right, that's enough, the dumplings are getting cold. Xiaoyu, tomorrow evening I'll have your cousin bring you some dumplings. We'll call that moral support!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 人都到齐了吧？那我们开个短会，半个小时。
turns.pinyin: rén dōu dàoqí le ba? nà wǒmen kāi gè duǎn huì, bàn gè xiǎoshí.
turns.en: Is everyone here? Let's have a quick meeting, half an hour.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 就我们两个人，当然到齐了。先说福和的项目吧。上星期五甲方看了我们的方案，反馈已经发过来了。
turns.pinyin: jiù wǒmen liǎng gè rén, dāngrán dàoqí le. xiān shuō Fúhé de xiàngmù ba. shàng xīngqī wǔ jiǎfāng kàn le wǒmen de fāng'àn, fǎnkuì yǐjīng fā guolai le.
turns.en: There are only two of us, so yes, everyone's here. Fuhe first. The client looked at our proposal last Friday, and they've sent their feedback.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我看了。总的来说他们挺满意，不过提了三点意见：第一，主色调希望再红一点儿；第二，品牌名要再大一点儿；第三，中秋礼盒的截止日期想提前一个星期。
turns.pinyin: wǒ kàn le. zǒngdeláishuō tāmen tǐng mǎnyì, bùguò tí le sān diǎn yìjiàn: dì yī, zhǔsèdiào xīwàng zài hóng yīdiǎnr; dì èr, pǐnpái míng yào zài dà yīdiǎnr; dì sān, zhōngqiū lǐhé de jiézhǐrìqī xiǎng tíqián yī gè xīngqī.
turns.en: I've read it. On the whole they're pretty happy, but they've raised three points. One, they'd like the main colour a bit redder. Two, the brand name needs to be bigger. Three, they want to bring the deadline for the Mid-Autumn gift box forward a week.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 提前一个星期？印刷厂那边肯定来不及。
turns.pinyin: tíqián yī gè xīngqī? yìnshuāchǎng nàbian kěndìng láibují.
turns.en: A week earlier? The printers will never make it.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 时间的问题我去跟印刷厂沟通。颜色呢？你怎么看？
turns.pinyin: shíjiān de wèntí wǒ qù gēn yìnshuāchǎng gōutōng. yánsè ne? nǐ zěnme kàn?
turns.en: I'll talk to the printers about the timing. What about the colour? What do you think?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我觉得可以按照他们的要求调一下，但是不能太红。根据公司上个月做的调查，年轻人更喜欢浅一点儿的颜色。
turns.pinyin: wǒ juéde kěyǐ ànzhào tāmen de yāoqiú tiáo yīxià, dànshì bù néng tài hóng. gēnjù gōngsī shàng gè yuè zuò de diàochá, niánqīngrén gèng xǐhuan qiǎn yīdiǎnr de yánsè.
turns.en: I think we can tweak it the way they want, but not too red. According to the survey the company did last month, young people prefer lighter colours.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 同意。我们可以多出两个版本，让他们自己选。
turns.pinyin: tóngyì. wǒmen kěyǐ duō chū liǎng gè bǎnběn, ràng tāmen zìjǐ xuǎn.
turns.en: Agreed. We could do two more versions and let them choose.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我补充一点：颜色一改，印刷的成本可能也会变，这个得提前跟他们说清楚。
turns.pinyin: wǒ bǔchōng yī diǎn: yánsè yī gǎi, yìnshuā de chéngběn kěnéng yě huì biàn, zhège děi tíqián gēn tāmen shuō qīngchǔ.
turns.en: Let me add one thing: if the colour changes, the printing costs may change too. We need to make that clear to them in advance.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好。那就这么定了：你负责改颜色，星期三以前出两个版本；我对接印刷厂，确认最晚的交货时间。
turns.pinyin: hǎo. nà jiùzhèmedìngle: nǐ fùzé gǎi yánsè, xīngqī sān yǐqián chū liǎng gè bǎnběn; wǒ duìjiē yìnshuāchǎng, quèrèn zuì wǎn de jiāohuò shíjiān.
turns.en: Good. Then that's settled. You'll change the colours and have two versions by Wednesday. I'll liaise with the printers and confirm the latest delivery date.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 还有一件事：老板说了，让你把今天会上说的整理一下，下午给甲方发封邮件。
turns.pinyin: hái yǒu yī jiàn shì: lǎobǎn shuō le, ràng nǐ bǎ jīntiān huì shang shuō de zhěnglǐ yīxià, xiàwǔ gěi jiǎfāng fā fēng yóujiàn.
turns.en: One more thing: the boss said you're to write up what we've said today and email the client this afternoon.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 发邮件？在微信上说一声不就行了吗？
turns.pinyin: fā yóujiàn? zài wēixìn shàng shuōyīshēng bù jiù xíng le ma?
turns.en: Email? Can't we just tell them on WeChat?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 微信是微信，邮件是邮件。重要的事情要有书面记录，万一以后有什么问题，也好查。邮件发了以后，再在微信上跟他们的对接人说一声：“邮件已发，请查收。”
turns.pinyin: wēixìn shì wēixìn, yóujiàn shì yóujiàn. zhòngyào de shìqing yào yǒu shūmiàn jìlù, wànyī yǐhòu yǒu shénme wèntí, yě hǎo chá. yóujiàn fā le yǐhòu, zài zài wēixìn shàng gēn tāmen de duìjiērén shuōyīshēng: yóujiàn yǐ fā, qǐng cháshōu.
turns.en: WeChat's WeChat and email's email. Important things need a written record, so if there's ever a problem later, it's easy to check. Once the email's gone, drop a line to their contact on WeChat: 'Email sent, please check your inbox.'

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 明白。那邮件用中文写还是用英文写？
turns.pinyin: míngbai. nà yóujiàn yòng zhōngwén xiě háishi yòng yīngwén xiě?
turns.en: Got it. Should I write it in Chinese or English?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 当然是中文。写好了先发给我看一下，别太口语化。你要是不知道怎么写，可以参考老板上次写的那封，开头和结尾都有固定的说法。
turns.pinyin: dāngrán shì zhōngwén. xiě hǎole xiān fā gěi wǒ kàn yīxià, bié tài kǒuyǔhuà. nǐ yàoshi bù zhīdào zěnme xiě, kěyǐ cānkǎo lǎobǎn shàng cì xiě de nà fēng, kāi tóu hé jiéwěi dōu yǒu gùdìng de shuōfǎ.
turns.en: Chinese, of course. Send it to me first when it's done, and don't make it too chatty. If you're not sure how to write it, have a look at the one the boss wrote last time. There are set phrases for the beginning and the end.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好。还有别的问题吗？没有的话，散会。
turns.pinyin: hǎo. hái yǒu biéde wèntí ma? méiyǒu dehuà, sànhuì.
turns.en: Right. Anything else? If not, that's it.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 散会！……哎，四十分钟了，两个人开会也能超时。
turns.pinyin: sànhuì! āi, sì shí fēnzhōng le, liǎng gè rén kāihuì yě néng chāoshí.
turns.en: Meeting over! ...Oh, forty minutes. Even two people can run over time.

dialogues.title: Stop agonising and go and talk

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 跟你们说件事。上个星期有个猎头找我，说一家大厂有个新职位，想让我过去，做手机应用的界面设计，工资比现在高一半。
turns.pinyin: gēn nǐmen shuō jiàn shì. shàng gè xīngqī yǒu gè liètóu zhǎo wǒ, shuō yī jiā dàchǎng yǒu gè xīn zhíwèi, xiǎng ràng wǒ guòqu, zuò shǒujī yìngyòng de jièmiàn shèjì, gōngzī bǐ xiànzài gāo yībàn.
turns.en: I've got something to tell you. Last week a headhunter got in touch. A big tech company has a new post and wants me for it, designing interfaces for phone apps. Half as much again as I earn now.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 高一半？可是你到一格才三个星期，又要跳槽？
turns.pinyin: gāo yībàn? kěshì nǐ dào Yīgé cái sān gè xīngqī, yòu yào tiàocáo?
turns.en: Fifty per cent more? But you've only been at 一格 three weeks. You want to change jobs again?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 所以我没答应。听说那边加班特别厉害，而且做界面跟我喜欢的品牌设计不太一样。
turns.pinyin: suǒyǐ wǒ méi dāying. tīngshuō nàbian jiābān tèbié lìhai, érqiě zuò jièmiàn gēn wǒ xǐhuan de pǐnpái shèjì bù tài yīyàng.
turns.en: That's why I said no. I've heard the overtime there is brutal, and interface design isn't the same as the brand design I love.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那我也说件事。有一家公司想跟我合作，在杭州再开一家陈家饺子，钱他们出。
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ yě shuō jiàn shì. yǒu yī jiā gōngsī xiǎng gēn wǒ hézuò, zài Hángzhōu zài kāi yī jiā Chénjiājiǎozi, qián tāmen chū.
turns.en: Then I've got something to tell you too. A company wants to go into partnership with me and open another Chen Family Dumplings in Hangzhou. They'd put up the money.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 第三家店？那可不是小事。你答应了吗？
turns.pinyin: dì sān jiā diàn? nà kě bùshì xiǎo shì. nǐ dāying le ma?
turns.en: A third restaurant? That's no small thing. Have you said yes?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 还没有，我很犹豫。上海店开了还不到三个月，我每天从早上六点忙到晚上十一点。可是再开一家，能多挣不少钱，我还想攒钱在上海买房呢。
turns.pinyin: hái méiyǒu, wǒ hěn yóuyù. Shànghǎi diàn kāi le hái bù dào sān gè yuè, wǒ měitiān cóng zǎoshang liù diǎn máng dào wǎnshang shí yī diǎn. kěshì zài kāi yī jiā, néng duō zhèng bù shǎo qián, wǒ hái xiǎng zǎnqián zài Shànghǎi mǎifáng ne.
turns.en: Not yet. I can't make up my mind. The Shanghai restaurant's been open less than three months, and I'm at it from six in the morning till eleven at night. But another one would bring in a lot more money, and I want to save up to buy a flat in Shanghai.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爸爸，你要是再开一家店，是不是就更没时间陪我了？
turns.pinyin: bàba, nǐ yàoshi zài kāi yī jiā diàn, shì bùshì jiù gèng méi shíjiān péi wǒ le?
turns.en: Dad, if you open another restaurant, will you have even less time for me?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 朵朵问得好。与其为了钱把自己累坏，不如先把上海店做好。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo wèndehǎo. yǔqí wèile qián bǎ zìjǐ lèi huài, bùrú xiān bǎ Shànghǎi diàn zuòhǎo.
turns.en: Good question, Duoduo. Rather than wearing yourself out for the money, why not get the Shanghai restaurant right first?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 话是这么说，可是上海的房价这么贵，一家店挣的钱哪儿够啊？
turns.pinyin: huàshìzhèmeshuō, kěshì Shànghǎi de fángjià zhème guì, yī jiā diàn zhèng de qián nǎr gòu a?
turns.en: That's all very well, but flats in Shanghai are so expensive. How's the money from one restaurant ever going to be enough?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我年轻的时候也换过好几次工作，后来才明白，三心二意，什么都做不好。我宁可少挣一点儿，也要把一件事做好。
turns.pinyin: wǒ niánqīng de shíhou yě huàn guo hǎojǐ cì gōngzuò, hòulái cái míngbai, sānxīn'èryì, shénme dōu zuò bù hǎo. wǒ nìngkě shǎo zhèng yīdiǎnr, yě yào bǎ yī jiàn shì zuòhǎo.
turns.en: I changed jobs a few times when I was young, and I only realised later: if your heart's not in it, you won't do anything well. I'd rather earn a bit less and do one thing properly.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那是因为您那时候房价便宜啊！
turns.pinyin: nà shì yīnwèi nín nàshíhou fángjià piányi a!
turns.en: That's because flats were cheap in your day!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，这倒是。时代不一样了。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, zhè dào shì. shídài bù yīyàng le.
turns.en: Ha ha, fair point. Times have changed.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那你能不能跟他们谈谈？比如新店先不开，让他们先帮上海店做推广。要是谈成了，那就一举两得了。
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ néng bù néng gēn tāmen tán tán? bǐrú xīn diàn xiān bù kāi, ràng tāmen xiān bāng Shànghǎi diàn zuò tuīguǎng. yàoshi tán chéng le, nà jiù yījǔliǎngdé le.
turns.en: Could you talk to them, then? Hold off on the new restaurant, say, and have them help promote the Shanghai one first. If it works out, that's two birds with one stone.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 新店不开，还要人家帮忙？我可开不了口。
turns.pinyin: xīn diàn bù kāi, hái yào rén jiā bāngmáng? wǒ kě kāi bu liǎo kǒu.
turns.en: No new restaurant, and I still ask for their help? I couldn't bring myself to.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这有什么开不了口的？你的饺子好不好，人家心里有数，所以才来找你。上海店才刚起步，现在把它放在一边，去忙杭州的事，半途而废，多可惜。
turns.pinyin: zhè yǒu shénme kāi bu liǎo kǒu de? nǐ de jiǎozi hǎo bù hǎo, rén jiā xīnliyǒushù, suǒyǐ cái lái zhǎo nǐ. Shànghǎi diàn cái gāng qǐbù, xiànzài bǎ tā fàng zài yībiān, qù máng Hángzhōu de shì, bàntú'érfèi, duō kěxī.
turns.en: Why ever not? They know full well how good your dumplings are, and that's why they came to you. The Shanghai restaurant's only just started. If you put it to one side now and get busy with Hangzhou, you'll be giving up halfway, and that would be a shame.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 好吧。与其在这儿纠结，不如明天就去找他们谈谈。
turns.pinyin: hǎo ba. yǔqí zài zhèr jiūjié, bùrú míngtiān jiù qù zhǎo tāmen tán tán.
turns.en: All right. Rather than agonising here, I'll go and talk to them tomorrow.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 这就对了！来，先吃饺子吧，饺子都快凉了。
turns.pinyin: zhè jiù duìle! lái, xiān chī jiǎozi ba, jiǎozi dōu kuài liáng le.
turns.en: That's the spirit! Now eat your dumplings, they're getting cold.

dialogues.title: An old house has its own charm

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我把马克带来了！他跟着中介看房看了一个月，一套都不满意。
turns.pinyin: wǒ bǎ Mǎkè dàilai le! tā gēnzhe zhōngjiè kànfáng kàn le yī gè yuè, yī tào dōu bù mǎnyì.
turns.en: I've brought Mark! He's spent a month viewing flats with agents, and he isn't happy with a single one.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨，侬好！楼下卖早饭的阿姨教我的。
turns.pinyin: āyí, nóng hǎo! lóuxià mài zǎofàn de āyí jiāo wǒ de.
turns.en: Auntie, nong ho! The auntie who sells breakfast downstairs taught me that.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 哟，上海话都学会了！快进来，房间在二楼。楼梯有点儿窄，当心头。
turns.pinyin: yō, shànghǎihuà dōu xuéhuì le! kuài jìnlai, fángjiān zài èr lóu. lóutī yǒudiǎnr zhǎi, dāngxīn tóu.
turns.en: Oh, Shanghainese already! Come in, come in, the room's on the first floor. The stairs are a bit narrow, mind your head.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哇，楼梯是木头的！这房子有多少年了？
turns.pinyin: wa, lóutī shì mùtou de! zhè fángzi yǒu duōshǎo nián le?
turns.en: Wow, wooden stairs! How old is this house?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 房东说是一九三几年造的，快一百年了。他们一家在这儿住了三代人，后来搬到高楼里去了，这房子就租给我们了。
turns.pinyin: fángdōng shuō shì yījiǔsān jǐ nián zào de, kuài yī bǎi nián le. tāmen yī jiā zài zhèr zhù le sān dài rén, hòulái bān dào gāolóu lǐ qù le, zhè fángzi jiù zū gěi wǒmen le.
turns.en: The landlord says it was built in the nineteen-thirties, so it's nearly a hundred years old. Three generations of his family lived here. Then they moved into a tower block, and the house was let to us.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 房间真亮！窗户朝南，外面还有一棵大树。
turns.pinyin: fángjiān zhēn liàng! chuānghu cháonán, wàimiàn hái yǒu yī kē dà shù.
turns.en: The room's so bright! The window faces south, and there's a big tree outside.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 那是梧桐树，夏天挡太阳，冬天叶子掉光了，阳光正好照进来。不过老房子也有老房子的毛病：没有电梯，隔音一般，冬天有点儿冷。
turns.pinyin: nà shì wútóngshù, xiàtiān dǎng tàiyáng, dōngtiān yèzi diào guāng le, yángguāng zhènghǎo zhào jìnlai. bùguò lǎo fángzi yě yǒu lǎo fángzi de máobìng: méiyǒu diàntī, géyīn yībān, dōngtiān yǒudiǎnr lěng.
turns.en: That's a plane tree. In summer it keeps the sun off, and in winter, when all the leaves have fallen, the sunshine comes straight in. But old houses have their faults: there's no lift, the walls are thin, and it's a bit cold in winter.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 厨房和卫生间是合用的吧？
turns.pinyin: chúfáng hé wèishēngjiān shì héyòng de ba?
turns.en: The kitchen and bathroom are shared, aren't they?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 对，跟我们一家合用。二楼另一间是朵朵的。陈明的店关门晚，他天天跟上夜班一样，晚上听见楼梯响，你别担心。
turns.pinyin: duì, gēn wǒmen yī jiā héyòng. èr lóu lìng yī jiān shì Duǒduo de. Chénmíng de diàn guānmén wǎn, tā tiān tiān gēnshàng yèbān yīyàng, wǎnshang tīngjiàn lóutī xiǎng, nǐ bié dānxīn.
turns.en: Yes, with all of us. The other room on this floor is Duoduo's. Chen Ming's restaurant closes late, so every day's like a night shift for him. If you hear the stairs creak at night, don't worry.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那房租怎么算？
turns.pinyin: nà fángzū zěnme suàn?
turns.en: And how does the rent work?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 一个月三千五，水电煤另算，网费我包了。你不用通过中介，中介费也省了。
turns.pinyin: yī gè yuè sānqiānwǔ, shuǐdiànméi lìng suàn, wǎngfèi wǒ bāo le. nǐ bùyòng tōngguò zhōngjiè, zhōngjièfèi yě shěng le.
turns.en: Three thousand five hundred a month. Water, electricity and gas are extra; I'll cover the internet. And since you're not going through an agent, you save the agent's fee.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 才三千五？上个星期中介带我看的那套，一个月五千五，押一付三，还要多付一个月的中介费。这样算下来，一开始就得交两万七。
turns.pinyin: cái sānqiānwǔ? shàng gè xīngqī zhōngjiè dài wǒ kàn de nà tào, yī gè yuè wǔqiān wǔ, yāyīfùsān, hái yào duō fù yī gè yuè de zhōngjièfèi. zhèyàng suànxiàlái, yī kāishǐ jiù děi jiāo liǎngwàn qī.
turns.en: Only three thousand five hundred? The flat the agent showed me last week was five thousand five hundred a month, one month's deposit and three months up front, plus an extra month as the agent's fee. That adds up to twenty-seven thousand before I've even started.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 上海租房都是这个规矩。那套不是还有电梯吗？
turns.pinyin: Shànghǎi zū fáng dōu shì zhège guīju. nà tào bùshì hái yǒu diàntī ma?
turns.en: That's how renting works in Shanghai. Didn't that one have a lift, though?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 是啊。那套在一个新小区，二十几层，有电梯，还有健身房。可是离地铁站要走二十分钟，房间也小，窗户对着别人家的窗户。
turns.pinyin: shì a. nà tào zài yī gè xīn xiǎoqū, èr shí jǐ céng, yǒu diàntī, hái yǒu jiànshēnfáng. kěshì lí dìtiězhàn yào zǒu èr shí fēnzhōng, fángjiān yě xiǎo, chuānghu duìzhe biéren jiā de chuānghu.
turns.en: It did. It was in a new estate, on the twenty-somethingth floor, with a lift and even a gym. But it was twenty minutes' walk from the metro, the room was small, and the window looked straight into someone else's.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 新房子干净、方便，老房子有味道，各有各的好。
turns.pinyin: xīn fángzi gānjìng, fāngbiàn, lǎo fángzi yǒu wèidào, gèyǒugèdehǎo.
turns.en: New flats are clean and convenient, old houses have character. Each has its good points.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 没有电梯我倒是不怕，每天爬楼梯就当锻炼了。就是……冬天到底有多冷？
turns.pinyin: méiyǒu diàntī wǒ dàoshì bù pà, měitiān pá lóutī jiù dàng duànliàn le. jiùshì dōngtiān dàodǐ yǒu duō lěng?
turns.en: I don't mind about the lift. Climbing the stairs every day can be my exercise. It's just... how cold does it actually get in winter?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 房间里有空调，冷不到哪里去的。再说，天冷了，阿姨给你煮汤圆吃。
turns.pinyin: fángjiān lǐ yǒu kōngtiáo, lěng bùdàonǎliqù de. zàishuō, tiān lěng le, āyí gěi nǐ zhǔ tāngyuán chī.
turns.en: There's air conditioning in the room, it won't be that cold. And anyway, when it gets cold, Auntie will make you some tangyuan.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 马克，你还犹豫什么？这么好的房东，打着灯笼都难找！
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, nǐ hái yóuyù shénme? zhème hǎode fángdōng, dǎzhedēnglongdōunánzhǎo!
turns.en: Mark, what are you waiting for? A landlady this good, you won't find one if you search high and low!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好，那就这么定了！阿姨，合同什么时候签？
turns.pinyin: hǎo, nà jiùzhèmedìngle! āyí, hétong shénmeshíhou qiān?
turns.en: Right, it's settled! Auntie, when shall we sign the contract?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 合同？自己家里人，还签什么合同！……好，你要合同，阿姨就给你写一份：押一付三，按上海的规矩来！
turns.pinyin: hétong? zìjǐ jiālirén, hái qiān shénme hétong! hǎo, nǐ yào hétong, āyí jiù gěi nǐ xiě yī fèn: yāyīfùsān, àn Shànghǎi de guīju lái!
turns.en: A contract? Between family? ...All right. If it's a contract you want, Auntie will write you one: a month's deposit and three months up front, the Shanghai way!

dialogues.title: And what kind of rubbish is this?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 马克，等一等！你这一袋是什么垃圾？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, děng yī děng! nǐ zhè yī dài shì shénme lājī?
turns.en: Mark, hold on! And what kind of rubbish is this bag?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 就是……普通的垃圾啊，中午吃剩的外卖，还有几张纸巾。
turns.pinyin: jiùshì pǔtōng de lājī a, zhōngwǔ chī shèng de wàimài, hái yǒu jǐ zhāng zhǐjīn.
turns.en: It's just... ordinary rubbish. What's left of a takeaway from lunch, and a few tissues.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 在上海可没有“普通垃圾”。吃剩的饭菜是湿垃圾，用过的纸巾是干垃圾，必须分开扔，否则我这个志愿者不是白当了？
turns.pinyin: zài Shànghǎi kě méiyǒu pǔtōng lājī. chī shèng de fàn cài shì shīlājī, yòng guo de zhǐjīn shì gānlājī, bìxū fēnkāi rēng, fǒuzé wǒ zhège zhìyuànzhě bùshì bái dāng le?
turns.en: There's no such thing as 'ordinary rubbish' in Shanghai. Leftover food is wet rubbish, used tissues are dry rubbish. They have to go in separately, otherwise what am I volunteering for?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 纸巾不是纸吗？纸不是可以回收吗？
turns.pinyin: zhǐjīn bùshì zhǐ ma? zhǐ bùshì kěyǐ huíshōu ma?
turns.en: Aren't tissues paper? Can't paper be recycled?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 用过的纸巾脏了，回收不了，所以算干垃圾。干净的纸盒、旧报纸才是可回收物。
turns.pinyin: yòng guo de zhǐjīn zāng le, huíshōu bù liǎo, suǒyǐ suàn gānlājī. gānjìng de zhǐhé, jiù bàozhǐ cái shì kěhuíshōuwù.
turns.en: Used tissues are dirty, they can't be recycled, so they count as dry rubbish. Clean cardboard and old newspapers are recyclables.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这么复杂！那塑料袋呢？
turns.pinyin: zhème fùzá! nà sùliàodài ne?
turns.en: It's so complicated! What about the plastic bag?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 湿垃圾要破袋：把袋子打开，里面的东西倒进湿垃圾桶，袋子扔进干垃圾桶。
turns.pinyin: shīlājī yào pòdài: bǎ dàizi dǎkāi, lǐmiàn de dōngxi dào jìn shī lājītǒng, dàizi rēng jìn gān lājītǒng.
turns.en: Wet rubbish has to be taken out of the bag: open it, tip what's inside into the wet bin, and put the bag in the dry bin.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 用手倒？……好吧。那这杯奶茶呢？还有一半没喝完。
turns.pinyin: yòng shǒu dào? hǎo ba. nà zhè bēi nǎichá ne? hái yǒu yībàn méi hē wán.
turns.en: By hand? ...All right. And this bubble tea? I've only drunk half.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 奶茶先倒掉，珍珠是湿垃圾，杯子和盖子是干垃圾。
turns.pinyin: nǎichá xiān dào diào, zhēnzhū shì shīlājī, bēizi hé gàizi shì gānlājī.
turns.en: Pour the tea away first. The pearls are wet rubbish, the cup and lid are dry.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 一杯奶茶要分三次扔……我都糊涂了。有没有简单一点儿的办法？
turns.pinyin: yī bēi nǎichá yào fēn sān cì rēng wǒ dōu hútu le. yǒu méiyǒu jiǎndān yīdiǎnr de bànfǎ?
turns.en: One bubble tea, three trips to the bins... I'm lost. Isn't there a simpler way?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 有个口诀，我们同学都这么记：猪爱吃的是湿垃圾，猪不吃的是干垃圾，猪吃了会生病的是有害垃圾，能卖钱的是可回收物。
turns.pinyin: yǒu gè kǒujué, wǒmen tóngxué dōu zhème jì: zhū ài chī de shì shīlājī, zhū bù chī de shì gānlājī, zhū chī le huì shēngbìng de shì yǒuhàilājī, néng mài qián de shì kěhuíshōuwù.
turns.en: There's a rhyme everyone in my class uses: if a pig would eat it, it's wet; if a pig won't eat it, it's dry; if it would make a pig ill, it's hazardous; and if you can sell it, it's recyclable.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，这个好记！那骨头呢？猪吃骨头吗？
turns.pinyin: hāhā, zhège hǎojì! nà gǔtou ne? zhū chī gǔtou ma?
turns.en: Ha ha, that's easy to remember! So what about bones? Do pigs eat bones?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 小骨头算湿垃圾，大骨头太硬，算干垃圾。
turns.pinyin: xiǎo gǔtou suàn shīlājī, dà gǔtou tài yìng, suàn gānlājī.
turns.en: Small bones count as wet rubbish. Big bones are too hard, so they're dry.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 你看，口诀也不是万能的。我刚来上海的时候也搞不清楚，天天站在垃圾桶旁边研究，奶奶还天天检查。
turns.pinyin: nǐ kàn, kǒujué yě bùshì wànnéng de. wǒ gāng lái Shànghǎi de shíhou yě gǎo bù qīngchu, tiān tiān zhàn zài lājītǒng pángbiān yánjiū, nǎinai hái tiān tiān jiǎnchá.
turns.en: See? The rhyme doesn't cover everything. When I first came to Shanghai I couldn't work it out either. I stood by the bins every day puzzling over it, and Grandma checked every single day.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可是每天这样分，大家不嫌麻烦吗？
turns.pinyin: kěshì měitiān zhèyàng fēn, dàjiā bù xián máfan ma?
turns.en: But sorting like this every day, don't people find it a pain?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 麻烦是麻烦。可是你想想，上海两千多万人，每天产生多少垃圾？以前由于不分类，大部分只能埋掉、烧掉。现在湿垃圾能做成肥料，可回收物能再利用，值得！
turns.pinyin: máfan shì máfan. kěshì nǐ xiǎng xiang, Shànghǎi liǎng qiān duō wàn rén, měitiān chǎnshēng duōshǎo lājī? yǐqián yóuyú bù fēnlèi, dàbùfen zhǐ néng mái diào, shāo diào. xiànzài shīlājī néng zuò chéng féiliào, kěhuíshōuwù néng zài lìyòng, zhíde!
turns.en: It's a pain, yes. But think about it: Shanghai's got over twenty million people, and how much rubbish do they make every day? Before, because nothing was sorted, most of it could only be buried or burned. Now the wet rubbish becomes fertiliser and the recyclables get used again. It's worth it!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 明白了。阿姨，以后我保证分好了再下来。
turns.pinyin: míngbai le. āyí, yǐhòu wǒ bǎozhèng fēn hǎole zài xiàlai.
turns.en: I get it. Auntie, from now on I promise to sort it before I come down.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 这就对了。还有，纸盒要压扁了再拿下来，不然太占地方。明天我还在这里，我来检查！朵朵，你的也一样。
turns.pinyin: zhè jiù duìle. hái yǒu, zhǐhé yào yābiǎn le zài ná xiàlai, bùrán tài zhàn dìfang. míngtiān wǒ hái zài zhè lǐ, wǒ lái jiǎnchá! Duǒduo, nǐ de yě yīyàng.
turns.en: That's more like it. And flatten your boxes before you bring them down, or they take up too much room. I'll be here again tomorrow, and I'll be checking! Yours too, Duoduo.

dialogues.title: Grandma's baskets are coming to town

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 小雨，马克，我想请你们公司帮个忙，不知道合适不合适。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, Mǎkè, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐmen gōngsī bāng gè máng, bù zhīdào héshì bù héshì.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, Mark, I'd like to ask your agency a favour, though I'm not sure it's the right thing to ask.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 说来听听。
turns.pinyin: shuōláitīngting.
turns.en: Let's hear it.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 我老家在浙江西边的山里，一个叫竹溪的小村子。村里很多老人会用竹子编篮子，可是年轻人都出去打工了，这门手艺快没人学了。最近村里成立了一个合作社，我弟弟也在里面，他们想做一个自己的品牌，把竹编卖到城里去。
turns.pinyin: wǒ lǎojiā zài Zhèjiāng xībian de shān lǐ, yī gè jiào Zhúxī de xiǎo cūnzi. cūn lǐ hěnduō lǎorén huì yòng zhúzi biān lánzi, kěshì niánqīngrén dōu chūqu dǎgōng le, zhè mén shǒuyì kuài méi rén xué le. zuìjìn cūn lǐ chénglì le yī gè hézuòshè, wǒ dìdi yě zài lǐmiàn, tāmen xiǎng zuò yī gè zìjǐ de pǐnpái, bǎ zhúbiān mài dào chénglǐ qù.
turns.en: My home village is a little place called Zhuxi, up in the hills in the west of Zhejiang. Lots of the old people there weave baskets from bamboo, but the young people have all gone off to work in the cities, and soon there'll be nobody left to learn the craft. The village has just set up a co-operative, and my brother's in it. They want a brand of their own, to sell their bamboo work in the cities.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 竹编？我在伦敦的一家店里见过这种篮子，一个要好几十英镑呢。
turns.pinyin: zhúbiān? wǒ zài Lúndūn de yī jiā diàn lǐ jiàn guo zhè zhǒng lánzi, yī gè yào hǎojǐ shí yīngbàng ne.
turns.en: Bamboo weaving? I've seen baskets like that in a shop in London. They were dozens of pounds each.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 在我们村，一个才卖几十块钱。我妈辛辛苦苦编好几天，挣的钱还不够买一件衣服。
turns.pinyin: zài wǒmen cūn, yī gè cái mài jǐ shí kuài qián. wǒ mā xīnxīnkǔkǔ biān hǎo jǐ tiān, zhèng de qián hái bù gòu mǎi yī jiàn yīfu.
turns.en: In our village one sells for just a few dozen yuan. My mum works hard on one for days, and what she earns wouldn't buy a shirt.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 所以问题不是东西不好，而是没有人帮他们把故事讲好。
turns.pinyin: suǒyǐ wèntí bùshì dōngxi bù hǎo, érshì méiyǒu rén bāng tāmen bǎ gùshi jiǎng hǎo.
turns.en: So the problem isn't that the baskets aren't good. It's that nobody's helping them tell their story well.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 他们的预算多少？
turns.pinyin: tāmen de yùsuàn duōshǎo?
turns.en: What's their budget?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 不多。说实话，这个项目可能赚不了什么钱。
turns.pinyin: bù duō. shuōshíhuà, zhège xiàngmù kěnéng zhuàn bù liǎo shénme qián.
turns.en: Not much. To be honest, you probably won't make any money on it.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 赚钱的项目我们做得不少了。马克，明天我们一起去跟老板说吧。
turns.pinyin: zhuànqián de xiàngmù wǒmen zuò de bù shǎo le. Mǎkè, míngtiān wǒmen yīqǐ qù gēn lǎobǎn shuō ba.
turns.en: We've done plenty of projects that make money. Mark, let's go and talk to the boss together tomorrow.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我看可以做。现在城里人就喜欢手工的东西，关键是设计要跟上。再说，帮一门老手艺找条活路，也是件好事。
turns.pinyin: wǒ kàn kěyǐ zuò. xiànzài chénglǐ rén jiù xǐhuan shǒugōng de dōngxi, guānjiàn shì shèjì yào gēnshàng. zàishuō, bāng yī mén lǎo shǒuyì zhǎo tiáo huólù, yěshì jiàn hǎoshì.
turns.en: I think you should. City people love handmade things these days; the key is for the design to keep up. Besides, helping an old craft find a way to survive is a good thing to do.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，你小时候也去过竹溪吗？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, nǐ xiǎoshíhou yě qù guo Zhúxī ma?
turns.en: Xiaoyu, did you go to Zhuxi when you were little?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 去过，我每年暑假都在那儿过。跟我一起玩的孩子，爸妈都在宁波的工厂打工，他们跟着爷爷奶奶在村里长大，就是大家说的“留守儿童”。爸妈一年只回来一次，就是过年的时候。
turns.pinyin: qù guo, wǒ měi nián shǔjià dōu zài nàr guò. gēn wǒ yīqǐ wán de háizi, bàmā dōu zài Níngbō de gōngchǎng dǎgōng, tāmen gēnzhe yéye nǎinai zài cūn lǐ zhǎngdà, jiùshì dàjiā shuō de liúshǒu'értóng. bàmā yī nián zhǐ huílai yī cì, jiùshì guònián de shíhou.
turns.en: I did. I spent every summer holiday there. The children I played with had parents working in factories in Ningbo, and they grew up in the village with their grandparents. They were what people call 'left-behind children'. Their parents came home once a year, at Spring Festival.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那一定很难受吧。
turns.pinyin: nà yīdìng hěn nánshòu ba.
turns.en: That must have been very hard.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 他们确实很想爸妈。有个孩子，每次过完年爸妈一走，她就躲在奶奶身后哭。不过现在她能理解了：他们要是不出去，她可能也上不了大学。
turns.pinyin: tāmen quèshí hěn xiǎng bàmā. yǒu gè háizi, měi cì guò wán nián bàmā yī zǒu, tā jiù duǒ zài nǎinai shēnhòu kū. bùguò xiànzài tā néng lǐjiě le: tāmen yàoshi bù chūqu, tā kěnéng yě shàng bù liǎo dàxué.
turns.en: They really did miss their parents. There was one girl who hid behind her grandma and cried every year when her mum and dad left after Spring Festival. But she understands now: if they hadn't gone, she might never have gone to university.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 我们那一代农村孩子，也是这样走出来的：我去了北京，小雨她妈妈去了成都。随着城市越来越大，村子越来越空，好像每个人的老家都在变小。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen nà yī dài nóngcūn háizi, yěshì zhèyàng zǒu chūlai de: wǒ qù le běijīng, Xiǎoyǔ tā māma qù le chéngdū. suízhe chéngshì yuèláiyuè dà, cūnzi yuèláiyuè kōng, hǎoxiàng měi gè rén de lǎojiā dōu zài biàn xiǎo.
turns.en: That's how my generation of village children got out too: I went to Beijing, and Xiaoyu's mum went to Chengdu. As the cities keep growing and the villages keep emptying, it's as if everyone's hometown is shrinking.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 也不全是这样。这几年，有些年轻人又回来了，在村里开民宿、做直播。我表弟就是，他在网上卖竹编，一个月能卖好几百个。
turns.pinyin: yě bù quán shì zhèyàng. zhè jǐ nián, yǒuxiē niánqīngrén yòu huílai le, zài cūn lǐ kāi mínsù, zuò zhíbō. wǒ biǎodì jiùshì, tā zài wǎngshang mài zhúbiān, yī gè yuè néng mài hǎojǐ bǎi gè.
turns.en: It's not all like that. In the last few years some young people have come back, to open guesthouses or do livestreaming in the village. My cousin's one. He sells bamboo baskets online, several hundred a month.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 好，那就这么定了。下个月找个周末，我们全家一起回竹溪看看，我也好几年没见姥姥了。妈，您来安排。
turns.pinyin: hǎo, nà jiùzhèmedìngle. xià gè yuè zhǎo gè zhōumò, wǒmen quánjiā yīqǐ huí Zhúxī kàn kan, wǒ yě hǎojǐ nián méi jiàn lǎolao le. mā, nín lái ānpái.
turns.en: Good, then that's settled. Next month we'll find a weekend and all go back to Zhuxi to have a look. I haven't seen Grandma in years either. Mum, you organise it.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 太好了！我妈一定高兴坏了。她编的篮子，终于要进城了。
turns.pinyin: tàihǎole! wǒ mā yīdìng gāoxìnghuàile. tā biān de lánzi, zhōngyú yào jìnchéng le.
turns.en: Wonderful! My mum will be over the moon. Her baskets are finally coming to town.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 马克，今天阿拉请侬吃早饭！这个摊子的大饼最好吃，爷爷付钱。
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, jīntiān ālā qǐng nóng chī zǎofàn! zhège tānzi de dàbǐng zuì hǎochī, yéye fùqián.
turns.en: Mark, breakfast's on us today! This stall does the best flatbread, and Grandpa's paying.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “阿拉”是“我们”的意思吧？弄堂里的阿姨们天天说，我都学会了。
turns.pinyin: ālā shì wǒmen de yìsi ba? lòngtáng lǐ de āyí men tiān tiān shuō, wǒ dōu xuéhuì le.
turns.en: 'Alah' means 'we', doesn't it? The aunties in the lane say it every day, so I've picked it up.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 对，“阿拉”是我们，“侬”是你，是我同学的奶奶教我的。来，大饼、油条、粢饭、豆浆，这是上海早饭的“四大金刚”。
turns.pinyin: duì, ālā shì wǒmen, nóng shì nǐ, shì wǒ tóngxué de nǎinai jiāo wǒ de. lái, dàbǐng, yóutiáo, cífàn, dòujiāng, zhè shì Shànghǎi zǎofàn de sìdàjīngāng.
turns.en: That's right: 'alah' is 'we' and 'nong' is 'you'. My classmate's grandma taught me. Here: sesame flatbread, fried dough sticks, sticky rice rolls and soya milk. They're the 'Four Guardians' of a Shanghai breakfast.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 一下子吃四种？那我中午就不用吃了。
turns.pinyin: yīxiàzi chī sì zhǒng? nà wǒ zhōngwǔ jiù bùyòng chī le.
turns.en: All four at once? Then I won't need lunch.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克，听说你要写文章参加比赛？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, tīngshuō nǐ yào xiě wénzhāng cānjiā bǐsài?
turns.en: Mark, I hear you're writing something for a competition?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对，是区里办的征文比赛，题目叫“我的上海”。我写了好几天了，一个字都不满意。
turns.pinyin: duì, shì qū lǐ bàn de zhēngwén bǐsài, tímù jiào wǒ de Shànghǎi. wǒ xiě le hǎojǐ tiān le, yī gè zì dōu bù mǎnyì.
turns.en: Yes, it's an essay competition run by the district, called 'My Shanghai'. I've been writing for days, and I'm not happy with a single word.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这有什么难的？写外滩，写东方明珠，写陆家嘴的高楼。
turns.pinyin: zhè yǒu shénme nán de? xiě Wàitān, xiě Dōngfāngmíngzhū, xiě Lùjiāzuǐ de gāolóu.
turns.en: What's so hard about that? Write about the Bund, the Pearl Tower, the skyscrapers in Lujiazui.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那些谁都写过。我想写的不是风景，而是……怎么说呢，一种感觉。
turns.pinyin: nàxiē shéi dōu xiě guo. wǒ xiǎng xiě de bùshì fēngjǐng, érshì zěnme shuō ne, yī zhǒng gǎnjué.
turns.en: Everyone's written about those. What I want to write about isn't the sights. It's... how can I put it... a feeling.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 什么感觉？
turns.pinyin: shénme gǎnjué?
turns.en: What kind of feeling?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 比如早上弄堂里的声音，阿姨们用上海话聊天，还有晾在外面的衣服。刚搬来的时候，我看见一整排衣服挂在两座房子中间，不禁停下来看了半天。
turns.pinyin: bǐrú zǎoshang lòngtáng lǐ de shēngyīn, āyí men yòng shànghǎihuà liáotiān, hái yǒu liàng zài wàimiàn de yīfu. gāng bān lái de shíhou, wǒ kànjiàn yī zhěng pái yīfu guà zài liǎng zuò fángzi zhōngjiān, bùjīn tíng xià lai kàn le bàntiān.
turns.en: Like the sounds in the lane in the morning, the aunties chatting in Shanghainese, and the washing hung out to dry. When I first moved in, I saw a whole row of clothes strung up between two houses, and I couldn't help stopping to stare.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，晾衣服有什么好看的？北京的胡同里也天天晾。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, liàng yīfu yǒu shénme hǎokàn de? běijīng de hútòng lǐ yě tiān tiān liàng.
turns.en: Ha ha, what's so interesting about washing? They hang it out every day in Beijing's hutongs too.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对你们来说很平常，对我来说却很新鲜。还有路边的梧桐树，秋天叶子一黄，走在下面，我仿佛回到了伦敦。
turns.pinyin: duì nǐmen láishuō hěn píngcháng, duì wǒ láishuō què hěn xīnxiān. hái yǒu lù biān de wútóngshù, qiūtiān yèzi yī Huáng, zǒu zài xià miàn, wǒ fǎngfú huídào le Lúndūn.
turns.en: It's ordinary to you, but it's all new to me. And the plane trees along the roads. When the leaves turn yellow in autumn and I walk under them, it's as if I'm back in London.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 侬晓得伐？这种树，上海人叫“法国梧桐”。我们老师说的。
turns.pinyin: nóng xiǎode fá? zhè zhǒng shù, shànghǎirén jiào fǎguówútóng. wǒmen lǎoshī shuō de.
turns.en: Did you know? Shanghai people call these trees 'French plane trees'. Our teacher told us.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可是在英国，它叫“伦敦的梧桐”，伦敦的街上到处都是。
turns.pinyin: kěshì zài yīngguó, tā jiào Lúndūn de wútóng, Lúndūn de jiē shang dàochù dōu shì.
turns.en: But in Britain it's called the London plane. London's streets are full of them.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那你就写这个！一个伦敦人，在上海的梧桐树下面想起伦敦。既有上海，又有你自己。
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ jiù xiě zhège! yī gè Lúndūn rén, zài Shànghǎi de wútóngshù xià miàn xiǎngqǐ Lúndūn. jì yǒu Shànghǎi, yòu yǒu nǐ zìjǐ.
turns.en: Then write about that! A Londoner, under the plane trees in Shanghai, thinking of London. It's got Shanghai in it, and it's got you.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可是我的中文写不出那种味道。
turns.pinyin: kěshì wǒ de zhōngwén xiěbuchū nà zhǒng wèidao.
turns.en: But my Chinese can't capture that kind of feeling.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 写文章不用那么多漂亮话。你写自己真正看到的、真正感觉到的，就是好文章。
turns.pinyin: xiě wénzhāng bùyòng nàme duō piàolianghuà. nǐ xiě zìjǐ zhēnzhèng kàn dào de, zhēnzhèng gǎnjué dào de, jiùshì hǎo wénzhāng.
turns.en: You don't need fancy words to write well. Write what you really saw and really felt, and that's a good essay.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 写好了先给阿拉看看。写得好，爷爷请侬吃大闸蟹！
turns.pinyin: xiě hǎole xiān gěi ālā kàn kan. xiě de hǎo, yéye qǐng nóng chī dàzháxiè!
turns.en: Show us when it's done. If it's good, Grandpa will treat you to hairy crab!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 马克，早！难得看到你周末起这么早，也来买菜啊？
turns.pinyin: Mǎkè, zǎo! nándé kàn dào nǐ zhōumò qǐ zhème zǎo, yě lái mǎi cài a?
turns.en: Morning, Mark! It's not often I see you up this early at the weekend. Are you doing some shopping too?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨说这个菜场的馄饨皮最好，让我来买一点儿，晚上咱们一起包馄饨。
turns.pinyin: āyí shuō zhège càichǎng de húntunpí zuìhǎo, ràng wǒ lái mǎi yīdiǎnr, wǎnshang zánmen yīqǐ bāo húntun.
turns.en: Auntie says this market has the best wonton wrappers, so she sent me to get some. We're all making wontons tonight.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 我帮你算：馄饨皮一斤八块，荠菜半斤十块，一共十八块。摊主说，扫这里就行。
turns.pinyin: wǒ bāng nǐ suàn: húntunpí yī jīn bā kuài, jìcài bàn jīn shí kuài, yīgòng shí bā kuài. tānzhǔ shuō, sǎo zhè lǐ jiù xíng.
turns.en: I'll add it up for you: a jin of wrappers is eight yuan, half a jin of shepherd's purse is ten, so that's eighteen altogether. The stallholder says just scan here.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 好……哎，怎么黑屏了？糟糕，昨天晚上忘了充电，手机没电了！
turns.pinyin: hǎo āi, zěnme hēipíng le? zāogāo, zuótiān wǎnshang wàng le chōngdiàn, shǒujī méidiàn le!
turns.en: Right... hang on, why's the screen gone black? Oh no, I forgot to charge it last night. My phone's dead!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那你身上带现金了吗？
turns.pinyin: nà nǐ shēnshang dài xiànjīn le ma?
turns.en: Have you got any cash on you, then?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 现金？我来上海八个月了，一次都没用过，连钱包放在哪儿都忘了。
turns.pinyin: xiànjīn? wǒ lái Shànghǎi bā gè yuè le, yī cì dōu méi yòng guo, lián qiánbāo fàng zài nǎr dōu wàng le.
turns.en: Cash? I've been in Shanghai eight months and I haven't used it once. I can't even remember where I put my wallet.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 我来吧。老板，给您二十块，找我两块。
turns.pinyin: wǒ lái ba. lǎobǎn, gěi nín èr shí kuài, zhǎo wǒ liǎng kuài.
turns.en: I'll get it. Here's twenty, give me two back.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，摊主说他这儿没有零钱，两块钱就算了吧。现在谁还用现金啊！
turns.pinyin: yéye, tānzhǔ shuō tā zhèr méiyǒu língqián, liǎng kuài qián jiù suànle ba. xiànzài shéi hái yòng xiànjīn a!
turns.en: Grandad, the stallholder says he hasn't got any change, so forget the two yuan. Who uses cash these days!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那怎么行？我这儿有硬币……一块、两块，正好十八块。
turns.pinyin: nà zěnme xíng? wǒ zhèr yǒu yìngbì yī kuài, liǎng kuài, zhènghǎo shí bā kuài.
turns.en: I can't have that. I've got coins here... one, two, that's exactly eighteen.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，谢谢您！等手机有电了，我马上转给您。
turns.pinyin: shūshu, xièxie nín! děng shǒujī yǒu diàn le, wǒ mǎshàng zhuǎn gěi nín.
turns.en: Thank you, Uncle! As soon as my phone's charged, I'll transfer it to you.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 十八块钱，转什么转。倒是你要记住：手机再方便，也不能全靠它。没电了、没信号了，你就寸步难行。
turns.pinyin: shí bā kuài qián, zhuǎn shénme zhuǎn. dàoshì nǐ yào jìzhù: shǒujī zài fāngbiàn, yě bù néng quánkào tā. méidiàn le, méi xìnhào le, nǐ jiù cùnbùnánxíng.
turns.en: For eighteen yuan? Don't be silly. But remember this: however handy your phone is, you can't rely on it for everything. When it's flat or there's no signal, you can't do a thing.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 您说得对。不过我看您用微信用得挺熟练的，为什么不用手机付钱呢？
turns.pinyin: nín shuō de duì. bùguò wǒ kàn nín yòng wēixìn yòng de tǐng shúliàn de, wèishénme bùyòng shǒujī fùqián ne?
turns.en: You're right. But you're pretty good on WeChat. Why don't you pay by phone?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 聊天、看新闻、听京剧，我都会。陈明也帮我开通了，可是我就是不肯绑银行卡。上个月隔壁的一位老人接到一个电话，说他的账户出了问题，让他把验证码告诉他们，差点儿被骗走两万块。
turns.pinyin: liáotiān, kàn xīnwén, tīng jīngjù, wǒ dōu huì. Chénmíng yě bāng wǒ kāitōng le, kěshì wǒ jiùshì bù kěn bǎng yínhángkǎ. shàng gè yuè gébì de yī wèi lǎorén jiē dào yī gè diànhuà, shuō tā de zhànghù chū le wèntí, ràng tā bǎ yànzhèngmǎ gàosu tāmen, chàdiǎnr bèi piàn zǒu liǎng wàn kuài.
turns.en: Chatting, reading the news, listening to Beijing opera, I can do all that. Chen Ming even set it up for me, but I just won't link my bank card. Last month an old man next door got a call saying there was a problem with his account and asking for his verification code, and he nearly got conned out of twenty thousand.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这种事确实可怕。不过手机支付本身挺安全的，只要不把密码告诉别人……
turns.pinyin: zhè zhǒng shì quèshí kěpà. bùguò shǒujī zhīfù běnshēn tǐng ānquán de, zhǐ yào bù bǎ mìmǎ gàosu biéren
turns.en: That kind of thing really is frightening. But paying by phone is quite safe in itself, as long as you don't tell anyone your password...

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 你讲得轻松。对我们老人来说，字那么小，按钮那么多，一不小心就按错了。再说，现金看得见、摸得着，花一张少一张，心里有数。用手机，钱花出去了都没感觉。
turns.pinyin: nǐ jiǎng de qīngsōng. duì wǒmen lǎorén láishuō, zì nàme xiǎo, ànniǔ nàme duō, yībùxiǎoxīn jiù àn cuò le. zàishuō, xiànjīn kàndejiàn, mō de zháo, huā yī zhāng shǎo yī zhāng, xīnliyǒushù. yòng shǒujī, qián huā chūqu le dōu méi gǎnjué.
turns.en: Easy for you to say. For us old folk, the writing's so small and there are so many buttons, one slip and you've pressed the wrong one. Besides, cash is something you can see and touch. Every note you spend is one fewer, so you know where you are. With a phone, the money's gone and you don't even feel it.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 这倒是。我这个月点外卖花了多少，自己都说不清楚。
turns.pinyin: zhè dàoshì. wǒ zhège yuè diǎn wàimài huā le duōshǎo, zìjǐ dōu shuō bu qīngchu.
turns.en: That's true. I couldn't tell you how much I've spent on takeaways this month.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，我教您扫码吧，很简单的！我爸爸店里的客人一天到晚都在扫码，他晚上用手机一算账，就知道今天挣了多少。
turns.pinyin: yéye, wǒ jiāo nín sǎomǎ ba, hěn jiǎndān de! wǒ bàba diàn lǐ de kèrén yītiāndàowǎn dōu zài sǎomǎ, tā wǎnshang yòng shǒujī yī suànzhàng, jiù zhīdào jīntiān zhèng le duōshǎo.
turns.en: Grandad, let me teach you to scan a code. It's really easy! The customers at my dad's restaurant are scanning codes from morning to night, and when he does the sums on his phone in the evening, he knows straight away what he's made that day.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 学学可以，绑不绑银行卡，我再想想。方便的同时，也要留个心眼。走，爷爷请你们吃碗小馄饨，用现金！
turns.pinyin: xué xué kěyǐ, bǎng bù bǎng yínhángkǎ, wǒ zài xiǎng xiang. fāngbiàn detóngshí, yě yào liú gè xīnyǎn. zǒu, yéye qǐng nǐmen chī wǎn xiǎohúntun, yòng xiànjīn!
turns.en: I don't mind learning. Whether I link my bank card, I'll think about. Enjoy the convenience, but keep your wits about you. Come on, Grandad's treating you both to a bowl of little wontons. In cash!

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你们快来看！老家的小川又在直播了，现在在线的有两千多人！
turns.pinyin: nǐmen kuài lái kàn! lǎojiā de Xiǎochuān yòu zài zhíbō le, xiànzài zàixiàn de yǒu liǎng qiān duō rén!
turns.en: Come and look, all of you! Xiaochuan, back in my village, is livestreaming again, and there are over two thousand people watching!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 两千多人？上个月您不是还说，他一场直播只有几十个人看吗？
turns.pinyin: liǎng qiān duō rén? shàng gè yuè nín bùshì hái shuō, tā yī chǎng zhíbō zhǐ yǒu jǐ shí gè rén kàn ma?
turns.en: Over two thousand? Didn't you say last month that only a few dozen people watched each stream?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 上个星期他拍了一条家里老人编竹篮的短视频，一下子就火了，播放量三百多万。现在他也算是个小网红了。
turns.pinyin: shàng gè xīngqī tā pāi le yī tiáo jiā lǐ lǎorén biān zhúlán de duǎnshìpín, yīxiàzi jiù huǒ le, bōfàngliàng sān bǎi duō wàn. xiànzài tā yě suàn shì gè xiǎo wǎnghóng le.
turns.en: Last week he filmed a short video of the old lady of his family weaving a basket, and it took off overnight: over three million views. He's a bit of an internet star now.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 流量来了，订单也跟着来了吧？
turns.pinyin: liúliàng lái le, dìngdān yě gēnzhe lái le ba?
turns.en: And where the traffic goes, the orders follow, right?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 是啊，一个星期的订单比以前半年还多。可是村里的老人一天只能编两三个，合作社都忙不过来了。
turns.pinyin: shì a, yī gè xīngqī de dìngdān bǐ yǐqián bàn nián hái duō. kěshì cūn lǐ de lǎorén yī tiān zhǐ néng biān liǎng sān gè, hézuòshè dōu mángbuguòlái le.
turns.en: Yes, one week's orders are more than half a year's used to be. But the old people in the village can only weave two or three a day, and the co-op can't keep up.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这就是流量，来得快，去得也快。我看啊，关键还是东西要好。
turns.pinyin: zhè jiùshì liúliàng, lái de kuài, qù de yě kuài. wǒ kàn a, guānjiàn háishi dōngxi yào hǎo.
turns.en: That's traffic for you: quick to come, quick to go. If you ask me, what matters is that the baskets are good.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说到短视频，我昨天看了一下手机的使用时间：平均每天六个小时，其中三个小时在刷短视频。
turns.pinyin: shuōdào duǎnshìpín, wǒ zuótiān kàn le yīxià shǒujī de shǐyòng shíjiān: píngjūn měitiān liù gè xiǎoshí, qízhōng sān gè xiǎoshí zài shuā duǎnshìpín.
turns.en: Talking of short videos, yesterday I checked my screen time: six hours a day on average, and three of those scrolling short videos.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 才六个小时？我上个星期每天七个小时。每天晚上躺在床上看健康视频，想着再看一个就睡，结果一抬头，两点了。
turns.pinyin: cái liù gè xiǎoshí? wǒ shàng gè xīngqī měitiān qī gè xiǎoshí. měitiān wǎnshang tǎng zài chuáng shang kàn jiànkāng shìpín, xiǎng zhe zài kàn yī gè jiù shuì, jiéguǒ yī táitóu, liǎng diǎn le.
turns.en: Only six? Last week I did seven a day. Every night I lie in bed watching health videos, thinking 'one more and then I'll sleep', and the next time I look up, it's two o'clock.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，您别光笑奶奶。昨天午休的时候，我看见您一直在刷京剧的视频，还笑出了声。
turns.pinyin: yéye, nín bié guāng xiào nǎinai. zuótiān wǔxiū de shíhou, wǒ kànjiàn nín yīzhí zài shuā jīngjù de shìpín, hái xiào chū le shēng.
turns.en: Don't just laugh at Grandma, Grandad. Yesterday after lunch, when you were meant to be having a rest, I saw you scrolling Beijing opera videos the whole time, laughing out loud.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那……那是学习！了解传统文化。
turns.pinyin: nà nà shì xuéxí! liǎojiě chuántǒng wénhuà.
turns.en: That... that's studying! Learning about traditional culture.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 说真的，这些应用好像知道我喜欢什么。我看了一次做菜的视频，第二天推给我的全是做菜的。
turns.pinyin: shuōzhēnde, zhèxiē yìngyòng hǎoxiàng zhīdào wǒ xǐhuan shénme. wǒ kàn le yī cì zuòcài de shìpín, dì èr tiān tuī gěi wǒ de quán shì zuòcài de.
turns.en: Seriously, these apps seem to know what I like. I watched one cooking video, and the next day everything it showed me was cooking.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那是算法。你看得越多，它就越了解你，你就越停不下来。有人说，不是我们在刷手机，而是手机在刷我们。
turns.pinyin: nà shì suànfǎ. nǐ kàn de yuè duō, tā jiù yuè liǎojiě nǐ, nǐ jiù yuè tíngbuxiàlái. yǒu rén shuō, bùshì wǒmen zài shuāshǒujī, érshì shǒujī zài shuā wǒmen.
turns.en: That's the algorithm. The more you watch, the better it knows you, and the harder it is to stop. Someone said it isn't us scrolling our phones, it's our phones scrolling us.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 可是即使没有算法，我也会刷。在店里忙了一天，看几个小视频，什么都不用想，挺放松的。
turns.pinyin: kěshì jíshǐ méiyǒu suànfǎ, wǒ yě huì shuā. zài diàn lǐ máng le yī tiān, kàn jǐ gè xiǎo shìpín, shénme dōu bùyòng xiǎng, tǐng fàngsōng de.
turns.en: But even without the algorithm, I'd still scroll. After a busy day at the restaurant, watching a few little videos without having to think about anything is really relaxing.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 放松是放松，就怕上瘾。现在很多人看文章都没耐心了，一段话超过三行就不想看。朵朵玩游戏也是一样，时间都被切成了碎片。
turns.pinyin: fàngsōng shì fàngsōng, jiù pà shàngyǐn. xiànzài hěnduō rén kàn wénzhāng dōu méi nàixīn le, yī duàn huà chāoguò sān háng jiù bù xiǎng kàn. Duǒduo wán yóuxì yěshì yīyàng, shíjiān dōu bèi qiē chéng le suìpiàn.
turns.en: Relaxing, yes, but the worry is getting hooked. Lots of people have no patience for articles any more: more than three lines and they don't want to read it. It's the same with Duoduo and her games. Our time's been chopped into little bits.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这就是所谓的“碎片化”吧。好，我决定了：从明天开始，戒一个月短视频！
turns.pinyin: zhè jiùshì suǒwèi de suìpiànhuà ba. hǎo, wǒ juédìng le: cóng míngtiān kāishǐ, jiè yī gè yuè duǎnshìpín!
turns.en: That's what they call 'fragmentation'. Right, I've decided: from tomorrow, I'm giving up short video for a month!

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 那我也戒一个月游戏！奶奶，您也一起吧？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ yě jiè yī gè yuè yóuxì! nǎinai, nín yě yīqǐ ba?
turns.en: Then I'll give up games for a month too! Grandma, will you do it with us?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 一个月？我跟你们打赌，你们坚持不了一个星期。
turns.pinyin: yī gè yuè? wǒ gēn nǐmen dǎdǔ, nǐmen jiānchí bù liǎo yī gè xīngqī.
turns.en: A month? I bet you can't last a week, any of you.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 赌就赌！谁输了，谁请全家喝奶茶。
turns.pinyin: dǔ jiù dǔ! shéi shū le, shéi qǐng quánjiā hē nǎichá.
turns.en: You're on! Whoever loses buys milk tea for the whole family.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥，你来得正好，我们正在辩论呢。福和的王经理发来邮件，说今年的中秋礼盒，想试试用AI来设计。他听说有的公司用AI，一天能出上百张图，价格只有我们的一半。
turns.pinyin: biǎogē, nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, wǒmen zhèngzài biànlùn ne. Fúhé de Wángjīnglǐ fā lái yóujiàn, shuō jīnnián de zhōngqiū lǐhé, xiǎng shì shi yòngAI lái shèjì. tā tīngshuō yǒu de gōngsī yòngAI, yī tiān néng chū shàngbǎi zhāng tú, jiàgé zhǐ yǒu wǒmen de yībàn.
turns.en: Just in time, cousin: we're in the middle of a debate. Manager Wang at Fuhe has emailed to say that for this year's Mid-Autumn gift box, they'd like to try designing it with AI. He's heard some companies use AI to turn out a hundred images a day, at half our price.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 一天上百张？那还要你们干什么？
turns.pinyin: yī tiān shàngbǎi zhāng? nà hái yào nǐmen gàn shénme?
turns.en: A hundred a day? Then what do they need you for?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 其实我们早就在用了。上个月的初稿里，有好几张参考图就是我用AI生成的。先让它出几十个方向，我再挑、再改，效率高多了。
turns.pinyin: qíshí wǒmen zǎojiù zài yòng le. shàng gè yuè de chūgǎo lǐ, yǒu hǎojǐ zhāng cānkǎo tú jiùshì wǒ yòngAI shēngchéng de. xiān ràng tā chū jǐ shí gè fāngxiàng, wǒ zài tiāo, zài gǎi, xiàolǜ gāo duōle.
turns.en: Actually, we've been using it for ages. Several of the reference images in last month's first draft were ones I generated with AI. I get it to come up with a few dozen directions, then I choose and rework. It's far more efficient.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 可是我有点儿担心刚入行的新人。他们平时做的就是这些基础工作：找参考图、改尺寸、出草图。要是这些AI都能做，公司还需要初级设计师吗？
turns.pinyin: kěshì wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn gāng rùháng de xīnrén. tāmen píngshí zuò de jiùshì zhèxiē jīchǔ gōngzuò: zhǎo cānkǎo tú, gǎi chǐcùn, chū cǎotú. yàoshi zhèxiēAI dōu néng zuò, gōngsī hái xūyào chūjí shèjìshī ma?
turns.en: But I'm a bit worried about the people who've just started out. They spend their days on exactly that groundwork: finding references, resizing, doing sketches. If AI can do all that, will companies still need junior designers?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那你们自己呢？以后我的菜单是不是也不用请你设计了？
turns.pinyin: nà nǐmen zìjǐ ne? yǐhòu wǒ de càidān shì bùshì yě bùyòng qǐng nǐ shèjì le?
turns.en: And what about the two of you? Does this mean I won't need you to design my menus any more?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那倒不会。我不同意“AI会取代设计师”这种说法。照相机发明的时候，大家也说画家要失业了，结果呢？画家没有消失，还多了摄影师。
turns.pinyin: nà dào bù huì. wǒ bù tóngyìAI huì qǔdài shèjìshī zhè zhǒng shuōfǎ. zhàoxiàngjī fāmíng de shíhou, dàjiā yě shuō huàjiā yào shīyè le, jiéguǒ ne? huàjiā méiyǒu xiāoshī, hái duōle shèyǐngshī.
turns.en: It won't come to that. I don't agree that AI will replace designers. When the camera was invented, everyone said painters would be out of work too. And what happened? Painters didn't disappear, and we got photographers as well.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 话虽如此，这次不一样。照相机不会自己画画，AI会。而且我听说，它是从成千上万设计师的作品里学会的，那些作品的主人，谁同意过？
turns.pinyin: huàsuīrúcǐ, zhè cì bù yīyàng. zhàoxiàngjī bù huì zìjǐ huàhuà,AI huì. érqiě wǒ tīngshuō, tā shì cóng chéngqiānshàngwàn shèjìshī de zuòpǐn lǐ xuéhuì de, nàxiē zuòpǐn de zhǔrén, shéi tóngyì guo?
turns.en: That may be so, but this time it's different. A camera can't paint on its own; AI can. And from what I hear, it learned from the work of tens of thousands of designers. Did any of them agree to that?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 版权的问题确实存在，这一点我同意。不过工具本身没有对错，关键看人怎么用。马克的担心有道理，可是反过来说，如果基础工作交给AI，新人就能把时间花在更重要的地方，比如跟客户沟通，真正理解一个品牌。
turns.pinyin: bǎnquán de wèntí quèshí cúnzài, zhèyīdiǎn wǒ tóngyì. bùguò gōngjù běnshēn méiyǒu duìcuò, guānjiàn kàn rén zěnme yòng. Mǎkè de dānxīn yǒudàoli, kěshì fǎnguòláishuō, rúguǒ jīchǔ gōngzuò jiāogěiAI, xīnrén jiù néng bǎ shíjiān huā zài gèng zhòngyào de dìfang, bǐrú gēn kèhù gōutōng, zhēnzhèng lǐjiě yī gè pǐnpái.
turns.en: The copyright problem is real, I'll grant you that. But a tool isn't right or wrong in itself. It depends on how people use it. Mark has a point, but look at it the other way round: if the groundwork goes to AI, new people can spend their time on things that matter more, like talking to clients and really understanding a brand.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 可是不做基础工作，新人怎么成长呢？我当年学包饺子，光擀皮就擀了一年。手上的功夫，是一遍一遍练出来的，没有捷径。
turns.pinyin: kěshì bù zuò jīchǔ gōngzuò, xīnrén zěnme chéngzhǎng ne? wǒ dāngnián xué bāo jiǎozi, guāng gǎn pí jiù gǎn le yī nián. shǒu shang de gōngfu, shì yī biàn yī biàn liàn chūlai de, méiyǒu jiéjìng.
turns.en: But if they don't do the groundwork, how will new people learn? When I was learning to make dumplings, I spent a whole year just rolling wrappers. Skill in your hands comes from doing it over and over. There's no shortcut.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 那机器人呢？听说现在有的机器人，一个小时能包几千个饺子。
turns.pinyin: nà jīqìrén ne? tīngshuō xiànzài yǒu de jīqìrén, yī gè xiǎoshí néng bāo jǐ qiān gè jiǎozi.
turns.en: What about robots, then? I hear there are robots now that can make several thousand dumplings an hour.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 机器人包的饺子，每个都一样。可是客人来我这儿，吃的就是手工的味道。
turns.pinyin: jīqìrén bāo de jiǎozi, měi gè dōu yīyàng. kěshì kèrén lái wǒ zhèr, chī de jiùshì shǒugōng de wèidao.
turns.en: Every dumpling a robot makes is the same. But people come to my place precisely for the taste of something made by hand.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 设计也是这样。客户要的归根结底不是一百张图，而是一个对的想法。AI能给你一百个答案，却不知道哪一个是对的。
turns.pinyin: shèjì yěshì zhèyàng. kèhù yào de guīgēnjiédǐ bùshì yī bǎi zhāng tú, érshì yī gè duì de xiǎngfǎ.AI néng gěi nǐ yī bǎi gè dá'àn, què bù zhīdào nǎ yī gè shì duì de.
turns.en: It's the same with design. When all's said and done, what a client wants isn't a hundred images but one right idea. AI can give you a hundred answers, but it doesn't know which one is right.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 而且AI做出来的东西，看多了都差不多，缺少一点儿温度。福和是老字号，它的故事，还得我们来讲。
turns.pinyin: érqiěAI zuò chūlai de dōngxi, kàn duōle dōu chàbuduō, quēshǎo yīdiǎnr wēndù. Fúhé shì lǎozìhào, tā de gùshi, hái děi wǒmen lái jiǎng.
turns.en: And when you've seen enough AI images, they all look the same. They lack a bit of warmth. Fuhe is an old brand, and its story is one we have to tell.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 那你们老板怎么说？
turns.pinyin: nà nǐmen lǎobǎn zěnme shuō?
turns.en: So what does your boss say?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 老板已经决定了：与其跟AI比速度、比价格，不如让福和看到，用了AI，我们能做得更好。这个项目由我负责，准备两套方案，一套纯手工，一套用AI辅助，下个星期一起给他们看。
turns.pinyin: lǎobǎn yǐjīng juédìng le: yǔqí gēnAI bǐ sùdù, bǐ jiàgé, bùrú ràng Fúhé kàn dào, yòng leAI, wǒmen néng zuò de gèng hǎo. zhège xiàngmù yóu wǒ fùzé, zhǔnbèi liǎng tào fāng'àn, yī tào chún shǒugōng, yī tào yòngAI fǔzhù, xià gè xīngqī yīqǐ gěi tāmen kàn.
turns.en: The boss has already decided: rather than competing with AI on speed and price, we'll show Fuhe that with AI, we can do even better. I'm in charge of the project. We'll prepare two proposals, one done entirely by hand and one with AI's help, and show them both next week.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 两套都会让他们满意的。
turns.pinyin: liǎng tào dōu huì ràng tāmen mǎnyì de.
turns.en: They'll be happy with both.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我先说好，我这一票投给纯手工那套。
turns.pinyin: wǒ xiānshuōhǎo, wǒ zhè yī piào tóu gěi chún shǒugōng nà tào.
turns.en: Let me say now: my vote goes to the handmade one.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥，你连看都还没看呢！
turns.pinyin: biǎogē, nǐ lián kàn dōu hái méi kàn ne!
turns.en: Cousin, you haven't even seen them yet!

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 你们快来看！我们票友群里有人发的：“紧急通知：二月一号起，全市商店一律不收现金！”这可怎么办？
turns.pinyin: nǐmen kuài lái kàn! wǒmen piàoyǒu qún lǐ yǒu rén fā de: jǐnjí tōngzhī: èr yuè yī hào qǐ, quánshì shāngdiàn yīlǜ bù shōu xiànjīn! zhè kě zěnmebàn?
turns.en: Come and look, all of you! Someone posted this in our opera fans' group chat: 'Urgent notice: from 1 February, no shop in the city will accept cash!' What are we going to do?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 您先别急。这条消息是从哪儿来的？有没有说是哪个部门发布的？
turns.pinyin: nín xiān bié jí. zhè tiáo xiāoxi shì cóng nǎr lái de? yǒu méiyǒu shuō shì nǎge bùmén fābù de?
turns.en: Don't panic. Where did this message come from? Does it say which department issued it?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 没说。最后就写着“请转发给您关心的人”，还有三个感叹号。
turns.pinyin: méi shuō. zuìhòu jiù xiě zhe qǐng zhuǎnfā gěi nín guānxīn de rén, hái yǒu sān gè gǎntànhào.
turns.en: No. At the bottom it just says 'Please forward to the people you care about', with three exclamation marks.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 越是写着“紧急”、叫你赶快转发的，越可能是假的。我们查一下。
turns.pinyin: yuèshì xiě zhe jǐnjí, jiào nǐ gǎn kuài zhuǎnfā de, yuè kěnéng shì jiǎ de. wǒmen chá yīxià.
turns.en: The more something says 'urgent' and tells you to forward it quickly, the more likely it is to be fake. Let's check.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我搜了一下，官方根本没发过这样的通知。倒是有一条辟谣：据报道，最近网上流传“商家可以不收现金”的说法，有关部门表示，这是谣言，拒收现金是违规的。我截个图，您发到群里。
turns.pinyin: wǒ sōu le yīxià, guānfāng gēnběn méi fā guo zhèyàng de tōngzhī. dàoshì yǒu yī tiáo pìyáo: jùbàodào, zuìjìn wǎngshang liúchuán shāngjiā kěyǐ bù shōu xiànjīn de shuōfǎ, yǒuguānbùmén biǎoshì, zhè shì yáoyán, jùshōu xiànjīn shì wéiguī de. wǒ jié gè tú, nín fā dào qún lǐ.
turns.en: I've searched, and no official body has issued any such notice. There is a rebuttal, though: according to reports, a claim has been going round online that 'shops can refuse cash', and the authorities have stated that it's a rumour, and refusing cash is against the rules. I'll take a screenshot, and you can post it in the group.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 原来是谣言！他昨天吓得去银行取了五千块钱……
turns.pinyin: yuánlái shì yáoyán! tā zuótiān xià de qù yínháng qǔ le wǔ qiān kuài qián
turns.en: So it's a rumour! He got such a fright he went to the bank yesterday and took out five thousand...

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 那也不算坏事，过年的红包都准备好了。
turns.pinyin: nà yě bù suàn huài shì, guònián de hóngbāo dōu zhǔnbèi hǎole.
turns.en: Well, that's not all bad. The New Year red envelopes are sorted.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 那我以后怎么知道哪条是真的，哪条是假的？
turns.pinyin: nà wǒ yǐhòu zěnme zhīdào nǎ tiáo shì zhēnde, nǎ tiáo shì jiǎ de?
turns.en: So how will I know in future which ones are true and which are fake?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 先看来源，是不是正规媒体或者官方发的；再看时间，有的旧新闻换个标题又传一遍；最后，别急着转发，多查一个地方。
turns.pinyin: xiān kàn láiyuán, shì bùshì zhèngguī méitǐ huòzhě guānfāng fā de; zài kàn shíjiān, yǒu de jiù xīnwén huàn gè biāotí yòu chuán yī biàn; zuìhòu, bié jí zhe zhuǎnfā, duō chá yī gè dìfang.
turns.en: First, look at the source: is it from proper media or an official account? Then look at the date: some old news goes round again with a new headline. And last, don't rush to forward it. Check one more place.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 记住了：看来源，看时间，不急着转。
turns.pinyin: jìzhù le: kàn láiyuán, kàn shíjiān, bù jí zhe zhuǎn.
turns.en: Got it: check the source, check the date, don't rush to forward.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 哎呀，差点儿把正事忘了！你戴上眼镜，把这一条念给大家听听，区里的公众号今天早上发的。
turns.pinyin: āiyā, chàdiǎnr bǎ zhèngshì wàng le! nǐ dài shang yǎnjìng, bǎ zhè yī tiáo niàn gěi dàjiā tīng tīng, qū lǐ de gōngzhònghào jīntiān zǎoshang fā de.
turns.en: Oh my, I nearly forgot the real business! Put your glasses on and read this one out to everybody. The district's WeChat account posted it this morning.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: “‘我的上海’征文比赛结果揭晓”……“据悉，本次活动共收到来稿一千二百余篇”……“外籍居民马克的《我的上海》获二等奖”！下面还有：“评委称，这篇文章用一个外国人的眼睛，写出了上海弄堂的温度。”
turns.pinyin: wǒ de Shànghǎi zhēngwén bǐsài jiéguǒ jiēxiǎo jùxī, běn cì huódòng gòng shōudào láigǎo yīqiān'èrbǎi yú piān wàijí jūmín Mǎkè de wǒ de Shànghǎi huò èrděngjiǎng! xià miàn hái yǒu: píngwěi chēng, zhè piān wénzhāng yòng yī gè wàiguórén de yǎnjing, xiě chū le Shànghǎi lòngtáng de wēndù.
turns.en: 'Results announced in My Shanghai essay competition'... 'It is understood that the competition received more than twelve hundred entries'... 'My Shanghai, by foreign resident Mark, wins second prize'! And there's more below: 'The judges said the essay captures the warmth of Shanghai's lanes through a foreigner's eyes.'

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 等一下……这是我吗？
turns.pinyin: děng yīxià zhè shì wǒ ma?
turns.en: Hang on... is that me?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 除了你，愚园路还有哪个外籍居民叫马克？恭喜恭喜！
turns.pinyin: chúle nǐ, Yúyuánlù hái yǒu nǎge wàijí jūmín jiào Mǎkè? gōngxǐ gōngxǐ!
turns.en: Which other foreign resident on Yuyuan Road is called Mark? Congratulations!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “外籍居民”“获二等奖”“评委称”……写的明明是我，读起来却像在说别人。
turns.pinyin: wàijí jūmín huò èrděngjiǎng píngwěi chēng xiě de míngmíng shì wǒ, dú qǐlai què xiàng zài shuō biéren.
turns.en: 'Foreign resident', 'wins second prize', 'the judges said'... It's obviously about me, but it reads as if it's about someone else.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 新闻就是这样。一个“获”字，比“得到了”正式多了。
turns.pinyin: xīnwén jiùshì zhèyàng. yī gè huò zì, bǐ dédào le zhèngshì duōle.
turns.en: That's news for you. One character, 获, is much more formal than 得到了.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这条我要转发！转到票友群里，让他们也看看，真新闻是什么样子的。
turns.pinyin: zhè tiáo wǒ yào zhuǎnfā! zhuǎn dào piàoyǒu qún lǐ, ràng tāmen yě kàn kan, zhēn xīnwén shì shénme yàngzi de.
turns.en: This one I'm forwarding! To the opera fans' group, so they can see what real news looks like.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 对了，叔叔，您说过，我写得好，就请我吃大闸蟹。
turns.pinyin: duìle, shūshu, nín shuō guo, wǒ xiě de hǎo, jiù qǐng wǒ chī dàzháxiè.
turns.en: By the way, Uncle, you did say that if I wrote it well, you'd treat me to hairy crab.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 大闸蟹早就过季了。过年阿姨给你做八宝饭！
turns.pinyin: dàzháxiè zǎojiù guòjì le. guònián āyí gěi nǐ zuò bābǎofàn!
turns.en: Hairy crab's long out of season. At New Year, Auntie will make you eight-treasure rice!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，清明节放了三天假，玩得怎么样？朋友圈里一张照片都没发。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, qīngmíngjié fàng le sān tiān jià, wán de zěnmeyàng? péngyouquān lǐ yī zhāng zhàopiàn dōu méi fā.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, how was your three-day Qingming holiday? You didn't post a single photo.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 玩？放了三天假，我见了三个人。第一天是我妈同事的儿子，第二天是我爸战友的侄子，第三天那个，是在人民公园的相亲角“挑”的。
turns.pinyin: wán? fàng le sān tiān jià, wǒ jiàn le sān gè rén. dì yī tiān shì wǒ mā tóngshì de érzi, dì èr tiān shì wǒ bà zhànyǒu de zhízi, dì sān tiān nàge, shì zài Rénmíngōngyuán de xiāngqīnjiǎo tiāo de.
turns.en: Fun? Three days off, and I met three men. Day one, my mum's colleague's son. Day two, the nephew of my dad's old army friend. And day three was one 'picked out' at the matchmaking corner in People's Park.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 是我挑的。我这不是为她好吗？她妈说了，今年九月小雨就二十七了，再不抓紧，好的都被别人挑走了。
turns.pinyin: shì wǒ tiāo de. wǒ zhè bùshì wèi tā hǎo ma? tā mā shuō le, jīnnián jiǔ yuè Xiǎoyǔ jiù èrshíqī le, zài bù zhuājǐn, hǎode dōu bèi biéren tiāo zǒu le.
turns.en: I picked him. Aren't I doing it for her own good? Her mum says Xiaoyu will be twenty-seven in September, and if she doesn't get a move on, all the good ones will be taken.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: “好的都被挑走了”？听起来像在菜场买菜。
turns.pinyin: hǎode dōu bèi tiāo zǒu le? tīngqilai xiàng zài càichǎng mǎi cài.
turns.en: 'All the good ones will be taken'? It sounds like buying vegetables at the market.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 差不多。相亲角那儿，一张张纸上写着年龄、身高、学历、收入、有没有房……我的“简历”也被贴上去了。
turns.pinyin: chàbuduō. xiāngqīnjiǎo nàr, yī zhāng zhāng zhǐ shang xiě zhe niánlíng, shēngāo, xuélì, shōurù, yǒu méiyǒu fáng wǒ de jiǎnlì yě bèi tiē shàngqu le.
turns.en: Pretty much. At the matchmaking corner there are sheets of paper giving age, height, education, income, whether you own a flat... and my 'CV' got put up too.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 贴一张怎么了？我们竹溪村也一样。我表姐的女儿二十五岁还没结婚，村里就有人在背后说她是“剩女”了。
turns.pinyin: tiē yī zhāng zěnmele? wǒmen Zhúxīcūn yě yīyàng. wǒ biǎojiě de nǚ'ér èr shí wǔ suì hái méi jiéhūn, cūn lǐ jiù yǒu rén zài bèihòu shuō tā shì shèngnǚ le.
turns.en: What's wrong with putting up one sheet? It's the same in Zhuxi. My cousin's daughter was twenty-five and still not married, and people in the village were already calling her a 'leftover woman' behind her back.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我最讨厌这个词。什么叫“剩”？难道女人是超市里的菜，过了日子就没人要了？
turns.pinyin: wǒ zuì tǎoyàn zhège cí. shénme jiào shèng? nándào nǚrén shì chāoshì lǐ de cài, guò le rìzi jiù méi rén yào le?
turns.en: I hate that word. What does 'leftover' mean? Are women vegetables in a supermarket, that nobody wants past their date?

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 在英国，三十多岁不结婚的人很多，父母一般不怎么管。不过我外婆每次跟我视频，都要问一句：“有女朋友了吗？”
turns.pinyin: zài yīngguó, sān shí duō suì bù jiéhūn de rén hěnduō, fùmǔ yībān bù zěnme guǎn. bùguò wǒ wàipó měi cì gēn wǒ shìpín, dōu yào wèn yī jù: yǒu nǚ péngyǒu le ma?
turns.en: In Britain, lots of people in their thirties aren't married, and parents don't usually interfere. Mind you, every time my gran video-calls me, she asks: 'Got a girlfriend yet?'

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 你看，英国的外婆也急！还有你，陈明。朵朵都快十二岁了，你一个人带孩子，什么时候也去见一见？
turns.pinyin: nǐ kàn, yīngguó de wàipó yě jí! hái yǒu nǐ, Chénmíng. Duǒduo dōu kuài shí èr suì le, nǐ yī gè rén dài háizi, shénmeshíhou yě qù jiàn yī jiàn?
turns.en: You see, grans in Britain worry too! And as for you, Chen Ming: Duoduo's nearly twelve, and you're bringing her up on your own. When are you going to go and meet someone?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 妈，店里忙成这样，我哪有时间谈恋爱？
turns.pinyin: mā, diàn lǐ máng chéng zhèyàng, wǒ nǎ yǒu shíjiān tánliàn'ài?
turns.en: Mum, with the restaurant as busy as it is, when would I have time to go out with anyone?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 话说回来，做父母的也不容易。儿子三十六了，我嘴上不说，心里也急。
turns.pinyin: huàshuōhuílái, zuò fùmǔ de yě bù róngyì. érzi sānshíliù le, wǒ zuǐ shang bù shuō, xīnli yě jí.
turns.en: That said, it isn't easy being a parent either. My son's thirty-six. I don't say anything, but inside I worry too.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，那您急的是什么呢？
turns.pinyin: yéye, nà nín jí de shì shénme ne?
turns.en: What is it you worry about, Grandad?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 说到底，还是怕。怕我们老了、走了，你长大了，他一个人，生病了身边都没个人照顾。
turns.pinyin: shuōdàodǐ, háishi pà. pà wǒmen lǎo le, zǒu le, nǐ zhǎngdà le, tā yī gè rén, shēngbìng le shēnbiān dōu méi gè rén zhàogù.
turns.en: When it comes down to it, it's fear. Fear that when we're old and gone, and you've grown up, he'll be on his own, with nobody beside him when he's ill.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 这个我懂。可是结婚不是为了找个人照顾，而是因为遇到了对的人。为了结婚而结婚，何必呢？
turns.pinyin: zhège wǒ dǒng. kěshì jiéhūn bùshì wèile zhǎo gè rén zhàogù, érshì yīnwèi yùdào le duì de rén. wèile jiéhūn ér jiéhūn, hébì ne?
turns.en: I understand that. But you don't marry to find someone to look after you. You marry because you've met the right person. Why marry just for the sake of it?

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 这话没错。不过在我们这代人眼里，结婚是人生的任务，跟上学、工作一样，到了年龄就得完成。
turns.pinyin: zhè huà méicuò. bùguò zài wǒmen zhè dài rén yǎnli, jiéhūn shì rénshēng de rènwu, gēnshàng xué, gōngzuò yīyàng, dào le niánlíng jiù děi wánchéng.
turns.en: That's true. But to our generation, marriage is one of life's tasks, like school and work: when you reach the age, you get it done.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 小雨，那你跟你爸妈好好谈过吗？
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, nà nǐ gēn nǐ bàmā hǎohāo tán guo ma?
turns.en: So have you had a proper talk with your parents, Xiaoyu?

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 谈过，一谈就吵。我说我的事业正在上升期，他们说事业再好，老了也不能陪你说话。
turns.pinyin: tán guo, yī tán jiù chǎo. wǒ shuō wǒ de shìyè zhèngzài shàngshēngqī, tāmen shuō shìyè zài hǎo, lǎo le yě bù néng péi nǐ shuōhuà.
turns.en: I have. Every time we talk, we fight. I say my career's on the way up, and they say however good your career is, it can't keep you company when you're old.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 那就慢慢来。毕竟是两代人，想法不一样很正常。……对了，马克，你呢？你跟小雨天天一起上班，你们两个人……
turns.pinyin: nà jiù mànmàn lái. bìjìng shì liǎngdàirén, xiǎngfǎ bù yīyàng hěn zhèngcháng. duìle, Mǎkè, nǐ ne? nǐ gēn Xiǎoyǔ tiān tiān yīqǐ shàngbān, nǐmen liǎng gè rén
turns.en: Then take it slowly. We're two generations, after all; it's normal to think differently. ...Oh, and Mark, what about you? You and Xiaoyu go to work together every day, and you two...

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 阿姨，饺子要凉了，快吃吧！
turns.pinyin: āyí, jiǎozi yào liáng le, kuài chī ba!
turns.en: Auntie, the dumplings are getting cold. Eat up!

dialogues.title: Busier at the weekend than at work

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 朵朵，再吃一个生煎。马克、小雨，你们看看，这孩子瘦成什么样了。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo, zài chī yī gè shēngjiān. Mǎkè, Xiǎoyǔ, nǐmen kàn kan, zhè háizi shòu chéng shénmeyàng le.
turns.en: Duoduo, have another fried bun. Mark, Xiaoyu, look how thin this child has got.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 妈，来不及了。八点半奥数，十点半编程，下午还有作文和钢琴。朵朵，快把牛奶喝了。
turns.pinyin: mā, láibují le. bā diǎn bàn àoshù, shí diǎn bàn biānchéng, xiàwǔ hái yǒu zuòwén hé gāngqín. Duǒduo, kuài bǎ niúnǎi hē le.
turns.en: Mum, there's no time. Maths Olympiad at half eight, coding at half ten, and composition and piano this afternoon. Duoduo, drink your milk, quick.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 星期六一天四节课？朵朵，你累不累？
turns.pinyin: xīngqī liù yī tiān sì jié kè? Duǒduo, nǐ lèi bù lèi?
turns.en: Four classes on a Saturday? Duoduo, aren't you tired?

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 累。可是我们班同学都这样。我同桌星期天还要上英语课呢。
turns.pinyin: lèi. kěshì wǒmen bān tóngxué dōu zhèyàng. wǒ tóngzhuō xīngqītiān hái yào shàng yīngyǔ kè ne.
turns.en: Yes. But everyone in my class is the same. My desk-mate has an English class on Sundays too.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 朵朵才十一岁吧？我十一岁的时候，周末就是看动画片，跟邻居家的孩子在院子里疯跑。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo cái shí yī suì ba? wǒ shí yī suì de shíhou, zhōumò jiùshì kàn dònghuàpiàn, gēn línjū jiā de háizi zài yuànzi lǐ fēng pǎo.
turns.en: Duoduo's only eleven, isn't she? When I was eleven, my weekends were cartoons and running wild in the courtyard with the neighbours' kids.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 小雨，你们那时候跟现在不一样。不是我想“鸡娃”，而是大家都在跑，你一停下来，孩子就跟不上了。朵朵在伦敦长大，中文作文本来就比同学差一点儿。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, nǐmen nàshíhou gēn xiànzài bù yīyàng. bùshì wǒ xiǎng jīwá, érshì dàjiā dōu zài pǎo, nǐ yī tíng xiàlai, háizi jiù gēnbushàng le. Duǒduo zài Lúndūn zhǎngdà, zhōngwén zuòwén běnlái jiù bǐ tóngxué chà yīdiǎnr.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, it was different in your day. It isn't that I want to push her. Everyone's running, and if you stop, your child falls behind. Duoduo grew up in London, and her Chinese composition was always going to be a bit behind her classmates'.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 大家都在跑，那大家都累死。依我看，就是互相攀比。孩子嘛，身体最要紧。
turns.pinyin: dàjiā dōu zài pǎo, nà dàjiā dōu lèi sǐ. yīwǒkàn, jiùshì hùxiāng pānbǐ. háizi ma, shēntǐ zuì yàojǐn.
turns.en: If everyone's running, everyone's worn out. The way I see it, it's just keeping up with everyone else. With children, their health comes first.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 妈，我也想让她轻松一点儿啊。可是明年就要小升初了，好的初中竞争那么激烈，我不得不早做准备。
turns.pinyin: mā, wǒ yě xiǎng ràng tā qīngsōng yīdiǎnr a. kěshì míngnián jiù yào xiǎoshēngchū le, hǎode chūzhōng jìngzhēng nàme jīliè, wǒ bùdébù zǎo zuò zhǔnbèi.
turns.en: Mum, I want her to have an easier time too. But next year she moves up to secondary school, and competition for the good ones is so fierce I've no choice but to prepare early.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 我在英国上学的时候，最重要的考试是十六岁和十八岁那两次。小学放学以后，基本上就是踢球。
turns.pinyin: wǒ zài yīngguó shàng xué de shíhou, zuì zhòngyào de kǎoshì shì shí liù suì hé shí bā suì nà liǎng cì. xiǎoxué fàng xué yǐhòu, jīběnshang jiùshì tī qiú.
turns.en: When I was at school in Britain, the exams that really mattered were at sixteen and eighteen. At primary school, after school was basically football.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 我们那时候，最怕的就是高考。高三一整年，早上六点起床，晚上十一点还在做题。教室后面的黑板上写着：距离高考还有一百天。
turns.pinyin: wǒmen nàshíhou, zuì pà de jiùshì gāokǎo. gāosān yī zhěng nián, zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, wǎnshang shí yī diǎn hái zài zuòtí. jiàoshì hòumiàn de hēibǎn shang xiě zhe: jùlí gāokǎo hái yǒu yī bǎi tiān.
turns.en: In our day, the thing we dreaded was the gaokao. The whole of the final year, up at six, still doing practice papers at eleven at night. On the board at the back of the classroom it said: one hundred days to the gaokao.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 是啊。高考那么难，孩子想上一所好大学，就非从小打好基础不可。一步慢了，步步都慢。
turns.pinyin: shì a. gāokǎo nàme nán, háizi xiǎng shàng yī suǒ hǎo dàxué, jiù fēi cóngxiǎo dǎ hǎo jīchǔ bùkě. yī bù màn le, bùbù dōu màn.
turns.en: Exactly. The gaokao is so hard that if a child wants to get into a good university, they simply have to build the foundations from early on. Fall one step behind, and you're behind at every step.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 奶奶，我其实最喜欢画画。可是爸爸说，画画不算分。
turns.pinyin: nǎinai, wǒ qíshí zuì xǐhuan huàhuà. kěshì bàba shuō, huàhuà bù suànfēn.
turns.en: Grandma, what I actually like best is drawing. But Dad says drawing doesn't count towards your marks.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 朵朵，画画可是我的工作哦。你画的是什么？给我看看。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo, huàhuà kěshì wǒ de gōngzuò ó. nǐ huà de shì shénme? gěi wǒ kàn kan.
turns.en: Duoduo, drawing's my job, you know. What have you drawn? Let me see.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 这是我们家的弄堂，这是奶奶，这是爷爷的茶杯，这是马克的自行车，这是你。
turns.pinyin: zhè shì wǒmen jiā de lòngtáng, zhè shì nǎinai, zhè shì yéye de chá bēi, zhè shì Mǎkè de zìxíngchē, zhè shì nǐ.
turns.en: This is our lane, this is Grandma, this is Grandad's teacup, this is Mark's bike, and this is you.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: ……我都不知道，她画得这么好。
turns.pinyin: wǒ dōu bù zhīdào, tā huà de zhème hǎo.
turns.en: ...I didn't even know she could draw this well.

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 所以说嘛。你小时候我也忙，可是当妈的再忙，也知道儿子喜欢什么。现在孩子的时间都被补习班占满了，你连她喜欢什么，都没时间看一看。
turns.pinyin: suǒyǐ shuō ma. nǐ xiǎoshíhou wǒ yě máng, kěshì dāngmāde zài máng, yě zhīdào érzi xǐhuan shénme. xiànzài háizi de shíjiān dōu bèi bǔxíbān zhànmǎn le, nǐ lián tā xǐhuan shénme, dōu méi shíjiān kàn yī kàn.
turns.en: That's just it. I was busy when you were little too, but however busy a mother is, she knows what her son likes. Now the child's time is all taken up by cram classes, and you haven't even got time to see what she likes.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 好吧。下午的钢琴课请个假，就今天一次，让她在家画画。下个星期还得去。
turns.pinyin: hǎo ba. xiàwǔ de gāngqín kè qǐng gè jià, jiù jīntiān yī cì, ràng tā zài jiā huàhuà. xià gè xīngqī hái děi qù.
turns.en: All right. She can skip this afternoon's piano class, just this once, and stay at home and draw. Next week she's going, though.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 太好了！马克，你教我画自行车！
turns.pinyin: tàihǎole! Mǎkè, nǐ jiāo wǒ huà zìxíngchē!
turns.en: Yay! Mark, teach me to draw a bike!

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 小雨，马克，你们都在，正好。我爸的检查结果出来了，我心里乱得很。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, Mǎkè, nǐmen dōu zài, zhènghǎo. wǒ bà de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ chūlai le, wǒ xīnli luàn de hěn.
turns.en: Xiaoyu, Mark, you're both here. Good. Dad's test results are back, and my head's all over the place.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥，出什么事了？是不是姨父的腿？
turns.pinyin: biǎogē, chū shénme shì le? shì bùshì yífu de tuǐ?
turns.en: What's happened? Is it Uncle's legs?

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 嗯。上个星期他在公园里摔了一跤，膝盖肿得厉害。医生说，两个膝盖都磨得差不多了，最好尽快换关节。
turns.pinyin: ń. shàng gè xīngqī tā zài gōngyuán lǐ shuāi le yī jiāo, xīgài zhǒng de lìhai. yīshēng shuō, liǎng gè xīgài dōu mó de chàbuduō le, zuìhǎo jǐnkuài huàn guānjié.
turns.en: Yes. Last week he fell over in the park, and his knee's badly swollen. The doctor says both knees are nearly worn out, and he should have them replaced as soon as possible.

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，您爬长城的时候就说膝盖不好，那次您坐的缆车。
turns.pinyin: shūshu, nín pá Chángchéng de shíhou jiù shuō xīgài bù hǎo, nà cì nín zuò de lǎnchē.
turns.en: You said your knees were bad when we climbed the Great Wall, Uncle. You took the cable car that time.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 换什么关节？我七十多了，不想挨那一刀。住院又花钱又要人照顾，我不想成为你们的负担。
turns.pinyin: huàn shénme guānjié? wǒ qīshí duōle, bù xiǎng ái nà yī dāo. zhùyuàn yòu huā qián yòu yào rén zhàogù, wǒ bù xiǎng chéngwéi nǐmen de fùdān.
turns.en: Replace what? I'm over seventy, and I don't want to go under the knife. Being in hospital costs money and needs someone to look after you, and I don't want to be a burden to you all.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 姨父，您就是这样，什么事都自己扛。姨妈，您说呢？
turns.pinyin: yífu, nín jiùshì zhèyàng, shénme shì dōu zìjǐ káng. yímā, nín shuō ne?
turns.en: That's you all over, Uncle. You shoulder everything yourself. What do you say, Auntie?

turns.name: 陈妈妈
turns.hanzi: 我没事。扶他上下楼，买菜做饭，我还做得动。
turns.pinyin: wǒ méi shì. fú tā shàng xià lóu, mǎi cài zuòfàn, wǒ hái zuò de dòng.
turns.en: I'm fine. Helping him up and down the stairs, the shopping, the cooking: I can still manage.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 妈，您自己的腰也不好，我看得出来，您快撑不住了。我是独生子，这个时候我不管，谁管？可是我天天在店里，总不能把店关了吧。
turns.pinyin: mā, nín zìjǐ de yāo yě bù hǎo, wǒ kàn de chūlai, nín kuài chēngbuzhù le. wǒ shì dúshēngzǐ, zhège shíhou wǒ bùguǎn, shéi guǎn? kěshì wǒ tiān tiān zài diàn lǐ, zǒngbùnéng bǎ diàn guān le ba.
turns.en: Mum, your own back isn't good, and I can see you're close to breaking point. I'm an only child. If I don't take care of this, who will? But I'm at the restaurant every day, and I can't very well shut it.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 有没有想过请个护工？我听说上海现在有不错的养老院，有医生，还能做康复。
turns.pinyin: yǒu méiyǒu xiǎng guo qǐng gè hùgōng? wǒ tīngshuō Shànghǎi xiànzài yǒu bùcuò de yǎnglǎoyuàn, yǒu yīshēng, hái néng zuò kāngfù.
turns.en: Have you thought about getting a carer? I've heard there are good care homes in Shanghai now, with doctors, and rehab as well.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 我提过一次，我爸当场就火了。
turns.pinyin: wǒ tí guo yī cì, wǒ bà dāngchǎng jiù huǒ le.
turns.en: I suggested it once, and Dad blew up on the spot.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 现在我也火！我有儿子，去什么养老院？让人家笑话！
turns.pinyin: xiànzài wǒ yě huǒ! wǒ yǒu érzi, qù shénme yǎnglǎoyuàn? ràng rénjia xiàohua!
turns.en: And I'm blowing up now! I've got a son. Why would I go into a home? People would laugh!

turns.name: 马克
turns.hanzi: 叔叔，在英国，很多老人最后几年都住在养老院。我爷爷就在一家养老院住了五年，我们每个周末都去看他。那不是没人要，是需要更专业的照顾。
turns.pinyin: shūshu, zài yīngguó, hěnduō lǎorén zuìhòu jǐ nián dōu zhù zài yǎnglǎoyuàn. wǒ yéye jiù zài yī jiā yǎnglǎoyuàn zhù le wǔ nián, wǒmen měi gè zhōumò dōu qù kàn tā. nà bùshì méi rén yào, shì xūyào gèng zhuānyè de zhàogù.
turns.en: Uncle, in Britain, lots of old people spend their last years in a care home. My grandad lived in one for five years, and we went to see him every weekend. It wasn't that nobody wanted him. He needed more professional care.

turns.name: 陈明
turns.hanzi: 道理我都懂。可是在中国，孝顺不只是让父母吃好穿好，还得让他们觉得有面子，觉得儿女就在身边。
turns.pinyin: dàoli wǒ dōu dǒng. kěshì zài zhōngguó, xiàoshùn bùzhǐ shì ràng fùmǔ chī hǎo chuān hǎo, hái děi ràng tāmen juéde yǒu miànzi, juéde érnǚ jiù zài shēnbiān.
turns.en: I understand all that. But in China, being a good son isn't just making sure your parents are fed and clothed. You have to make them feel respected, feel their children are right there with them.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 姨父，与其说您是怕花钱、怕麻烦我们，不如说您是怕自己没用了。表哥越说“我来照顾你”，您越觉得自己老了。
turns.pinyin: yífu, yǔqíshuō nín shì pà huā qián, pà máfan wǒmen, bùrúshuō nín shì pà zìjǐ méi yòng le. biǎogē yuè shuō wǒ lái zhàogù nǐ, nín yuè juéde zìjǐ lǎo le.
turns.en: Uncle, it isn't so much that you're afraid of the cost or of troubling us. It's more that you're afraid of being useless. The more he says 'I'll look after you', the older you feel.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: ……你这么一说，好像是这样。我退休以后，最怕别人说我老。
turns.pinyin: nǐ zhème yī shuō, hǎoxiàng shì zhèyàng. wǒ tuìxiū yǐhòu, zuì pà biéren shuō wǒ lǎo.
turns.en: ...Now you put it like that, I think you're right. Ever since I retired, what I've dreaded most is people saying I'm old.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，那我们不说“照顾”。手术做完了，您还能去公园唱京剧，还能带我去爬长城。
turns.pinyin: yéye, nà wǒmen bù shuō zhàogù. shǒushù zuò wán le, nín hái néng qù gōngyuán chàng jīngjù, hái néng dài wǒ qù pá Chángchéng.
turns.en: Then we won't say 'look after', Grandad. Once the operation's done, you'll be back in the park singing Beijing opera, and you can take me up the Great Wall.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 哈哈，这个我爱听！行，听朵朵的，做。
turns.pinyin: hāhā, zhège wǒ ài tīng! xíng, tīng Duǒduo de, zuò.
turns.en: Ha ha, now that I like to hear! All right. We'll do what Duoduo says. I'll have it done.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 表哥，你先陪他们把手术做了。店里的事，师傅们能行。姨妈一个人扛了这么久，也该轮到你了。
turns.pinyin: biǎogē, nǐ xiān péi tāmen bǎ shǒushù zuò le. diàn lǐ de shì, shīfu men néng xíng. yímā yī gè rén káng le zhème jiǔ, yě gāi lúndào nǐ le.
turns.en: Be with them for the operation first. The chefs can manage the restaurant. Auntie's carried this on her own for so long. It's your turn now.

turns.name: 小雨
turns.hanzi: 朵朵，录音笔开了，你问吧。姨父，您就当跟朵朵聊天，想到哪儿说到哪儿。
turns.pinyin: Duǒduo, lùyīnbǐ kāi le, nǐ wèn ba. yífu, nín jiù dàng gēn Duǒduo liáotiān, xiǎngdàonǎr shuōdàonǎr.
turns.en: Duoduo, the recorder's on. Off you go. Uncle, just think of it as chatting with Duoduo. Say whatever comes to mind.

turns.name: 陈爸爸
turns.hanzi: 好。先说好，讲错了不许笑我。
turns.pinyin: hǎo. xiānshuōhǎo, jiǎng cuò le bùxǔ xiào wǒ.
turns.en: All right. But I'm telling you now, no laughing at me if I get things wrong.

turns.name: 朵朵
turns.hanzi: 爷爷，您是哪一年出生的？小时候住在什么地方？
turns.pinyin: yéye, nín shì nǎ yī nián chūshēng de? xiǎoshíhou zhù zài shénme dìfang?
